board.sessionNote.category_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by category.
board.sessionNote.category_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by category and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.assignee_one.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such card below is not filtered by assignee.
board.sessionNote.assignee_one.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.assignee_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by assignee.
board.sessionNote.assignee_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.priorityCategory_one.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such card below is not filtered by priority or category.
board.sessionNote.priorityCategory_one.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority or category and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.priorityCategory_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by priority or category.
board.sessionNote.priorityCategory_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority or category and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.priorityAssignee_one.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such card below is not filtered by priority or assignee.
board.sessionNote.priorityAssignee_one.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.priorityAssignee_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by priority or assignee.
board.sessionNote.priorityAssignee_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.categoryAssignee_one.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such card below is not filtered by category or assignee.
board.sessionNote.categoryAssignee_one.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by category or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.categoryAssignee_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by category or assignee.
board.sessionNote.categoryAssignee_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by category or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.all_one.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such card below is not filtered by priority, category or assignee.
board.sessionNote.all_one.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority, category or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

board.sessionNote.all_other.text: Changes in progress don't carry priority, category or assignee. The {{count}} such cards below are not filtered by priority, category or assignee.
board.sessionNote.all_other.description: Note at the top of the Workshop board's "Underway" column when the board is filtered by priority, category or assignee and the cards of changes in progress are shown anyway, because those have none of them. {{count}} is how many such cards are below.

request.fallbackTitle.description: Stands in for the title of a request (a filed issue) linked to a change when the title is not known. {{number}} is the issue's number.

request.ref.closedBy.description: Small heading on a request's page (a request is a filed issue) over the link to the change that deals with it. Used when that change was merged and the request is closed; the change's reference follows.

request.ref.addressedBy.description: Small heading on a request's page (a request is a filed issue) over the link to the change that deals with it. Used when that change was merged and the request is still open; the change's reference follows.

request.ref.waiting.description: Small heading on a request's page (a request is a filed issue) over the link to the change that deals with it. Used when that change is up for a vote.

request.ref.underway.description: Small heading on a request's page (a request is a filed issue) over the link to the change that deals with it. Used when that change is still being built.

request.ref.changeLabel.description: Short label on the link from a request's page to the change that deals with it, used when the change has no pull request number to show. A noun.

request.ref.pullRequestTitle.description: Stands in for the title of the change linked from a request's page when the change has no title. {{number}} is its pull request number on GitHub.

request.ref.changeTitle.description: Stands in for the title of the change linked from a request's page when it has neither a title nor a pull request number. "Change" is a noun; {{id}} is the change's number in Homeroom.

request.actions.stopWorking.description: Button on a request's page for the person who said they would work on it: withdraws that claim.

request.actions.stopWorkingTitle.text: Stop working on this so somebody else can pick it up
request.actions.stopWorkingTitle.description: Tooltip on the Stop working on this button of a request.

request.actions.claim.description: Button on a request's page: tells everyone that this person will work on the request. "It" is the request.

request.actions.claimTitle.text: Let everyone know you'll work on this. It's not a promise of progress
request.actions.claimTitle.description: Tooltip on the Claim it button of a request. It ends without a full stop.

request.actions.bountied.description: Label of the disabled kudos button on a request when this person has already pledged kudos for it. Keep the star at the start.

request.actions.pledgeKudos.description: Button on a request's page: promises kudos (thank-you points) to whoever builds the change that fulfils the request. "Pledge" is a verb.

request.actions.pledgeKudosTitle.text: Pledge kudos to whoever's change makes this happen
request.actions.pledgeKudosTitle.description: Tooltip on the Pledge kudos button of a request.

request.actions.closeProposed.description: Label of the disabled button on a request when a vote to close the request is already open. "Close" is a noun here: the closing of the request has been proposed.

request.actions.closeProposedTitle.text: Closing this request is waiting for approval
request.actions.closeProposedTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled Close proposed button of a request.

request.actions.proposeReopen.description: Button on a closed request's page: asks the group to vote on reopening the request. "Reopening" is a verb, to make the request open again.

request.actions.proposeReopenTitle.text: Ask the group to reopen this request. If they approve, it's open again
request.actions.proposeReopenTitle.description: Tooltip on the Propose reopening button of a closed request. It ends without a full stop.

request.actions.reopenProposed.description: Label of the disabled button on a closed request when a vote to reopen it is already open. "Reopen" is a noun here: the reopening has been proposed.

request.actions.reopenProposedTitle.text: Reopening this request is waiting for approval
request.actions.reopenProposedTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled Reopen proposed button of a closed request.

request.actions.proposeClose.description: Button on a request's page: asks the group to vote on closing the request. "Close" is a verb, to mark the request as finished.

request.actions.proposeCloseTitle.text: Ask the group to close this request. If they approve, it's closed
request.actions.proposeCloseTitle.description: Tooltip on the Propose to close button of a request. It ends without a full stop.

request.comments.unknownAuthor.description: Shown in place of the author's name on a comment on a request's page when the comment has no known author. Lower case, as a name would sit there.

request.closedBand.whenByVote.description: The whole text of the band at the top of a closed request's page (a request is a filed issue), when the group voted to close it. "Closed" is an adjective describing the request. {{date}} is a short date or relative time, for example Oct 5 or 3d ago. <0></0> is the status word, drawn bold; <1></1> and <3></3> are separator dots hidden from screen readers; <2></2> holds the date and <4></4> the words saying how it was closed. Keep every tag, in the order your language reads.

request.closedBand.whenByAdmin.description: The whole text of the band at the top of a closed request's page (a request is a filed issue), when an administrator closed it. "Closed" is an adjective describing the request. {{date}} is a short date or relative time, for example Oct 5 or 3d ago. <0></0> is the status word, drawn bold; <1></1> and <3></3> are separator dots hidden from screen readers; <2></2> holds the date and <4></4> the words saying how it was closed. Keep every tag, in the order your language reads.

request.closedBand.byVote.description: The whole text of the band at the top of a closed request's page (a request is a filed issue), when the group voted to close it and the date is not known. "Closed" is an adjective describing the request. <0></0> is the status word, drawn bold; <1></1> is a separator dot hidden from screen readers; <2></2> holds the words saying how it was closed. Keep every tag, in the order your language reads.

request.closedBand.byAdmin.description: The whole text of the band at the top of a closed request's page (a request is a filed issue), when an administrator closed it and the date is not known. "Closed" is an adjective describing the request. <0></0> is the status word, drawn bold; <1></1> is a separator dot hidden from screen readers; <2></2> holds the words saying how it was closed. Keep every tag, in the order your language reads.

page.about.request.description: Heading over the description on a request's page (a request is a filed issue).

page.notSavedYet.text: This change isn’t saved on this phone yet. It will open when you’re back online.
page.notSavedYet.description: A short notice (toast) when someone opens a change's page while Homeroom cannot be reached and the page was never saved on this device. The page opens by itself once the connection is back.

page.notSavedYetThread.text: This page isn’t saved on this phone yet. It will open when you’re back online.
page.notSavedYetThread.description: A short notice (toast) when someone opens a request's or a group decision's page while Homeroom cannot be reached and the page was never saved on this device. The page opens by itself once the connection is back.

page.slowToAnswer.text: Homeroom is taking a while to answer. This page will open when it does.
page.slowToAnswer.description: A short notice (toast) when someone opens a change's, a request's or a group decision's page while the phone is online but Homeroom did not answer in time (a slow connection, or a server error). The page keeps waiting and opens by itself once Homeroom answers.

page.about.change.description: Heading over the description on a change's page (a change is work on the project that is being built, voted on or already live). "Change" is a noun.

page.about.proposal.description: Heading over the description on the page of a proposal to change a project's settings or rules.

page.about.generic.description: Heading over the description on a board item's page when the kind of item is not known.

page.hero.kind.description: Small upper-case word at the top of a change's page saying what kind of page it is. A noun. A status may follow it after a middle dot.

page.hero.status.visibleToGroup.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change is still being built and its owner has shared it with the project's members.

page.hero.status.notShared.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change is still being built and only its owner can see it.

page.hero.status.approvedChecking.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change has the votes its project's rule needs, and Homeroom's own checks are still running on its latest version.

page.hero.status.approvedGithub.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change has the votes its project's rule needs and Homeroom's checks passed, and GitHub's own required checks are still running before it merges.

page.hero.status.approvedFailing.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change has the votes its project's rule needs, but its checks are failing, so it cannot go live until they are fixed.

page.hero.status.merging.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change was approved and is being merged into the project.

page.hero.status.goingLive.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change was merged and the new version of the app is being deployed.

page.hero.status.notLiveYet.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change was merged and the deployment of the new version failed or is stuck.

page.hero.status.live.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change was merged and is part of the running app. An adjective.

page.hero.status.closed.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change was withdrawn or rejected. An adjective describing the change.

page.hero.status.goingLiveIncludedIn.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The new version is being deployed. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change. {{number}} is that change's pull request number.

page.hero.status.goingLiveIncludedInAnot.text: Going live, included in another change
page.hero.status.goingLiveIncludedInAnot.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The new version is being deployed. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change.

page.hero.status.notLiveYetIncludedIn.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The deployment failed or is stuck. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change. {{number}} is that change's pull request number.

page.hero.status.notLiveYetIncludedInAno.text: Not live yet, included in another change
page.hero.status.notLiveYetIncludedInAno.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The deployment failed or is stuck. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change.

page.hero.status.liveIncludedIn.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change is part of the running app. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change. {{number}} is that change's pull request number.

page.hero.status.liveIncludedInAnother.description: Status beside the word "Change" at the top of a change's page. The change is part of the running app. It was not merged on its own: its work went in as part of another change.

page.hero.authorBot.description: Author shown in the by-line under a change's title when the platform's assistant built the change. "Homeroom bot" is the assistant's name.

page.hero.verb.started.description: Lower-case verb in the by-line under a change's title, between the author's name and how long ago, as in "maya · {verb} 5h ago". Past tense. The author began the change and is still building it.

page.hero.verb.imported.description: Lower-case verb in the by-line under a change's title, between the author's name and how long ago, as in "maya · {verb} 5h ago". Past tense. The change was brought in from a pull request on GitHub.

page.hero.verb.made.description: Lower-case verb in the by-line under a change's title, between the author's name and how long ago, as in "maya · {verb} 5h ago". Past tense. Homeroom bot built the change.

page.hero.verb.proposed.description: Lower-case verb in the by-line under a change's title, between the author's name and how long ago, as in "maya · {verb} 5h ago". Past tense. The author put the change up for a vote.

page.hero.provenance.importedBy.description: One fact at the end of the by-line under a change's title, after a middle dot, so it starts in lower case. The change came from a pull request on GitHub; {{author}} is its author's GitHub username.

page.hero.provenance.imported.description: One fact at the end of the by-line under a change's title, after a middle dot, so it starts in lower case. The change came from a pull request on GitHub whose author is not known.

page.hero.provenance.builtWith.description: One fact at the end of the by-line under a change's title, after a middle dot, so it starts in lower case. {{agent}} is the name of the coding agent the change was made with, for example Claude Code.

page.hero.provenance.maintenance.description: One fact at the end of the by-line under a change's title, after a middle dot, so it starts in lower case. The change was made by Homeroom itself to keep the project working, not by a member.

page.includedIn.heading.description: Small heading on the page of a merged change whose work was released inside another change; a link to that other change follows.

page.includedIn.changeLabel.description: Short label on the link to the change that this change went live as part of, used when that change has no pull request number to show. A noun.

page.includedIn.pullRequestTitle.description: Stands in for the title of the change that this change went live as part of, when it has no title. {{number}} is its pull request number on GitHub.

page.includedIn.changeTitle.description: Stands in for the title of the change that this change went live as part of, when it has neither a title nor a pull request number. "Change" is a noun; {{id}} is its number in Homeroom.

page.menu.askForChanges.description: Row in the ⋯ menu of the page of a proposal that Homeroom bot built: opens this person's chat with Homeroom bot to ask it to alter the proposal. "Changes" is a noun: alterations.

page.menu.askForChangesTitle.text: Ask Homeroom bot to change this, in your chat with it
page.menu.askForChangesTitle.description: Tooltip on the Ask for changes row in the ⋯ menu of a proposal's page. "Homeroom bot" is the name of the platform's assistant; "change" is a verb.

page.actions.openApp.description: Button on the page of a change that is live: opens the running app. "Open" is a verb.

page.actions.syncWithMain.description: Button on a person's own change: brings the change up to date with "main", the project's current code. "Sync" is a verb; "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.actions.syncing.description: Label of the Sync with main button on a change's page while the sync is running.

page.actions.retryPreview.description: Button on the Testing card of a change's page when its preview (a running test copy of the app) failed to start: tries to start it again. "Retry" is a verb.

page.actions.submitForReview.description: Main button on a person's own change that is still being built: puts the change up for the group's vote.

page.actions.submitting.description: Label of the Submit for review button on a change's page while the change is being submitted.

page.actions.notReady.text: This change cannot be submitted yet. Try again in a moment.
page.actions.notReady.description: Brief notice shown when a change could not be put up for a vote because the platform was not ready for it. "Change" is a noun.

page.actions.failed.text: The action could not be completed.
page.actions.failed.description: Brief notice shown when syncing a change or submitting it for review failed and the server gave no reason.

page.actions.synced.description: Brief notice shown after a change was brought up to date with "main", the project's current code. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.actions.networkError.description: Brief notice shown when syncing a change or submitting it for review failed because the server could not be reached.

page.menu.details.description: Row in the ⋯ menu of a change's page: opens the technical details of the change.

page.menu.detailsTitle.text: The pull request, its steps and checks, and its description
page.menu.detailsTitle.description: Tooltip on the Details row in the ⋯ menu of a change's page, listing what the details hold.

page.menu.editDescription.description: Row in the ⋯ menu of a person's own change: lets them rewrite the change's description.

page.menu.openOnGitHub.description: Row in the ⋯ menu of a request's page, for a request that is an issue on GitHub: opens the issue on GitHub in a new tab. "Open" is a verb.

page.sample.note.text: This is a display-only sample. To try editing a description, open "[Preview sample] Your editable change" in your sessions.
page.sample.note.description: Note on the page of a made-up sample change on a test build of Homeroom. "[Preview sample] Your editable change" is the title of another sample; keep it as written.

page.summary.missingDescription.text: No short summary has been added yet. The current description is below.
page.summary.missingDescription.description: Shown in place of the summary on the page of a change that has a full description and no short summary or plan; the description is folded under this line.

page.summary.missing.text: No change summary has been added yet.
page.summary.missing.description: Shown in place of the summary on a change that has no summary and no description. "Change" is a noun.

page.discussion.shareFirst.text: Make this change visible to the group to start a discussion. Only you can see the agent workspace here unless you share it. Its code is public.
page.discussion.shareFirst.description: Shown in place of the discussion on a person's own change that they have not shared with the project's members yet. "Change" is a noun.

page.steps.actor.auto.description: The whole text of a small grey note shown in its own element beside a step on a change's page, saying who completes that step: nobody, the platform does it by itself. It is not joined to any other words.

page.steps.actor.author.description: The whole text of a small grey note shown in its own element beside a step on a change's page, saying who completes that step: the person who made the change. It is not joined to any other words.

page.steps.actor.admin.description: The whole text of a small grey note shown in its own element beside a step on a change's page, saying who completes that step: an administrator of the project. It is not joined to any other words.

page.steps.actor.group.description: The whole text of a small grey note shown in its own element beside a step on a change's page, saying who completes that step: the project's members, by voting. It is not joined to any other words.

page.steps.label.yourApproval.description: Name of the voting step on a change's page in a project where this person's approval alone decides.

page.steps.label.vote.description: Name of the voting step on a change's page. A noun: the group's vote on the change.

page.steps.headline.goingLive.description: Headline over the steps on the page of a change that was merged while the new version of the app is still being deployed.

page.steps.headline.releaseBlocked.description: Headline over the steps on the page of a change that was merged, but whose automatic release failed one of its steps (for example a security check), so it is not live and will not be until that is fixed.

page.steps.headline.live.description: Headline over the steps on the page of a merged change that is part of the running app. An adjective.

page.steps.headline.liveIncludedIn.description: Headline over the steps on the page of a change that is part of the running app because its work went in as part of another change. {{number}} is that change's pull request number.

page.steps.headline.liveIncludedInAnothe.description: Headline over the steps on the page of a change that is part of the running app because its work went in as part of another change whose number is not known.

page.steps.headline.standing.description: Headline over the steps on a change's page when there is no summary of what it still needs. "It" is the change.

page.draft.gate.review.description: Name of a step in the list of what a change still needs before it goes live, on the page of a change that is still being built. This step is done once the author puts the change up for a vote.

page.draft.gate.reviewDetail.description: Short line under the headline "Nothing needs you" on the page of a change that has not been put up for a vote, naming the step that is under way or that Homeroom does on its own: the step "Submitted for review". Shown alone on its own line; lower case in English.

page.draft.gate.approvals.description: Name of a step in the list of what a change still needs before it goes live, on the page of a change that is still being built. The group's votes on the change. A noun.

page.draft.gate.integration.description: Name of a step in the list of what a change still needs before it goes live, on the page of a change that is still being built. The change's code fits together with "main", the project's current code; "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.draft.gate.integrationDetail.description: Short line under the headline "Nothing needs you" on the page of a change that has not been put up for a vote, naming the step that is under way or that Homeroom does on its own: the step "No conflicts with main". Shown alone on its own line; lower case in English.

page.draft.gate.checks.description: Name of a step in the list of what a change still needs before it goes live, on the page of a change that is still being built. The automated tests run on the change. A noun.

page.draft.gate.checksDetail.description: Short line under the headline "Nothing needs you" on the page of a change that has not been put up for a vote, naming the step that is under way or that Homeroom does on its own: the step "Checks". Shown alone on its own line; lower case in English.

page.draft.gate.github.description: Name of a step in the list of what a change still needs before it goes live, on the page of a change that is still being built. The change is combined into the project's code. A noun.

page.draft.gate.githubDetail.description: Short line under the headline "Nothing needs you" on the page of a change that has not been put up for a vote, naming the step that is under way or that Homeroom does on its own: the step "Merge". Shown alone on its own line; lower case in English.

page.draft.line.submitting.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "Submitted for review" while the change is being put up for a vote.

page.draft.line.notSubmitted.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "Submitted for review", for someone other than the author.

page.draft.line.conflictFiles_one.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "No conflicts with main": the change and the project's current code alter the same lines. {{count}} is the number of files affected.

page.draft.line.conflictFiles_other.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "No conflicts with main": the change and the project's current code alter the same lines. {{count}} is the number of files affected.

page.draft.line.conflict.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "No conflicts with main" when the change clashes with the project's current code and the files are not known. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.draft.line.notMeasured.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "No conflicts with main" when the platform has not checked yet whether the change fits the project's current code.

page.draft.line.checksAfterSync.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "Checks": the automated tests start once the change has been brought up to date with the project's current code.

page.draft.line.checksNotRun.description: Short line under a step on the page of a change that is still being built. Under "Checks" when the automated tests have not been started.

vote.names.loading.description: Shown on the voting step of a change's page while the list of who voted is being fetched.

vote.names.none.description: Shown on the voting step of a change's page when nobody has voted.

vote.names.no.description: Line on the voting step of a change's page when everybody who voted voted against. "No" is the vote; {{names}} is the list of their usernames.

vote.names.yesAndNo.description: Line on the voting step of a change's page listing who voted. {{yes}} is the usernames of those who voted yes, shown without a label; "No" is the vote against and {{no}} the usernames of those who cast it.

vote.button.yes.description: The Yes vote button on a proposal's card. {{tally}} is the number of Yes votes so far, for example "3", or "2✓ +1" where votes from approvers and advisory votes are counted separately.

vote.button.no.description: The No vote button on a proposal's card. {{tally}} is the number of No votes so far, for example "1", or "1✓ +2" where votes from approvers and advisory votes are counted separately.

page.checks.build.built.description: Value shown beside the build on the checks step of a change's page once the preview has been built. Past participle: the app was built.

page.checks.build.building.description: Value shown beside the build on the checks step of a change's page while the preview is being built and the current stage is not known.

page.checks.note.previewDidNotStart.description: Note on the checks step of a change's page when its preview (a running test copy of the app) failed to start. {{error}} is the technical error text, in English.

page.checks.note.broken.text: The staging build or the test run itself broke, so the platform can't confirm the app works.
page.checks.note.broken.description: Note on the checks step of a change's page when the automated tests could not be carried out at all. "Staging build" is the test copy of the app.

page.submission.failing.note.text: Its checks are failing. You can submit it now; it can merge only after a fix passes them.
page.submission.failing.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests fail. "It" is the change.

page.submission.failing.short.text: Ready · checks must pass before it merges
page.submission.failing.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests fail.

page.submission.error.note.text: Its checks could not run. You can submit it now; it can merge only once they run and pass.
page.submission.error.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests could not be run.

page.submission.error.short.text: Ready · checks must run before it merges
page.submission.error.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests could not be run.

page.submission.uploaded.note.text: A commit was uploaded but has not been submitted for checks yet. Ask the agent to submit it first.
page.submission.uploaded.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. A coding agent uploaded code and has not handed it in for testing. "Commit" is a saved revision of the code.

page.submission.uploaded.short.text: The agent has not submitted its commit yet
page.submission.uploaded.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. "Commit" is a saved revision of the code.

page.submission.empty.note.text: There are no committed changes to submit yet. Ask the agent to make a change first.
page.submission.empty.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. Nothing has been saved to the change yet.

page.submission.empty.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. No code has been saved to the change.

page.submission.previewClosed.note.text: Ready to submit for review. Its preview was closed while idle; submitting rebuilds it and runs the checks again.
page.submission.previewClosed.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The tests passed and the preview has since been shut down.

page.submission.previewClosed.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The preview has been shut down and will be rebuilt.

page.submission.ready.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The tests passed.

page.submission.ready.short.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote, when nothing stands in the way. An adjective describing the change.

page.submission.running.note.text: You can submit it now. Its checks keep running, and it can merge only once they pass.
page.submission.running.note.description: Note and tooltip on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests are still running.

page.submission.running.shortDeferred.text: Ready · checks run after the sync
page.submission.running.shortDeferred.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The tests start once the change is brought up to date with the project's current code.

page.submission.running.shortRunning.description: Short line under the "Submitted for review" step on a person's own change that is still being built, about putting it up for a vote. The automated tests have not finished.

page.ledger.preview.label.description: Label of the row about the change's preview (a running test copy of the app) in the list of facts under Details on a change's page. A noun.

page.ledger.preview.failed.text: <0>Failed.</0> The submitted preview did not start.
page.ledger.preview.failed.description: Text of the Preview row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when the preview failed to start and no reason is known. <0></0> draws the verdict bold and red.

page.ledger.preview.failedWith.text: <0>Failed.</0> The submitted preview did not start: {{error}}
page.ledger.preview.failedWith.description: Text of the Preview row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when the preview failed to start. <0></0> draws the verdict bold and red; {{error}} is the technical error text, in English.

page.ledger.checks.label.description: Label of the row about the automated tests in the list of facts under Details on a change's page. A noun.

page.ledger.checks.none.text: No check results have been recorded yet.
page.ledger.checks.none.description: Text of the Checks row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when no automated test has reported a result.

page.ledger.checks.failing.text: <0>Failing.</0> Required checks need attention before this change can merge.
page.ledger.checks.failing.description: Text of the Checks row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page on a change still being built whose automated tests fail. <0></0> draws the verdict bold and red.

page.ledger.main.label.description: Label of the row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page that says how the change compares with "main", the project's current code. "Main" is the name of the code branch.

page.ledger.main.behind_one.description: Text of the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page: the project's current code has moved on since the change was started. {{count}} is how many commits (saved revisions) it is behind; "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.ledger.main.behind_other.description: Text of the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page: the project's current code has moved on since the change was started. {{count}} is how many commits (saved revisions) it is behind; "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.ledger.main.upToDate.description: Text of the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when the change is based on the project's current code. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.ledger.main.unverified.text: Main freshness has not been verified yet.
page.ledger.main.unverified.description: Text of the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when the platform has not checked yet whether the change is based on the project's current code.

page.ledger.main.movedAhead.description: Text of the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page when the project's current code has changed since the change was started and the number of commits is not known.

page.ledger.main.forkNote.text: The author must update this branch in their fork, then push the changes.
page.ledger.main.forkNote.description: Smaller note under the Main row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page on a change whose code lives in the author's own copy (fork) of the repository, so Homeroom cannot update it. "Push" is the git verb.

page.ledger.votes.label.description: Label of the row about the group's votes in the list of facts under Details on a change's page. A noun.

page.ledger.review.label.description: Label of the row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page, on a change still being built, that says whether it can be put up for a vote. A noun.

page.ledger.review.submitting.description: Text of the Review row in the list of facts under Details on a change's page while the change is being put up for a vote.

feed.loadFailed.text: Couldn't load the feed right now.
feed.loadFailed.description: Shown in place of a project's board when its items could not be fetched and nothing was loaded before.

feed.comment.earlier_one.description: Line above the newest replies shown under a request's card in the feed, saying how many older replies are not shown. {{count}} is that number.

feed.comment.earlier_other.description: Line above the newest replies shown under a request's card in the feed, saying how many older replies are not shown. {{count}} is that number.

feed.comment.unknownAuthor.description: Shown in place of the author's name on a reply under a request's card when the reply has no known author. Lower case, as a name would sit there.

feed.comment.botTag.description: Small tag after the author's name on a reply under a request's card, marking that an automated account wrote the reply, not a person.

feed.comment.specTitled.description: Line at the end of a reply the Homeroom bot wrote under a request, naming the written plan it attached. {{title}} is that plan's title.

feed.comment.spec.description: Line at the end of a reply the Homeroom bot wrote under a request, saying it attached a written plan that has no title.

feed.comment.showMore.description: Button under a long reply on a request's card in the feed that is cut off after a few lines: shows the whole reply.

feed.comment.showLess.description: Button under a long reply on a request's card in the feed after it was expanded: cuts it back to a few lines.

visuals.fallbackClaim.description: Stands in for the description of a visible change in the before/after screenshots of a change, when the author gave none. It names the pair of screenshots.

explore.title.text: Open your thread with Homeroom bot about this change
explore.title.description: Tooltip on the Explore in a coding agent button of a proposal: it opens the viewer's own conversation with Homeroom bot about that change. "Open" is a verb; "change" is a noun. Homeroom bot is the name of Homeroom's building assistant.

workshop.category.fallbackName.description: Stands in for a category's name on the Workshop board when the category a filter names is no longer in the list, for example in the filter chip "Category: Category". A noun: a group of related requests and changes.

workshop.weeks.thisWeek.description: Heading of the newest card in the Workshop's week-by-week summary of a project: the card that says what has happened in the current calendar week.

workshop.lane.review.description: Heading of a group of cards inside one category on a project's Workshop tab: the changes that have been put up for a vote and are not approved yet.

workshop.lane.underway.description: Heading of a group of cards inside one category on a project's Workshop tab: requests and changes somebody is working on now.

workshop.lane.open.description: Heading of a group of cards inside one category on a project's Workshop tab: requests nobody has started on. An adjective describing the requests, not the verb.

workshop.lane.shipped.description: Heading of a group of cards inside one category on a project's Workshop tab: the changes that were merged and went live during the last seven days.

workshop.ungrouped.name.description: Name of the last group on the Workshop tab's "By category" view, holding the cards that none of the automatically drafted categories includes yet.

workshop.ungrouped.description.text: Items the categories do not name yet.
workshop.ungrouped.description.description: Line under the "Not yet grouped" heading on the Workshop tab, explaining that the cards below are the ones no category lists yet.

workshop.ungrouped.everything.description: Name of the only group on the Workshop tab's "By category" view when no categories have been drafted for the project yet, so every card is listed together.

workshop.ungrouped.placingName.description: Name of the last group on the Workshop tab's "By category" view when every card in it is new and is being sorted into a category automatically right now.

workshop.ungrouped.placingDescription.text: New cards are placed into a category within a minute or two of arriving.
workshop.ungrouped.placingDescription.description: Line under the "Being placed" heading on the Workshop tab, telling the reader the cards below will move into a category shortly without anyone doing anything.

workshop.ungrouped.somePlacing_one.text: Cards the categories do not cover yet; {{count}} of them is being placed now. They count towards the next re-draft.
workshop.ungrouped.somePlacing_one.description: Line under the "Not yet grouped" heading on the Workshop tab when some of its cards are being sorted into a category automatically right now. {{count}} is how many of them. "Re-draft" is the next time the categories themselves are rewritten automatically.

workshop.ungrouped.somePlacing_other.text: Cards the categories do not cover yet; {{count}} of them are being placed now. They count towards the next re-draft.
workshop.ungrouped.somePlacing_other.description: Line under the "Not yet grouped" heading on the Workshop tab when some of its cards are being sorted into a category automatically right now. {{count}} is how many of them. "Re-draft" is the next time the categories themselves are rewritten automatically.

workshop.ungrouped.notCovered.text: Cards the categories do not cover yet. They count towards the next re-draft of the categories.
workshop.ungrouped.notCovered.description: Line under the "Not yet grouped" heading on the Workshop tab when none of its cards is being sorted right now. "Re-draft" is the next time the categories are rewritten automatically.

workshop.queue.voteAsk.description: The question shown above the Yes and No buttons on a "Needs you" card for a proposal the viewer has not voted on. "Go in" means be merged into the project.

workshop.row.tag.checksPassed.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change: all of its automatic checks have passed.

workshop.row.tag.live.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change that was approved and is now part of the running project. An adjective.

workshop.row.tag.waitingForVotes.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a request: a change made for it is up for a vote.

workshop.row.tag.beingWorkedOn.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a request: somebody's change for it is being built right now.

workshop.row.tag.started.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a request: work on it was begun and is not running at the moment. A past participle describing the request.

workshop.row.tag.pickedUp.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a request: somebody has taken it on and has not started building yet.

workshop.row.tag.changeBeingWorkedOn.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change that is still being made: its agent is working right now.

workshop.row.tag.changeStarted.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change that is still being made: it was begun and nothing is running on it at the moment. A past participle describing the change.

workshop.row.tag.previewReady.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change that is still being made, beside an eye glyph: a preview build of it can be opened and tried.

workshop.row.tag.previewReadyVote.description: Small status tag on a row in the lists of a project's Workshop tab (Your work, Since your last visit and a week's page). On a change that is up for a vote, beside an eye glyph: a preview build of it can be opened and tried before voting.

countdown.daysHours.description: Short countdown on a proposal's card showing roughly how long until its voting window ends, for example "~2d 5h". {{days}} and {{hours}} are numbers; "d" and "h" abbreviate days and hours. Keep the leading "~" (about).

countdown.days.description: Short countdown on a proposal's card showing roughly how many whole days until its voting window ends, for example "~2d". "d" abbreviates days. Keep the leading "~" (about). {{days}} is the number of days.

countdown.hoursMinutes.description: Short countdown on a proposal's card showing roughly how long until its voting window ends, for example "~3h 20m". "h" and "m" abbreviate hours and minutes. Keep the leading "~" (about). {{hours}} and {{minutes}} are the numbers of hours and minutes.

countdown.hours.description: Short countdown on a proposal's card showing roughly how many whole hours until its voting window ends, for example "~3h". "h" abbreviates hours. Keep the leading "~" (about). {{hours}} is the number of hours.

countdown.minutes.description: Short countdown on a proposal's card showing roughly how many minutes until its voting window ends, for example "~12m". "m" abbreviates minutes. Keep the leading "~" (about). {{minutes}} is the number of minutes.

session.fallbackTitle.description: Title shown on the card of a change in progress when it has no title, pull request title or branch name. {{id}} is its number. A "session" is one change being worked on.

session.prFallbackTitle.description: Stands in for an imported pull request's title, in the dialog that asks whether to archive it, when the pull request has no title. {{number}} is its number on GitHub. "PR" abbreviates pull request.

session.venueTitle.description: Tooltip of the chip on the card of a change in progress that says where it is being built. {{venue}} is the name of that place and {{blurb}} a short sentence describing it.

session.failing.names.description: Line on the viewer's own card for a change in progress naming the automated checks that are failing. {{checks}} is one or two check names.

session.failing.namesAndMore_one.description: Line on the viewer's own card for a change in progress naming the automated checks that are failing. {{checks}} is the first two check names and {{count}} how many more are failing.

session.failing.namesAndMore_other.description: Line on the viewer's own card for a change in progress naming the automated checks that are failing. {{checks}} is the first two check names and {{count}} how many more are failing.

session.failing.reason.description: One line of the tooltip on a session card's "Failing: …" text. {{check}} is the name of a failing automated check and {{reason}} why it failed.

session.failing.reasonAdvisory.description: One line of the tooltip on a session card's "Failing: …" text, for a check that is advisory: it failed but does not block the merge. {{check}} is the check's name and {{reason}} why it failed.

session.chip.working.description: Status chip with a spinner on the card of a change in progress while the AI agent is busy building it.

session.chip.importedPr.description: Chip on a session card marking that the change was imported from an existing GitHub pull request, not built in Homeroom. "PR" abbreviates pull request.

session.menu.archivePr.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of an imported pull request's card: closes the pull request on GitHub and archives its card. "Archive" is a verb.

session.menu.archivePrTitle.text: Close this imported pull request and archive its card
session.menu.archivePrTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Archive PR" item in the ⋯ menu of an imported pull request's card.

session.menu.viewPr.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the card of a change in progress, when its pull request is on GitHub: opens it on GitHub in a new tab.

session.menu.viewCode.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the card of a change in progress, when its code is on Homeroom's own git host rather than GitHub: opens that code in a new tab. "View" is a verb.

session.menu.openDiscussion.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress: opens the public discussion thread about that change. "Open" is a verb.

session.menu.openDiscussionCount_one.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress: opens the public discussion thread about that change. {{count}} is how many messages it has. "Open" is a verb.

session.menu.openDiscussionCount_other.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress: opens the public discussion thread about that change. {{count}} is how many messages it has. "Open" is a verb.

session.menu.openDiscussionTitle.text: Open the public discussion on this session
session.menu.openDiscussionTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Open public discussion" item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress.

session.menu.viewChecks.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the card of a change in progress: opens the results of the automated checks that ran on it.

session.menu.rerunChecks.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the card of a change in progress: runs its automated checks again.

session.menu.archive.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress: archives the change. A verb.

session.menu.archiveTitle.text: Archive this session (closes the PR, frees the slot)
session.menu.archiveTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Archive" item in the ⋯ menu of the viewer's own card for a change in progress. "The slot" is one of the limited number of changes a person may have in progress at once. "PR" abbreviates pull request.

session.mine.importedBy.text: Imported by {{author}} · not waiting for approval yet
session.mine.importedBy.description: Line under the title of the viewer's own card for an imported pull request that has not been put up for a vote. {{author}} is the GitHub name of the pull request's author.

session.mine.importedByUnknown.text: Imported by unknown author · not waiting for approval yet
session.mine.importedByUnknown.description: Line under the title of the viewer's own card for an imported pull request that has not been put up for a vote, when the pull request's author is not known.

session.mine.visible.description: Line under the title of the viewer's own card for a change in progress when everyone can see the change but not read its build chat.

session.mine.private.text: Only you can see this here. Its code is public.
session.mine.private.description: Line under the title of the viewer's own card for a change in progress when the change is not shared with the group.

session.mine.workingTitle.description: Tooltip of the viewer's own card for a change in progress while the AI agent is busy. {{title}} is the change's title.

session.actions.askForApproval.description: Button on the viewer's own card for an imported pull request: puts the change up for the group's vote.

session.actions.askForApprovalTitle.text: Ask the group to approve this imported change
session.actions.askForApprovalTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Ask for approval" button on the viewer's own card for an imported pull request.

session.actions.hide.description: Button on the viewer's own card for a change in progress when the change is visible to everyone: makes it private again. A verb.

session.actions.hideTitle.text: Make this session private again (removes it from everyone's In progress area, and stops anyone reading the chat)
session.actions.hideTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Hide" button on the viewer's own card for a change in progress.

session.actions.makeVisible.description: Button on the viewer's own card for a change in progress when only they can see it: shows it to everyone in the project.

session.actions.makeVisibleTitle.text: Show this change in everyone's In progress area, where others can comment and open its live preview
session.actions.makeVisibleTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Make visible" button on the viewer's own card for a change in progress.

session.shared.working.description: Line under the title of another person's card for a change in progress. {{owner}} is that person's account name.

session.shared.workingSomeone.description: Line under the title of another person's card for a change in progress when that person's name is not known. It starts in lower case because a name normally stands there.

session.shared.imported.text: Imported pull request by {{author}} · imported by {{owner}}
session.shared.imported.description: Line under the title of a card for a pull request imported from GitHub. {{author}} is the GitHub name of whoever wrote the pull request and {{owner}} the account name of the person who imported it.

session.shared.importedBySomeone.text: Imported pull request by {{author}} · imported by someone
session.shared.importedBySomeone.description: Line under the title of a card for a pull request imported from GitHub when the importer is not known. {{author}} is the GitHub name of whoever wrote the pull request.

session.shared.importedUnknownAuthor.text: Imported pull request by unknown author · imported by {{owner}}
session.shared.importedUnknownAuthor.description: Line under the title of a card for a pull request imported from GitHub when its author is not known. {{owner}} is the account name of the person who imported it.

session.shared.importedUnknownBoth.text: Imported pull request by unknown author · imported by someone
session.shared.importedUnknownBoth.description: Line under the title of a card for a pull request imported from GitHub when neither its author nor its importer is known.

session.visibility.failedHttp.description: Toast shown when making a change in progress visible to everyone, or hiding it again, was refused by the server without an explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number, for example 500.

session.visibility.failed.description: Toast shown when making a change in progress visible to everyone, or hiding it again, could not be sent. {{error}} is the technical error message.

session.unarchive.failed.description: Toast shown when restoring an archived change failed and the server gave no explanation.

session.unarchive.failedWith.description: Toast shown when restoring an archived change could not be sent. {{error}} is the technical error message.

session.unarchive.restoredTitle.description: Title of the notice shown after an archived change was restored but the AI no longer remembers the earlier conversation.

session.unarchive.restoredMessage.text: Claude's memory had already been cleared, so this picks up as a fresh chat on the same branch.
session.unarchive.restoredMessage.description: Body of the "Session restored" notice. Claude is the name of the AI and stays as it is. "Branch" is the line of code changes the session was working on.

session.archive.confirmTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks the person to confirm archiving a change in progress or an imported pull request. {{title}} is its title. "Archive" is a verb.

session.archive.confirmMessageImported.text: This closes the imported pull request on GitHub and archives its card. The source branch is kept.
session.archive.confirmMessageImported.description: Body of the dialog that asks the person to confirm archiving an imported pull request.

session.archive.confirmMessage.text: This closes the PR and frees the slot. You can Unarchive it later to restore it (chat memory is kept for 30 days).
session.archive.confirmMessage.description: Body of the dialog that asks the person to confirm archiving their change in progress. "The slot" is one of the limited number of changes a person may have in progress. "Unarchive" is the name of the button that restores it. "PR" abbreviates pull request.

session.archive.confirmLabel.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to archive a change in progress or an imported pull request. A verb.

session.archive.failedHttp.description: Toast shown when archiving a change in progress was refused by the server without an explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

session.archive.failedWith.description: Toast shown when archiving a change in progress could not be sent. {{error}} is the technical error message.

archiveUndo.archived_one.description: Bottom notice shown right after a person archives one of their changes in progress on a project's board, with an Undo button beside it. {{title}} is the change's title. {{count}} (1 here) is how many archives can be undone in a row, newest first.

archiveUndo.archived_other.description: Bottom notice shown right after a person archives a change in progress when earlier archives can still be undone too, with an Undo button beside it. {{title}} is the change's title; {{count}} is how many can be undone in a row, newest first, this one included.

archiveUndo.withdrawn_one.description: Bottom notice shown right after a person withdraws their own proposal from the vote, with an Undo button beside it. {{title}} is the proposal's title. {{count}} (1 here) is how many withdrawals or archives can be undone in a row, newest first.

archiveUndo.withdrawn_other.description: Bottom notice shown right after a person withdraws their own proposal when earlier archives or withdrawals can still be undone too, with an Undo button beside it. {{title}} is the proposal's title; {{count}} is how many can be undone in a row, newest first, this one included.

archiveUndo.restored_one.description: Bottom notice shown after Undo brought an archived or withdrawn session back, while earlier ones can still be undone; an Undo button stays beside it. {{title}} is the session's title; {{count}} is how many more can be undone.

archiveUndo.restored_other.description: Bottom notice shown after Undo brought an archived or withdrawn session back, while earlier ones can still be undone; an Undo button stays beside it. {{title}} is the session's title; {{count}} is how many more can be undone.

archiveUndo.restoredLast.description: Bottom notice shown after Undo brought the last archived or withdrawn session back, with nothing left to undo and no button. {{title}} is the session's title.

archiveUndo.undo.description: Button on the bottom notice shown after archiving or withdrawing a change in progress: brings the most recent one back. A verb.

explicit.fallback.sentence.text: This change needs a Yes from another member.
explicit.fallback.sentence.description: Sentence explaining why a proposal that changes a protected setting cannot merge on its own approval: somebody other than its author must vote Yes. "Yes" is the name of the vote button.

explicit.fallback.line.description: Short line under the "A Yes from another member" step of a proposal's list of steps, saying why the step applies. No full stop.

explicit.lead.admins.text: It changes who runs this app.
explicit.lead.admins.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, saying why: it changes the list of people who administer the app.

explicit.lead.governance.text: It changes how changes are approved.
explicit.lead.governance.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, saying why: it changes the rule for how changes are approved.

explicit.lead.visibility.text: It changes who can see this app.
explicit.lead.visibility.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, saying why: it changes who is allowed to see the app.

explicit.lead.platformEnv.text: It changes this app’s platform settings.
explicit.lead.platformEnv.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, saying why: it changes the settings the platform holds for the app.

explicit.lead.secrets.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, saying why: it changes the app's secret keys.

explicit.lead.changesProtected.description: First sentence of the tooltip and note on a proposal that needs explicit approval, when which setting it changes is not known.

explicit.lockTitle.text: {{reason}} It won’t merge on a timer: it needs real Yes votes to reach the app’s normal threshold, and it can still be voted down.
explicit.lockTitle.description: Tooltip of the lock mark on a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{reason}} is a whole sentence saying why, for example "It changes who can vote." "On a timer" refers to proposals normally being approved automatically when a waiting period ends.

explicit.note.full.text: {{reason}} It won't merge on a timer. {{votes}} It can still be voted down, and it still closes on the usual schedule if nobody engages.
explicit.note.full.description: Note on the page of a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{reason}} is a whole sentence saying why, and {{votes}} a whole sentence saying how many Yes votes it has and needs.

explicit.note.hasVotesNoMember.text: It has the Yes votes it needs ({{yes}} of {{required}}), but none of them is from another member yet.
explicit.note.hasVotesNoMember.description: Sentence inside the note on a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes it has and {{required}} the number it needs. "Another member" is anyone other than the author.

explicit.note.hasVotes.text: It has the Yes votes it needs ({{yes}} of {{required}}) and will merge as soon as the usual checks and conflict gates clear.
explicit.note.hasVotes.description: Sentence inside the note on a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes it has and {{required}} the number it needs. "Gates" are the remaining automatic conditions before a merge.

explicit.note.needsVotes_one.text: It needs {{count}} real Yes vote and has {{yes}} so far.
explicit.note.needsVotes_one.description: Sentence inside the note on a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{count}} is the number of Yes votes it needs and {{yes}} the number it has.

explicit.note.needsVotes_other.text: It needs {{count}} real Yes votes and has {{yes}} so far.
explicit.note.needsVotes_other.description: Sentence inside the note on a proposal that needs explicit approval. {{count}} is the number of Yes votes it needs and {{yes}} the number it has.

explicit.adminMerge.plain.text: Admin: merge this PR right now, bypassing the vote majority
explicit.adminMerge.plain.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in a proposal's ⋯ menu, shown to administrators only. "PR" abbreviates pull request.

explicit.adminMerge.admins.text: Admin: merge this change to who runs this app right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.admins.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting: the list of people who administer the app. Shown to administrators only.

explicit.adminMerge.governance.text: Admin: merge this change to how changes are approved right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.governance.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting: the rule for how changes are approved. Shown to administrators only.

explicit.adminMerge.visibility.text: Admin: merge this change to who can see this app right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.visibility.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting: who is allowed to see the app. Shown to administrators only.

explicit.adminMerge.platformEnv.text: Admin: merge this change to this app’s platform settings right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.platformEnv.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting: the settings the platform holds for the app. Shown to administrators only.

explicit.adminMerge.secrets.text: Admin: merge this change to this app’s keys right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.secrets.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting: the app's secret keys. Shown to administrators only.

explicit.adminMerge.protected.text: Admin: merge this change to a protected setting right now, without the vote or another member’s Yes
explicit.adminMerge.protected.description: Tooltip of the "Admin merge" item in the ⋯ menu of a proposal that changes a protected setting, when which setting is not known.

step.adminYes.text: Needs one admin to vote yes
step.adminYes.description: Line under the "Admin approval" step in a proposal's list of steps, while no administrator has voted Yes yet.

hold.pill.description: Short status label on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it.

hold.pillOther.description: Short status label on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it, when the change's author is an administrator and so a different administrator has to approve it.

hold.title.text: This change needs an admin’s approval
hold.title.description: Heading of the warning on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it. The reasons are listed under it.

hold.titleOther.text: This change needs another admin’s approval
hold.titleOther.description: Heading of the warning on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it, when the change's author is an administrator and so a different administrator has to approve it.

hold.asked.text: An admin has been asked. Votes still count.
hold.asked.description: Last line of the warning on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it: the administrators were notified, and members can keep voting meanwhile.

hold.willAsk.text: An admin is asked once it is up for a vote.
hold.willAsk.description: Last line of the warning on a proposed change's card and page, in the warning shown while the change is held until a platform administrator approves it, before the change has been proposed to the group: administrators are notified when it is.

hold.step.text: Held until an admin votes yes.
hold.step.description: Line under the "Admin approval" step in a proposal's list of steps, while the change is held and no administrator has voted Yes. One or more reason sentences follow it.

hold.stepOther.text: Held until another admin votes yes.
hold.stepOther.description: Line under the "Admin approval" step in a proposal's list of steps, while the change is held and its author is an administrator, so a different administrator has to vote Yes. One or more reason sentences follow it.

hold.rule.wallet.text: It lets the app send tokens.
hold.rule.wallet.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change makes the app able to send the person's tokens from their wallet.

hold.rule.people.text: It starts keeping data about people.
hold.rule.people.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change makes the app store information about the people who use it.

hold.rule.secret.text: It adds a private key for an outside service.
hold.rule.secret.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change declares a secret key the app uses to reach a service outside Homeroom.

hold.rule.capability.text: It asks for a device capability such as location.
hold.rule.capability.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change makes the app ask for access to something on the person's device, like their location, camera or microphone.

hold.rule.script.text: It loads a script from another site.
hold.rule.script.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change makes the app load code from a website other than Homeroom.

hold.rule.content.text: The Content rules check flagged it.
hold.rule.content.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: Homeroom's automatic review found something that may break the platform's content or data rules. Content rules is the name of that check.

hold.rule.unread.text: It could not be read in full.
hold.rule.unread.description: One reason a proposed change is held for an administrator's approval: the change was too large, or could not be loaded, for Homeroom's automatic reading of it, so a person has to look.

step.shots.failed.description: Line under the "Before & after screenshots" step in a proposal's list of steps when the automatic before-and-after screenshots could not be taken.

step.shots.taking.description: Line under the "Before & after screenshots" step in a proposal's list of steps while the automatic before-and-after screenshots are being taken.

step.env.needsValues.description: Line under the "Platform variables" step in a proposal's list of steps when the change needs configuration values that an administrator has not set, and their names are not known.

step.env.setOne.description: Line under the "Platform variables" step in a proposal's list of steps, telling an administrator which configuration value to set. {{name}} is the variable's name, for example STRIPE_KEY. "Set" is an imperative verb.

step.env.setMany.description: Line under the "Platform variables" step in a proposal's list of steps, telling an administrator which configuration values to set. {{names}} is a comma-separated list of variable names and {{last}} the final one. "Set" is an imperative verb.

step.main.passThrough.text: Red, but this change can merge
step.main.passThrough.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps. "Red" means the tests on the project's main branch are failing; this change is allowed to merge anyway.

step.main.confirming.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps while a test failure on the main branch is being run again to confirm it.

step.main.red.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps: the tests on the project's main branch are failing, so merges are paused.

step.main.redSince.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps: the tests on the main branch are failing. {{sha}} is the short code of the version where they started failing.

step.main.redTest.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps: the tests on the main branch are failing. {{test}} is the name of the failing test.

step.main.redSinceTest.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps: the tests on the main branch are failing. {{sha}} is the short code of the version where they started failing and {{test}} the name of the failing test.

step.main.checking.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps while the tests are running on the most recent merge.

step.main.resumed.description: Line under the "Main is healthy" step in a proposal's list of steps: the tests on the main branch are failing, but an administrator has allowed merges to continue.

step.github.resolving.description: Line under the "Merge" step in a proposal's list of steps when GitHub refused to merge the change and Homeroom is fixing the cause automatically.

step.github.manualSync.text: GitHub refused · needs a manual sync
step.github.manualSync.description: Line under the "Merge" step in a proposal's list of steps when GitHub refused to merge the change and a person has to bring it up to date with main by hand.

step.integration.clean.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps when Homeroom's own merge check found that the change does not conflict with the main branch.

step.integration.measuring.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps while Homeroom has not yet checked whether this version of the change conflicts with the main branch.

step.integration.withAge.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps, adding how long ago Homeroom checked. {{line}} is the finding, such as "No conflicts" or a conflict, and {{measured}} is a phrase such as "measured 2 minutes ago".

step.integration.resolvingFiles_one.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps while a conflict with the main branch is being resolved automatically. {{count}} is how many files conflict.

step.integration.resolvingFiles_other.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps while a conflict with the main branch is being resolved automatically. {{count}} is how many files conflict.

step.integration.resolvingMain.description: Line under the "No conflicts with main" step in a proposal's list of steps while a conflict with the main branch is being resolved automatically and the number of files is not known.

step.checks.afterSync.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps: the automated checks will run once the change has been brought up to date with the main branch.

step.checks.skipped.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps when the automated checks were not needed and did not run.

step.checks.passed.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps when the automated checks passed and no count is available.

step.checks.passedOlder.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps when the automated checks passed, but against an earlier version of the main branch.

step.checks.somePassed_one.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps. {{passed}} is how many automated checks passed and {{count}} how many ran.

step.checks.somePassed_other.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps. {{passed}} is how many automated checks passed and {{count}} how many ran.

step.checks.somePassedOlder_one.text: {{passed}} of {{count}} passed · on an older main
step.checks.somePassedOlder_one.description: Line under the "Checks" step in a proposal's list of steps, when the checks ran against an earlier version of the main branch. {{passed}} is how many automated checks passed and {{count}} how many ran.
