workshop.row.tag.stateWhoMore_one.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, who is doing it, and how many other people are too, for example "Being worked on · zura +1". {{state}} is the state's own tag, {{who}} a username and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateWhoMore_other.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, who is doing it, and how many other people are too, for example "Being worked on · zura +2". {{state}} is the state's own tag, {{who}} a username and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateYou.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer, for example "Started · you". {{state}} is the state's own tag ("Picked up", "Being worked on", "Started", "Waiting for votes"). "you" is lower case in English because it follows the dot.

workshop.row.tag.stateYouMore_one.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer and other people, for example "Being worked on · you +1". {{state}} is the state's own tag and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateYouMore_other.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer and other people, for example "Being worked on · you +2". {{state}} is the state's own tag and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.onlyYou.description: Small status tag, beside a lock, on the row of the viewer's own change in a project's Workshop lists and All items board when nobody else can see it yet.

workshop.row.tag.specDraft.description: Small status tag, beside a lock, on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board when the viewer has a private draft change for it that nobody else can see yet. "Spec" is the written plan of the change.

badge.tag.checks.description: Status tag, beside a spinner and a progress bar, on a proposal's card and its row while its automated checks run; the bar shows how far they are.

chips.checks.label.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card, beside a spinner and a progress bar, while its automated checks run; the bar shows how far they are.

chips.checks.progress.of_one.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are: the accessible name of the progress bar inside its checks chip, and the start of the chip's tooltip. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progress.of_other.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are: the accessible name of the progress bar inside its checks chip, and the start of the chip's tooltip. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all.

chips.checks.progress.soFar_one.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are while their total is not known yet: the accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside its checks chip. {{count}} is how many have finished. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progress.soFar_other.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are while their total is not known yet: the accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside its checks chip. {{count}} is how many have finished.

chips.checks.progress.starting.description: The accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside a proposal's checks chip before any check has finished: the preview is being built and the checks are about to run.

chips.checks.progressTitle.of_one.text: {{done}} of {{count}} checks done. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.of_one.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progressTitle.of_other.text: {{done}} of {{count}} checks done. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.of_other.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_one.text: {{count}} checks done so far. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_one.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run and their total is not known yet. {{count}} is how many have finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_other.text: {{count}} checks done so far. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_other.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run and their total is not known yet. {{count}} is how many have finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

chips.checks.progressTitle.starting.text: Checks starting. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.starting.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip before any of its automated checks has finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

shots.noticed.title.description: Small heading on a change's before & after screenshots, over problems the automated screenshot agent saw on the after build that are not part of the change; also that list's accessible name.

shots.noticed.change.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: which of the change's declared changes it was seen while showing. {{number}} is that change's place in the list (1, 2, 3).

shots.noticed.alsoBefore.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: the same problem shows on the version before the change, so the change did not cause it.

shots.noticed.notBefore.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: the problem does not show on the version before the change.

page.steps.detail.release.description: Second line under "Going live" at the top of a merged change's page, for a change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

workshop.row.tag.releaseTitle.description: Tooltip on a Workshop row's "Going live" tag, for a merged change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it. Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

badge.pill.releaseTitle.description: Tooltip on a change card's "Going live" pill, for a merged change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it. Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

vote.forceMerge.queued.text: Admin merge queued. It merges once main's checks of the last merge and any conflict with main are through.
vote.forceMerge.queued.description: Notice an administrator sees right after confirming Admin merge on a change: the merge is waiting its turn, not done yet. "main" is the repository's main branch.

vote.forceMerge.alreadyQueued.text: An admin merge is already queued for this change.
vote.forceMerge.alreadyQueued.description: Notice when an administrator picks Admin merge on a change that already has one waiting its turn. Nothing new is sent.

step.force.skipped.description: Line under a step of a change's merge checklist when an administrator's Admin merge skips that step, such as the vote or the checks.

step.force.headline.main.text: Merging… waiting for main's checks of the last merge
step.force.headline.main.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge waits for the repository's main branch to finish checking the last change merged into it.

step.force.headline.conflict.text: Merging… resolving a conflict with main
step.force.headline.conflict.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge waits for the platform to resolve a conflict between the change and the repository's main branch.

step.force.headline.merging.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge is being carried out.

step.force.headline.stopped.description: Headline of a change's merge steps when an administrator's Admin merge cannot go ahead; the step it stopped on says why.

page.votes.figure.adminMerge.description: The Votes card's figure on a change where an administrator used Admin merge: the vote is not being counted, so it is not asking anyone for a yes.

page.votes.note.adminMerge.text: {{by}} used Admin merge on {{head}}, so this change does not wait for votes.
page.votes.note.adminMerge.description: Note under the Votes card when an administrator's Admin merge is waiting. {{by}} is the administrator's username and {{head}} is the first seven characters of the commit identifier.

page.votes.note.adminMergeDropped.text: {{by}}'s admin merge was for an earlier commit ({{head}}). This version waits for its vote again.
page.votes.note.adminMergeDropped.description: Note under the Votes card after the author pushed new code, which ends an administrator's earlier Admin merge. {{by}} is the administrator's username and {{head}} is the first seven characters of the earlier commit's identifier.

page.votes.note.adminMergeNoHead.text: {{by}} used Admin merge, so this change does not wait for votes.
page.votes.note.adminMergeNoHead.description: Note under the Votes card when an administrator's Admin merge is waiting but the commit it applies to was not recorded. {{by}} is the administrator's username.

page.votes.note.adminMergeDroppedNoHead.text: {{by}}'s admin merge was for an earlier commit. This version waits for its vote again.
page.votes.note.adminMergeDroppedNoHead.description: Note under the Votes card after the author pushed new code, ending an administrator's earlier Admin merge whose commit was not recorded. {{by}} is the administrator's username.

page.votes.note.adminMergeNoName.description: Stands in for an administrator's username under the Votes card when it was not recorded.

governance.menu.copyLink.description: Row in the ⋯ menu on a governance vote's page: copies the address of the page to the clipboard.

governance.menu.copyLinkDone.description: Brief notice after pressing Copy link on a governance vote's page: the link is on the clipboard.

track.plan.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.build.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.checks.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.vote.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.live.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

group.mention.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside Homeroom's assistant in the list of people offered while typing @ in a chat message. Short for artificial intelligence; it marks the entry as not a person.

group.mention.you.description: Small tag beside the person's own username in the list of people offered while typing @ in a chat message. Lower case, it follows the username.

group.emojiMenu.heading.description: Heading of the list of emoji offered while typing a shortcode such as :smile in a chat message. {{query}} is what the person typed so far, with its leading colon, for example :smi. Keep the <0> tags around it.

group.emojiMenu.label.description: Accessible name of the list of emoji offered while typing a shortcode in a chat message.

group.composer.replyingTo.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to an earlier message. {{name}} is whose message it is: an @username, or a label such as a proposal's name. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToPr.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a line about a pull request. PR is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number. Do not put a # before the number: a change's number is written PR, never #.

group.composer.replyingToPrUnnumbered.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a line about a pull request whose number is not known.

group.composer.cancelReply.description: Accessible name of the ✕ button beside the 'Replying to' line above the chat message box: the message stops being a reply.

group.composer.attachFiles.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the paperclip button beside the chat message box: opens the file chooser to add files to the message.

group.composer.send.description: Label, tooltip and accessible name of the button that sends the chat message the person typed. Send is a verb.

group.composer.page.attachFiles.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the + button beside the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page: opens the file chooser to add files to the reply.

group.composer.page.reply.description: Accessible name of the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page, where the person writes a reply to it. A noun: the reply being written.

group.composer.page.send.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the round arrow button beside the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page: sends the reply the person typed. A verb.

group.composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of a community's channel.

group.readOnly.devSpace.text: You’re viewing this app’s dev space read-only. Only collaborators can post.
group.readOnly.devSpace.description: Notice in place of the message box in a project's channel when the person may read it but not write. 'Dev space' is the project's area for building; 'post' is a verb, to send a message.

group.specPanel.resize.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the chat and the side panel that shows a plan (the written description of a change).

group.postedVia.title.text: Posted by a coding agent on this person's behalf
group.postedVia.title.description: Tooltip of the 'via agent' chip beside a message's author: the message was sent by that person's AI coding agent, not typed by them. Posted is a verb form, to post a message.

group.postedVia.chip.description: Small chip beside a message's author when the person's AI coding agent sent the message for them. Lower case; it follows the author's name.

group.quiet.change.nobody.text: Nobody has commented on this change yet
group.quiet.change.nobody.description: Heading of the card shown in the empty discussion of a proposed change that has never had a comment. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to a project.

group.quiet.change.lately.text: It has been quiet on this change lately
group.quiet.change.lately.description: Heading of the card shown in the discussion of a proposed change when there are no recent comments to show. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to a project.

group.quiet.app.nobody.text: Nobody has said anything here yet
group.quiet.app.nobody.description: Heading of the card shown in a project's channel that has never had a message.

group.quiet.app.lately.text: It has been quiet in here lately
group.quiet.app.lately.description: Heading of the card shown in a project's channel when there are no recent messages to show.

group.quiet.change.invite.text: 👋 Ask a question, or say what you think of it.
group.quiet.change.invite.description: Line under the heading of the empty-discussion card of a proposed change, for a person who may comment. 'It' is the change. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.change.readOnly.text: Comments from the group will show up here.
group.quiet.change.readOnly.description: Line under the heading of the empty-discussion card of a proposed change, for a person who may read but not comment. 'The group' is the project's community.

group.quiet.app.invite.text: 👋 Say hi, ask a question, or share what you would like to see next in {{app}}.
group.quiet.app.invite.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project, for a person who may write. {{app}} is the project's name. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.app.readOnly.text: Messages from the people building {{app}} will show up here.
group.quiet.app.readOnly.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project, for a person who may read but not write. {{app}} is the project's name.

group.reactionBar.moreEmoji.description: Accessible name of the ＋ button on the reaction bar that appears on a touched chat message: opens the full grid of emoji to react with.

group.reactionBar.edit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button on the reaction bar that appears on the person's own chat message on a touch screen: starts editing that message.

group.reactionBar.report.description: Button on the reaction bar that appears on someone else's chat message: reports the message to the moderators. Report is a verb.

group.starters.label.description: Accessible name of the row of suggested first messages above the message box of a channel the person has not written in yet.

group.starters.hi.description: Suggested first message above a channel's message box. Tapping it puts exactly this text in the message box; it is not sent until the person sends it. Keep the waving hand.

group.starters.loveIt.description: Suggested first message above a channel's message box. Tapping it puts exactly this text in the message box. 'It' is the project the channel belongs to.

group.starters.couldItAlso.description: Chip above a channel's message box that starts a suggestion for the project. Tapping it puts the beginning of this sentence in the message box for the person to finish. 'It' is the project.

group.starters.couldItAlsoText.description: The beginning of a sentence put in the message box when the person taps the 'Could it also…' chip; they type the rest. 'It' is the project. No ellipsis and no final punctuation: the person's own words follow it.

group.spec.sections.description: Accessible name of the two tabs (User-facing, Technical) at the top of a plan shown in the chat's side panel. A plan is the written description of a change.

group.spec.tab.user.description: Tab of a plan in the chat's side panel: the part that describes what people using the project will see.

group.spec.tab.tech.description: Tab of a plan in the chat's side panel: the part that describes how the change is built.

group.spec.tabEmpty.description: Shown under a plan's User-facing or Technical tab in the chat's side panel when that part of the plan is empty.

group.spec.copy.label.description: Button in the header of the plan side panel: copies the whole plan to the clipboard as Markdown text. Copy is a verb.

group.spec.copy.title.text: Copy the whole plan as markdown
group.spec.copy.title.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the 'Copy markdown' button in the header of the plan side panel.

group.spec.copy.copied.description: Replaces the 'Copy markdown' button's label for a moment after the plan was copied to the clipboard.

group.spec.copy.failed.description: Replaces the 'Copy markdown' button's label for a moment when the plan could not be copied to the clipboard.

group.spec.copy.failedToast.text: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually
group.spec.copy.failedToast.description: Brief notice shown when the plan could not be copied to the clipboard from the plan side panel.

group.spec.close.description: Accessible name of the × button in the header of the plan side panel: closes the panel. Close is a verb.

group.botStatus.willRead.text: Homeroom bot will read this in a moment
group.botStatus.willRead.description: Line under the messages of a request's or change's thread, a project channel or a reply thread, where the typing line goes, after somebody wrote to Homeroom bot: the bot has the message and will read it shortly. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botStatus.readingYours.text: Homeroom bot is reading your reply
group.botStatus.readingYours.description: Line under the messages of a request's or change's thread, a project channel or a reply thread, where the typing line goes, seen by the person who wrote the message: Homeroom bot is reading what they just wrote. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botStatus.reading.text: Homeroom bot is reading the reply
group.botStatus.reading.description: Line under the messages of a request's or change's thread, a project channel or a reply thread, where the typing line goes, seen by everybody except the person who wrote the message: Homeroom bot is reading what somebody else just wrote. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botStatus.quiet.text: Homeroom bot read this and has nothing to add
group.botStatus.quiet.description: Line under the messages of a request's or change's thread, a project channel or a reply thread, where the typing line goes, after Homeroom bot read a message addressed to it and chose not to answer. It fades after a few seconds. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.label.text: Homeroom bot, only you can see this
group.botCard.label.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message. Nobody else in the channel sees the card. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.onlyYou.description: Small heading at the top of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: nobody else in the channel sees the card.

group.botCard.shared.text: Everyone here can see it in the project's requests.
group.botCard.shared.description: Line on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, just after a request was taken: the request is on the project's list of requests, which everyone in the channel can see. 'It' is the request. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.choices.description: Accessible name of the row of buttons on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message.

group.botCard.withStays.text: {{words}} It stays in the project’s requests with your name on it.
group.botCard.withStays.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message on the person's first request in a project. {{words}} is the complete sentence or sentences the card says about the request, for example 'Got it: Add dark mode.'; this adds that the request stays listed in the project's requests under their name. 'Requests' is a noun: the project's list of things people asked for.

group.botCard.approval.has.text: It has the approvals it needs.
group.botCard.approval.has.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …': the change has been approved by enough people. 'It' is the change.

group.botCard.approval.noVote.text: It goes live without a vote.
group.botCard.approval.noVote.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …' or 'Updated the first version.': the change is the project's first version, which is not put to a vote and goes live once its automated checks pass. 'It' is the change.

group.botCard.approval.needs_one.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many approvals the built change still needs and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number of approvals; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

group.botCard.approval.needs_other.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many approvals the built change still needs and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number of approvals; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.needsMore_one.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many more approvals the built change needs, once it has some, and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number still missing; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

group.botCard.approval.needsMore_other.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many more approvals the built change needs, once it has some, and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number still missing; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.waitingFrom.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying that every person listed still has to approve the built change. {{people}} is a list joined with "and", for example "you, @ada and 2 more".

group.botCard.approval.waitingFromYou.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying that every person listed still has to approve the built change. Used when the reader's own approval is the only one the change is waiting for. A complete sentence.

group.botCard.approval.waiting.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …': the change still needs approval and nobody in particular is named.

group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWait.text: Got it: {{title}}. Waiting for the first version to go live. I’ll start on this as soon as it does.
group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWait.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and will start once the project's first version is live. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWaitUnti.text: Got it: your request. Waiting for the first version to go live. I’ll start on this as soon as it does.
group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWaitUnti.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and will start once the project's first version is live. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.waitingSlot.text: Got it: {{title}}. Homeroom bot will build it when it has a free slot. It starts by itself.
group.botCard.filed.waitingSlot.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and it waits in the bot's own line on the project until the bot has a free slot. Nobody else builds it and the person has nothing to do: the bot starts on it by itself. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.filed.waitingSlotUntitled.text: Got it: your request. Homeroom bot will build it when it has a free slot. It starts by itself.
group.botCard.filed.waitingSlotUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and it waits in the bot's own line on the project until the bot has a free slot. Nobody else builds it and the person has nothing to do: the bot starts on it by itself. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.filed.waitingPlan.text: Got it: {{title}}. It’s waiting for you: you’re planning it with Homeroom bot in a private thread.
group.botCard.filed.waitingPlan.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and will not start on it while the person is working out its plan with the bot in a private thread of their own. It waits for the person, not for a free slot. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.filed.waitingPlanUntitled.text: Got it: your request. It’s waiting for you: you’re planning it with Homeroom bot in a private thread.
group.botCard.filed.waitingPlanUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and will not start on it while the person is working out its plan with the bot in a private thread of their own. It waits for the person, not for a free slot. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.filed.building.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot is building the change that was asked for. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.buildingUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot is building the change that was asked for. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.checking.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and its tests are running. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.checkingUntitled.text: Built: your request. Testing it now.
group.botCard.filed.checkingUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and its tests are running. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.proposed.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and waits for approval. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.proposedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and waits for approval. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approved.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approvedUntitled.text: Approved: your request. It’s going live.
group.botCard.filed.approvedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.live.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change that was asked for is now in use. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.liveUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change that was asked for is now in use. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.closed.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was closed without being released. Closed is an adjective here. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.closedUntitled.text: Closed: your request. It won’t go live.
group.botCard.filed.closedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was closed without being released. Closed is an adjective here. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotIt.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotItUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutes_one.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words; {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.text: Got it: your request. Usually about {{count}} minutes.
group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. Used when the request has no title. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutes_other.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words; {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.text: Got it: your request. Usually about {{count}} minutes.
group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. Used when the request has no title. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.question.text: I have a question about this. It’s in our chat.
group.botCard.filed.question.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: before building, the bot asked the person something in their private chat with it. The bot speaks as 'I'; 'our chat' is that private conversation.

group.botCard.filed.person.text: I left this for the group to decide.
group.botCard.filed.person.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot did not build the request and left it as a request for the project's community to decide on. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.stopped.text: I couldn’t finish this. Our chat says why.
group.botCard.filed.stopped.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot stopped before finishing the change; the reason is in the person's private chat with the bot. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.firstVersi.text: Updated the first version. Testing it now.
group.botCard.revise.checking.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.untitled.text: Updated that change. Testing it now.
group.botCard.revise.checking.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. The change is the project's first version. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.asked.firstVersion.text: I have a question about your fix. It’s in the discussion of the first version.
group.botCard.revise.asked.firstVersion.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot asked the person something about the fix, in that change's discussion. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.asked.titled.text: I have a question about your fix. It’s in the discussion of “{{title}}”.

group.weekly.nothingLanded.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel when no change went live this week. 'Landed' means was released.

group.weekly.wentLive_one.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Change' is a noun.

group.weekly.wentLive_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Changes' is a noun.

group.weekly.authorBacked.description: After a change's title on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, following a middle dot. {{author}} is the username of the person who built the change; {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it.

group.weekly.moreLive_one.description: Last line of the list of changes released this week on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes went live that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.moreLive_other.description: Last line of the list of changes released this week on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes went live that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.waiting_one.text: One change is waiting for approval
group.weekly.waiting_one.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes waiting for the community's vote, when there is exactly one. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

group.weekly.waiting_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes waiting for the community's vote. {{count}} is how many.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_one.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_other.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.door.description: Link at the bottom of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: opens the project's Workshop, the tab that lists its changes and requests. Open is a verb; Workshop is the tab's name. Keep the › at the end.

group.attachment.openFullSize.description: Tooltip of a picture attached to a chat message: clicking it opens the picture at full size. {{file}} is the file's name. Open is a verb.

group.attachment.openFullSizeUnnamed.description: Tooltip of a picture attached to a chat message: clicking it opens the picture at full size. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.download.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the download control on a file attached to a chat message. {{file}} is the file's name. Download is a verb.

group.attachment.downloadUnnamed.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the download control on a file attached to a chat message. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.view.description: Tooltip of a Markdown file attached to a chat message: clicking its name opens the file for reading in the side panel. {{file}} is the file's name. View is a verb.

group.attachment.viewUnnamed.description: Tooltip of a Markdown file attached to a chat message: clicking its name opens the file for reading in the side panel. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.previewTitle.description: Tooltip of the Preview link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab, isolated ('sandboxed') so it cannot touch the person's account. {{file}} is the file's name. Open is a verb.

group.attachment.previewTitleUnnamed.description: Tooltip of the Preview link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab, isolated ('sandboxed') so it cannot touch the person's account. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

group.attachment.unnamed.description: Stands where a file's name would be on a chat attachment that has none. Shown alone, as the chip's label. A noun, lower case.

group.attachment.preview.description: Link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab to look at it. A verb here.

group.row.editTitle.description: Tooltip of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message. A verb.

group.row.edit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message.

group.row.savedTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: clicking removes it from their saved items.

group.row.saveTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message: clicking keeps the message in the person's notifications list so they can find it later. Save is a verb.

group.row.unsave.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: removes it from their saved items.

group.row.save.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message: keeps the message in the person's saved items. Save is a verb, to bookmark.

group.row.reactTitle.description: Tooltip of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with. A verb.

group.row.addReaction.description: Accessible name of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with.

group.row.repeated_one.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_one.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.repeated_other.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_other.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.botSkipped.text: Homeroom bot doesn't answer this message; @ it in your own words to ask it.
group.row.botSkipped.description: Small grey line under a message a person's coding agent posted for them on a request's, a change's or a reply thread's discussion, when Homeroom bot will not answer it (so an agent and the bot cannot talk to each other forever, or its voice is off there). One line, no icon, not a button.

group.row.unreadMention.description: Accessible name of the dot before the author of a chat message that mentions the person and that they have not read yet.

group.row.edited.description: Small muted word after a chat message's time when its author changed the message after sending it. Lower case.

group.row.showMore.description: Button under a long message in a thread or a request's discussion that is cut off after about fifteen lines: shows the whole message.

group.row.showLess.description: Button under a long message in a thread or a request's discussion after it was opened: cuts it back to about fifteen lines.

group.row.deleted.description: Shown in place of a chat message's content after its author deleted it.

group.voteCard.change.description: How a change is named on the small vote card under a chat line about it, and on the line under Homeroom bot’s "It’s up for a vote" post on a request’s page, when the project’s code is on Homeroom’s own git host. {{number}} is the change’s number.

group.voteCard.changePr.description: How a change is named on the small vote card under a chat line about it, and on the line under Homeroom bot’s "It’s up for a vote" post on a request’s page, when the project’s code is on GitHub (a change’s number is written PR, never #). {{number}} is the pull request number.

group.voteCard.changeTitled.description: The change’s name followed by its title on the small vote card under a chat line about it, and on the line under Homeroom bot’s "It’s up for a vote" post on a request’s page. {{name}} is "Change #12" or "PR 12" and {{title}} the change’s title.

group.voteCard.unnamed.description: What the small vote card under a chat line about a change calls the change while neither its number nor its title is known yet.

group.voteCard.seeVote.description: Button on the line under Homeroom bot’s "It’s up for a vote" post on a request’s page, and on the small vote card about a change whose vote is over: scrolls to or opens that change’s Votes card. See is a verb.

group.voteCard.preview.description: Button on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: opens a running copy of the app with the change in it. A verb.

group.voteCard.vote.description: Button on the small vote card under a chat line about a change whose vote is open: opens the change’s Votes card, where the person votes. A verb.

group.voteCard.needsMore_one.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change, while it is short of Yes votes. {{count}} is how many more Yes votes it needs. "Yes" is the vote, as a noun.

group.voteCard.needsMore_other.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change, while it is short of Yes votes. {{count}} is how many more Yes votes it needs. "Yes" is the vote, as a noun.

group.voteCard.needsOtherMember.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change that has enough Yes votes but still needs one from a member other than its author. "Yes" is the vote.

group.voteCard.reached.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change, once it has the Yes votes it needs. {{yes}} is how many Yes votes it has and {{needed}} how many it needs.

group.voteCard.youVotedYes.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: the person reading has already voted Yes on it.

group.voteCard.youVotedNo.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: the person reading has already voted No on it.

group.voteCard.merging.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: the vote passed and the change is being merged right now.

group.voteCard.merged.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: the change was merged, so the vote is over.

group.voteCard.checks.passed.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: every automated check passed.

group.voteCard.checks.failing.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: at least one automated check failed.

group.voteCard.checks.running.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: its automated checks have not finished yet.

group.voteCard.checks.error.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: its automated checks could not be run.

group.voteCard.previewBuilding.description: One fact on the small vote card under a chat line about a change: the running copy of the app with the change in it is still being started, so there is no Preview button yet.

group.voteCard.label.description: Accessible name of the small vote card under a chat line about a change, which says where its vote and checks stand and offers Preview and Vote.

group.specCard.sharedBy.description: Line on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version. Shared is a verb form.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeone.description: Line on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number.

group.specCard.sharedByBuilt.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeoneBuilt.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{built}} is when it was built, already formatted.

group.specCard.sharedByPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR is the usual abbreviation of pull request.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeonePr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{number}} is the pull request's number; keep "PR".

group.specCard.sharedByBuiltPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the plan's version number; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR abbreviates pull request.

group.specCard.sharedBySomeoneBuiltPr.description: Line on the card of a plan that someone shared in a chat. Used when nobody can be named; "Someone" is written as the line has always shown it. {{version}} is the plan's version number. {{built}} is when it was built, already formatted. {{number}} is the pull request's number; keep "PR".

group.specCard.loading.description: Replaces the label of the 'View full plan' button on a shared plan's card while the plan is being fetched.

group.specCard.view.description: Button on the card of a plan (the written description of a change) shared in a chat: opens the whole plan in the side panel. View is a verb.

group.menu.makeRequest.description: Item in a chat message's menu: asks Homeroom bot to treat the message as a request to build something for the project. 'Request' is a noun.

group.menu.viewThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message already has replies: opens the thread of replies under it.

group.menu.replyInThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message has no replies yet: opens a thread under the message to reply there. Reply is a verb.

group.menu.edit.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: starts editing it.

group.menu.copyText.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies the message's text to the clipboard. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.textCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy text' in a chat message's menu: the message's text is on the clipboard.

group.menu.copyLink.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies a web link that opens the chat at this message. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.linkCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy link to message' in a chat message's menu: the link is on the clipboard.

group.menu.markUnread.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: marks the channel as unread from this message on, so it shows as new again. Mark is a verb.

group.menu.markedUnread.description: Brief notice after 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu: the channel now shows as unread from that message.

group.menu.markUnreadFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu failed. 'This' is the message.

group.menu.delete.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: asks for confirmation, then deletes the message for everyone.

group.menu.deleteFailed.description: Brief notice when deleting the person's own chat message failed.

group.menu.report.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: opens the form that reports the message to the moderators. Report is a verb.

group.menu.block.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: asks for confirmation, then hides that person's messages from the reader. {{username}} is the author's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb.

group.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: asks for confirmation, then hides that person's messages from the reader. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.menu.blockFailed.description: Alert shown when blocking a chat message's author failed and the server gave no reason. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.deleteConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted.

group.deleteConfirm.message.text: Everyone will see “Message deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.
group.deleteConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted. “Message deleted” is the exact text shown where the message was; translate it the same way as that text.

group.deleteConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to delete the person's own chat message. A verb.

group.blockConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before a chat message's author is blocked. {{username}} is that person's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.blockConfirm.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before a chat message's author is blocked. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.blockConfirm.message.text: Their messages in Messages and app discussions will be hidden.
group.blockConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before a person is blocked from a chat message's menu. The second 'Messages' is the name of the Messages tab; 'app discussions' are the projects' channels.

group.blockConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to block a chat message's author. A verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.report.label.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from a chat message. {{username}} is the message author's username; keep the @ before it.

group.report.labelUnknown.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from a chat message. Used on a message whose author did not come with it and is shown as "System".

group.sheet.reply.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held on a touch screen: starts a reply to that message. A verb.

group.sheet.unsave.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a saved chat message is pressed and held: removes the message from the person's saved items.

group.sheet.save.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held: keeps the message in the person's saved items. A verb, to bookmark; not saving a form.

group.thread.replies_one.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Reply is a noun.

group.thread.replies_other.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Replies is a noun.

group.thread.noReplies.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat that nobody has replied to.

group.history.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a discussion's messages: fetches the older messages before the ones shown. Load is a verb.

group.composer.replyingToPlatform.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to an automatic line that Homeroom itself posted, such as a change being put up for a vote. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToMessage.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to a message whose author is no longer known. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToSystem.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a chat line that came with no author and shows "System" in the author's place. "@System" is written as it has always been shown.

group.composer.replyingToSomeone.description: Label over the message box while the person replies to a shared plan card whose sharer is not known and shows "Someone". "@Someone" is written as it has always been shown.

group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.text: 👋 Say hi, ask a question, or share what you would like to see next in this app.
group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may write. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.text: Messages from the people building this app will show up here.
group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may read but not write.

group.typing.one.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while one other person is typing. {{name}} is their username.

group.typing.several.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while several other people are typing. {{names}} is their usernames, already joined into a list.

group.send.notSentReason.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused. {{reason}} is the server's own complete sentence saying why, for example that the channel has moved or the topic was closed.

group.send.notSentJoin.text: Not sent. Join this project to post here.
group.send.notSentJoin.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person is not a member of the project. Join and post are verbs: become a member, send a message.

group.send.rateLimited_one.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} second.
group.send.rateLimited_one.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimited_other.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
group.send.rateLimited_other.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimitedMoment.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in a moment.
group.send.rateLimitedMoment.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time, and the wait is not known.

group.send.error.description: Brief notice when the chat connection reported an error and gave no explanation of its own.

group.send.notSentError.text: Not sent. Something went wrong. Try again.
group.send.notSentError.description: Brief notice when a chat message could not be delivered because its channel moved or its topic was closed, and the server gave no explanation of its own.

group.systemSender.description: Stands in for the author's name on a chat line that no person wrote, such as an automatic notice, when the project's name is not available. A noun: the platform itself.

group.history.failed.description: Error line in a project's channel when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.readOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box of a discussion thread the person may read but not write in.

group.thread.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of a discussion thread. Reply is a verb.

group.thread.empty.text: No messages yet. Start the thread.
group.thread.empty.description: Line shown in a discussion thread that has no messages. Start is a verb: write the first message.

group.thread.loading.description: Line shown in a discussion thread while its messages are being fetched.

group.thread.failed.description: Error line in a discussion thread when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.unknownAuthor.description: Stands where a person's username is shown on the card under a chat message that previews the newest reply in its thread, when the reply's author is not known. Shown alone in the name's own element; lower case in English, like a username.

group.quote.spec.description: Stands in for the text of a shared plan that has no title, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A plan is the written description of a change.

group.quote.file.description: Stands in for an attached file's name when it has none, after a paperclip, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A noun, lower case.

group.quote.pr.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that came from a pull request, and in a shared plan's subtitle. PR is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number. Do not put a # before the number: a change's number is written PR, never #.

group.quote.prUnnumbered.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that came from a pull request whose number is not known.

group.quote.system.description: Stands where an author's name would be on a quoted line that no person wrote. Lower case, one word: the platform itself.

group.bookmark.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when bookmarking a chat message failed. Save means keep it in the person's saved items.

group.bookmark.unsaveFailed.description: Brief notice when removing a chat message from the person's saved items failed.

group.bot.askFailed.text: Couldn’t ask Homeroom bot just now.
group.bot.askFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Make this a request' on a chat message could not reach Homeroom bot, the product's assistant that builds changes. Keep the name Homeroom bot.

group.row.editedAt.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message. {{when}} is the date and time of the last edit, already formatted, for example Jun 16, 2026, 02:41 PM. Lower case.

group.row.editedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message when the time of the edit is not known. Lower case.

group.edit.notConnected.text: Not connected. Your edit wasn’t sent, so try again in a moment.
group.edit.notConnected.description: Notice beside the Save and Cancel buttons while editing a chat message, when the change could not be sent because the connection is down. 'Edit' is a noun here: the changed message.

group.report.selected.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from the reaction bar of a chat message on a touch screen.

group.attach.tooBig.image.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Images max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.image.description: Error above the chat message box when a picture chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.markdown.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Markdown files max {{kilobytes}} KB.
group.attach.tooBig.markdown.description: Error above the chat message box when a Markdown file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{kilobytes}} is the limit in kilobytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.html.text: "{{file}}" is too big. HTML files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.html.description: Error above the chat message box when an HTML file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.other.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.other.description: Error above the chat message box when a file chosen to attach is over the size limit for files in general. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_one.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_other.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.uploadFailedStatus.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.attach.uploadFailed.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and nothing more is known.

group.attach.stillUploading.description: Notice above the chat message box when Send was pressed while an attached file is still uploading; the message is not sent yet.

group.file.loadFailedStatus.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing. {{file}} is the file's name; {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 404.

group.file.loadFailedStatusUnnamed.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing. Used when the attached file has no name; "file" is written as it has always been shown. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

group.file.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing and nothing more is known.

group.spec.title.description: Title of a shared plan that has no title of its own, on its card in the chat and in the side panel. {{version}} is the plan's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. A plan is the written description of a change.

group.spec.previewTitle.description: Title shown in the side panel's header while a shared plan with no title of its own is being fetched. {{version}} is the plan's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. Lower case.

group.spec.someone.description: Stands in for the username of the person who shared a plan in a chat when it is not known, in 'Shared by …' on the plan's card.

group.spec.gone.text: This plan is no longer available. The sharer may have deleted the session.
group.spec.gone.description: Shown in the side panel when a plan shared in a chat no longer exists. 'The sharer' is the person who shared it; a 'session' is the piece of work with the AI builder that the plan belonged to.

group.spec.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a plan shared in a chat could not be fetched. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.spec.empty.description: Shown in the side panel in place of the content of a shared plan that has no content. Keep the parentheses.

group.spec.error.description: Shown in the side panel when fetching a shared plan failed. {{message}} is the browser's own technical error message.

group.spec.loading.description: Shown in the side panel in place of a shared plan's content while it is being fetched again after the page was reloaded.

group.status.reconnecting.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection to the chat is down and being restored.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_one.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_other.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.ref.byUser.description: Stands in for the title of a proposed change that has none, in the list of changes offered while typing # in a chat message. {{username}} is the username of the person who proposed it. Lower case.

group.botCard.filed.approvedRelease.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approvedReleaseUntit.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.fir.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. The change is the project's first version. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.tit.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approvedRelease.unt.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and merged into Homeroom itself, and goes live with the platform's next release. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. {{release}} is a sentence, without its full stop, saying when that release goes out, for example 'Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.topicChannel.empty.description: Line shown in a topic's channel of a project's discussion when nobody has written in it yet. A topic is one of a project's own named channels, such as #onboarding.

group.topicChannel.start.description: Invitation in the middle of a topic's channel when nobody has written in it yet. {{handle}} is the channel's name without its #, for example "onboarding".

group.topicChannel.invite.text: Ideas posted here can become requests.
group.topicChannel.invite.description: Second line of the invitation in the middle of an empty topic channel: says what posting there leads to. A request is something a member asks to have built or fixed.

group.botOffer.failed.description: The line under the buttons when pressing Yes or No under one of Homeroom bot's offers in a chat could not be sent, and the server gave no reason of its own.

group.botOffer.gone.text: This offer is no longer available.
group.botOffer.gone.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the offer behind them no longer exists.

group.botOffer.goneClose.text: This offer is no longer available. You can still propose closing it from the request’s ⋯ menu.
group.botOffer.goneClose.description: Where an "already works" note's Propose to close buttons were, once the offer behind them no longer exists; the request's ⋯ menu still has its own Propose to close.

group.botOffer.expired.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the offer is more than 14 days old and can no longer be chosen.

group.botOffer.refused.alreadyDecided.description: The line under Homeroom bot's offer in a chat when a Yes or No was pressed after the offer had already been answered, here or on another device.

group.botOffer.refused.notForYou.text: Only the person it was offered to can choose this.
group.botOffer.refused.notForYou.description: The line under Homeroom bot's offer in a chat when someone pressed a Yes or No meant for another person.

group.botOffer.refused.notThisMessage.text: These buttons belong to another message. Reload to see them where they are.
group.botOffer.refused.notThisMessage.description: The line under Homeroom bot's offer in a chat when the offer a button named is shown under a different message, which happens on a screen that has not caught up.

group.botOffer.retired.closeVote.text: No longer needed: a vote on closing this request is open.
group.botOffer.retired.closeVote.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once a vote on closing the request it was about has opened, so proposing to close it again is not needed.

group.botOffer.retired.closed.text: No longer needed: this is closed.
group.botOffer.retired.closed.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the request or change it was about has been closed.

group.botOffer.retired.building.text: No longer needed: building it has started.
group.botOffer.retired.building.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the request it was about started being built, so the choice it offered no longer applies.

group.botOffer.retired.movedOn.text: No longer needed: things have moved on since.
