group.botOffer.retired.movedOn.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the request or change it was about moved to a stage where the choice no longer applies.

group.botOffer.retired.superseded.text: No longer needed: a newer note replaced this one.
group.botOffer.retired.superseded.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once a newer message from the bot about the same thing offered the same choice again.

group.botOffer.retired.other.description: Where an offer's buttons were, under Homeroom bot's message in a chat, once the offer no longer applies, when no more specific reason is known.

sections.open.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities anyone can find and join.

sections.invited.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities only invited people can open.

sections.solo.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the projects that have no member but this person.

sections.open.noun.description: What one community anyone can find and join is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.invited.noun.description: What one community only invited people can open is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.solo.noun.description: What a project with no member but this person is called, naming its audience. It stands where "Public community" or "Private community" would.

sections.open.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.open.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.solo.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.solo.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.shownOf_one.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOf_other.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_one.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_other.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.showFewer.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities, once every community in it is showing: folds the section back to its first few rows.

sections.showMore_one.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

sections.showMore_other.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

row.toVote_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.toVote_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

page.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of the Communities page (desktop widths), which filters the person's pinned and joined communities by name.

page.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Communities page, which filters the person's pinned and joined communities by name.

page.pinned.description: Small-caps heading on the Communities page over the communities the person pinned, each a tile that opens its hub. An adjective: these communities are pinned.

page.joined.description: Small-caps heading on the Communities page over the communities the person is a member of but has not pinned. An adjective: communities they have joined.

page.showAll_one.description: Accessible label of the heading over a group of communities (Pinned or Joined) on the Communities page, in the Standard (WIP) look, while the group is folded to its first rows: pressing the heading unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many communities the group has.

page.showAll_other.description: Accessible label of the heading over a group of communities (Pinned or Joined) on the Communities page, in the Standard (WIP) look, while the group is folded to its first rows: pressing the heading unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many communities the group has.

page.showLess.description: Accessible label of the heading over a group of communities (Pinned or Joined) on the Communities page, in the Standard (WIP) look, once the group has been unfolded: pressing the heading folds it back to its first rows.

page.editLabel.description: Accessible name of the Edit button beside a heading on the Communities page: lets the person unpin pinned communities and pin joined ones. "Edit" is a verb.

page.empty.text: You are not in a community yet. Join one from Home, or start your own.
page.empty.description: Line on the Communities page for a person who has pinned no community and joined none. Home is the name of the Home screen, where the communities to join are listed.

page.notSaved.text: Not saved on this phone yet. Your communities will load when you’re back online.
page.notSaved.description: Communities screen, in place of the list, when Homeroom cannot be reached and the list was never saved on this device. Not an error: it says what will happen.

page.noMatch.description: Line on the Communities page when the search finds none of the person's communities. {{query}} is what they typed.

page.discover.heading.description: Small-caps heading over the last card of the Communities page, which leads to the public communities the person has not joined. A verb used as a section name, the same word as the button's first.

page.discover.title.description: Title of the card at the foot of the Communities page, which leads to the public communities the person has not joined.

page.discover.text.text: Public communities you have not joined yet are on Home, under Communities to join.
page.discover.text.description: Line under "Find more communities" on the Communities page. Home is the name of the Home screen; "Communities to join" is the name of the section there, written as that section's heading is.

page.discover.button.description: Button on the card at the foot of the Communities page: opens the Home screen at its Communities to join section. "Discover" is a verb.

needsYou.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the row of filter chips above the Needs you feed (All, Votes that decide, Advisory), which narrows the votes waiting on the person to one kind.

needsYou.filter.all.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows every vote waiting on the person, whether their vote decides it or is advisory.

needsYou.filter.deciding.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows only the votes that count toward whether a change goes in.

needsYou.filter.advisory.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows only the changes where the person's vote is recorded but does not decide the outcome.

needsYou.filter.allCount_one.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.allCount_other.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.decidingCount_one.description: Accessible name of the Votes that decide filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many of the person's votes decide their outcome. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.decidingCount_other.description: Accessible name of the Votes that decide filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many of the person's votes decide their outcome. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.advisoryCount_one.description: Accessible name of the Advisory filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many advisory votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.advisoryCount_other.description: Accessible name of the Advisory filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many advisory votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

reel.fallbackTitle.change.description: Stands in for the title of a proposal (a change to a project put up for a vote) in the Needs you feed when the proposal has no title.

reel.fallbackTitle.decision.description: Stands in for the title of a group decision (a vote on a project's settings, such as a rename, rather than on a code change) in the Needs you feed when it has no title.

reel.ask.change.description: Question over the Yes and No buttons of a proposal in the Needs you feed: asks whether the proposed change should be merged into the project.

reel.ask.decision.description: Question over a group decision in the Needs you feed: asks whether the decision (for example a rename of the project) should be carried out.

reel.fallbackTitle.question.description: Stands in for the words of a question Homeroom bot asked the person about their request, in the Needs you feed, when the question has none.

reel.ask.ballot.description: Question on an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes for one request (and maybe a proposal to close it): the person picks one on the request's page.

reel.ask.question.text: Homeroom bot asked you about your request
reel.ask.question.description: Question on an item of the Needs you feed that is a question Homeroom bot asked the person about their request: they answer it on the request's page.

reel.ballot.choice.description: One choice of competing changes, in the list on an item of the Needs you feed. {{letter}} is the change's letter (A, B, C) as the request's page letters it, {{title}} its title.

reel.ballot.close.description: Last choice in the list of competing changes on an item of the Needs you feed, when a proposal to close the request competes with them.

reel.ballot.choices.description: Line on an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes: its choices, joined as a list. {{choices}} is that list.

reel.ballot.fallbackTitle.description: Title of an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes, when the request they are for has no title. {{number}} is the request's number.

reel.pages.note.text: These are waiting on you. Each one is decided on its own page.
reel.pages.note.description: Line above the list on the Communities screen's Needs you when everything waiting is decided on its own page (a group decision, competing changes or a question from Homeroom bot) rather than in the review run.

reel.pages.governance.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a group decision's own page. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.ballot.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a request's page, where competing changes for it are picked from. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.question.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a request's page, where Homeroom bot asked a question. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.label.description: Accessible name of the list on the Communities screen's Needs you whose rows each open the page where that item is decided.

reel.yes.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes for the change going in.

reel.no.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes against the change going in.

reel.error.text: Couldn't load what is waiting on you. Each project's own Needs you page still has it.
reel.error.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when it could not be loaded. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page, which lists the same votes for that project.

reel.loading.description: Accessible name of the empty placeholder shown while the Needs you feed on the Communities screen is loading.

reel.empty.text: Nothing is waiting on your vote in any of your projects.
reel.empty.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen only when nothing at all is waiting for this person: no proposal, competing change, question or group decision.

reel.emptyProject.text: Nothing is waiting on your vote in {{project}}.
reel.emptyProject.description: Shown on one project's own Needs you page when nothing in that project is waiting for this person: no proposal, competing change, question or group decision. {{project}} is the project's name. Other projects may still have votes waiting, so it speaks for this project only.

reel.caughtUp.title.description: Heading of a project's own Needs you page when nothing in that project waits for this person (the Standard (WIP) look). Good news, said plainly.

reel.caughtUp.next.description: Small line under the caught-up heading on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look), over three ways on into the project.

reel.caughtUp.workshop.title.description: Title of a card on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look): opens the project's Workshop, where its requests and changes are.

reel.caughtUp.workshop.text.text: Requests and changes, and the ones nobody has picked up
reel.caughtUp.workshop.text.description: Line under the Workshop card's title on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look).

reel.caughtUp.discussion.title.description: Title of a card on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look): opens the project's discussion channel.

reel.caughtUp.discussion.text.text: Say what you think, or ask a question
reel.caughtUp.discussion.text.description: Line under the discussion card's title on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look).

reel.caughtUp.hub.title.description: Title of a card on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look): opens the project's hub. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.caughtUp.hub.text.text: Its hub: what it is and what went live lately
reel.caughtUp.hub.text.description: Line under the hub card's title on a project's empty Needs you page (the Standard (WIP) look).

reel.done.description: Button on the card at the end of the Needs you page (every vote waiting on the person across their projects): returns to Home, where their communities are.

reel.capped_one.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_one.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

reel.capped_other.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_other.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

switcher.title.description: Title of the switcher that lists every community the person belongs to, opened from the header's name or the Communities tab, for moving from one community to another.

switcher.all.name.description: First row of the Your communities switcher: leaves the single community being shown and opens the list of all of the person's communities.

switcher.all.count_one.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.count_other.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.every.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher while the list is still loading, so there is no count to show yet.

switcher.loading.description: Note in the Your communities switcher while the list of the person's communities is loading.

switcher.row.solo.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a project that has no member but this person.

switcher.row.invited_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.invited_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.toVote_one.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.toVote_other.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher, which filters the person's communities by name as they type.

switcher.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher. It can also be reached with Command+K or Ctrl+K.

switcher.search.results.description: Accessible name of the list of communities whose names match what the person typed in the Your communities switcher's search.

switcher.search.none.description: Shown in the Your communities switcher when no community the person is in has the searched words in its name. {{query}} is what they typed.

switcher.recent.description: Small heading in the Your communities switcher over the communities the person used most recently (and the ones they pinned), above the All communities row.

switcher.join.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

switcher.start.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.

review.end.line.description: Quiet line at the end of Needs you feed, under a check mark, once every waiting change has been shown.

review.end.throughAll.description: Title at the end of Needs you when the person skipped some changes without voting, so not everything is done. Shown over a small stack of the skipped changes.

review.end.waiting_one.text: 1 is still waiting for your vote.
review.end.waiting_one.description: Line under "You've been through them all" at the end of Needs you, when the person skipped one change without voting.

review.end.waiting_other.text: {{count}} are still waiting for your vote.
review.end.waiting_other.description: Line under "You've been through them all" at the end of Needs you, when the person skipped several changes without voting. {{count}} is how many.

review.end.again_one.description: Main button at the end of Needs you when one change was skipped: opens that change again so the person can vote.

review.end.again_other.description: Main button at the end of Needs you when several changes were skipped: goes through them again so the person can vote. {{count}} is how many.

review.thumbs.label.description: Accessible name of the row of small screen pictures under a change's before and after slider in Needs you flow.

review.thumbs.one.description: Accessible name of one small screen picture under a change's slider in Needs you flow. {{n}} is its position, {{total}} how many there are.

review.strip.all_one.description: Accessible name of the first tile in the strip under a change's picture (Needs you flow): it shows every screen of the change at once. {{count}} is how many screens.

review.strip.all_other.description: Accessible name of the first tile in the strip under a change's picture (Needs you flow): it shows every screen of the change at once. {{count}} is how many screens.

review.alt.after.description: Alt text of the after picture in a change's before and after slider (Needs you flow).

review.alt.before.description: Alt text of the before picture in a change's before and after slider (Needs you flow).

review.compare.label.description: Accessible name of the before and after slider on a change's page (Needs you flow). Drag sideways, or use the arrow keys, to compare.

review.compare.showingAfter.text: Showing the screen after the change
review.compare.showingAfter.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen after the change.

review.compare.showingBefore.text: Showing the screen before the change
review.compare.showingBefore.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen before the change.

review.compare.captionBefore.description: Caption printed at the top left of the before picture on a change's page (Needs you flow), in small capitals. <0> wraps the quieter part. Keep it very short.

review.compare.captionAfter.description: Caption printed at the top right of the after picture on a change's page (Needs you flow), in small capitals: the screen as it will be if the vote passes. <0> wraps the quieter part. Keep it very short.

review.compare.switch.text: Show the screen before the change
review.compare.switch.description: Accessible name of the small switch at the foot of the before and after picture (Needs you flow). On: the before screen fills the picture. Off: the after screen.

review.sheet.label.description: Accessible name of the vote sheet at the foot of a change's page (Needs you flow).

review.sheet.more.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it rests: tapping it opens the help (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it, About).

review.sheet.close.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it is open: tapping it folds the sheet back.

review.vote.yes.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote for the change going live.

review.vote.no.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote against the change. It asks for one line on what would make it a yes.

review.vote.approve.description: Yes button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours, where your yes is the one it needs.

review.vote.dontApprove.description: No button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours.

review.vote.skip.description: Button beside the Yes | No pair at the foot of a change's page in Needs you. It moves on to the next change at once without a vote; nothing is recorded and the change keeps waiting in Needs you. After a vote the same place shows Next. One word.

review.vote.skipLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the Skip button beside the Yes | No pair in Needs you. It moves on without a vote; the change keeps waiting in Needs you.

review.no.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason. {{name}} is the username of the person who made the change.

review.no.placeholderNoName.text: One line for whoever made it
review.no.placeholderNoName.description: Placeholder in the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason, when the change's maker is not known.

review.no.send.description: Button that sends a No vote, with the picked answer as its reason, in the vote sheet on a change's page (Needs you). It is off until an answer is picked.

review.reason.add.description: Quiet link above the vote buttons after someone voted No on a change (Needs you flow). It opens the sheet that asks why.

review.reason.label.description: Accessible name of the one-line field where someone adds a reason to their No vote (Needs you flow).

review.reason.share.description: Button inside the one-line reason field: sends the reason with the No vote (Needs you flow).

review.why.title.description: Heading of the sheet that asks why someone is voting No on a change (Needs you flow).

review.why.notWorking.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: the change does not work.

review.why.approach.text: I do not agree with the approach
review.why.approach.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: they disagree with how the change was made.

review.why.notNeeded.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: the change is unnecessary.

review.why.other.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote when none of the other answers fits; the optional line is where they say more.

review.why.detailLabel.description: Label over the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason.

review.why.withDetail.description: How a No vote's reason reads when the voter added a line: the picked answer, a colon, then the line. {{choice}} is the answer, for example "It does not work"; {{detail}} is the line they wrote.

review.said.yes.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting Yes, under a large check mark.

review.said.no.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting No, under a large mark.

review.said.undo.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting: takes the vote back while voting is still open.

review.desc.show.description: Accessible name of the ⌄ button beside the change's title at the top of Needs you flow: drops the change's full description over the page.

review.desc.hide.description: Accessible name of the same button while the change's full description is open (Needs you flow): folds it away.

review.desc.by.description: Small line under a change's description in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. {{name}} is the person who made the change.

review.help.label.description: Screen-reader name of the help rows (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it) at the foot of the card that opens from the bar of Needs you.

review.help.ask.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens a private question to the AI about this change; only the person sees the answers.

review.help.talk.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens the change's discussion thread: what others said about it.

review.help.try.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens a live copy of the app with this change, when one is running.

review.back.label.description: Accessible name of the back control at the top of Needs you flow. {{place}} is the place it goes back to: Home, or the project's name.

review.said.nextShort.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting (Needs you flow): moves sideways to the next change waiting on you. A small count in a ring follows it. Keep it one short word.

review.said.nextLeft_one.description: Accessible name of the Next button in Needs you flow, when one change still waits besides the one on screen. The button shows that number in a ring that fills as the run is decided.

review.said.nextLeft_other.description: Accessible name of the Next button in Needs you flow: {{count}} is how many changes still wait besides the one on screen, the number the button shows in a ring that fills as the run is decided.

review.said.done.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting on the last change without your vote: opens the all-done message, which says that nothing else is waiting and offers the way back to the list.

review.ask.note.text: Only you see this. Answers come from the change itself.
review.ask.note.description: Line at the top of Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.inAi.description: Button in the Ask privately sheet of a change waiting for the person's vote: opens their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) with this change attached, to ask about it there. "AI" is the tab's name.

review.ask.inAiNote.text: Ask Homeroom bot about this change in your private chat with it. The change comes with you, and only you see it.
review.ask.inAiNote.description: Line at the top of the Ask privately sheet of a change waiting for the person's vote, above the Ask Homeroom bot button: questions about the change are asked in the person's private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) now. "AI" is the tab's name.

review.ask.earlier.description: Small heading in the Ask privately sheet of a change, over the questions the person asked about it here before questions moved to the AI chat, and their answers. They can still be read.

review.ask.who.description: Name over an answer in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.q1.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.q2.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the question box in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.send.description: Button that sends a question in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.reading.description: Placeholder answer in Ask privately while the answer is on its way.

review.ask.failed.text: Couldn't get an answer just now. Try again in a moment.
review.ask.failed.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be answered and the server gave no reason.

review.ask.offline.text: You seem to be offline. Try again when you're connected.
review.ask.offline.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be sent.

review.try.note.text: A live copy with this change. Nothing you do there is kept.
review.try.note.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet, over the button that opens the live copy.

review.try.open.description: Button on the Try it page of the vote sheet: opens the change's live preview.

review.try.none.text: There's no live copy of this change right now. Its page may be able to start one.
review.try.none.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet when the change has no live preview.

review.more.open.description: Row in the vote sheet’s help, and a link in its About and Try it panels (Needs you flow): leaves the run for the change’s own page in its project.

review.benefit.fixed.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.stability.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.clarity.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.more.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.results.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.speed.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.effort.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.security.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.behind.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.area.agents.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.proposals.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.platform.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.projects.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.accounts.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.admin.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.messages.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.challenges.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.decision.closeIssue.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.rename.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.secret.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.other.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.end.backToProject.description: Button at the end of a project's Needs you in the review flow, once every waiting change has been shown: opens the project's Workshop.

language.notice.showing.description: Notice shown once after Homeroom picked the device's language automatically. {{language}} is that language's own name, for example Español.

language.notice.dismiss.description: Accessible label of the close button on the automatic-language notice.

language.notice.switchToEnglish.description: Button on the automatic-language notice. Always shown in English, whatever language is active, so a person who cannot read the picked language can find it.

tabs.sections.description: Accessible name of the main navigation: the tab bar on a phone, the left rail on a desktop.

tabs.home.description: Tab in the main navigation: opens the Home screen, the launcher of the person's apps.

tabs.discover.description: Tab in the main navigation on a computer's sidebar, and on a phone the name of the Discover page, which Home's Discover section opens: the screen for finding apps and communities to join.

tabs.ai.description: Tab in the main navigation: opens the person's page with Homeroom bot, the AI that builds what people ask for (their private threads with it and their work across projects). The bot's own name. On a phone it sits under an icon in a bar of five, in one of its two wider seats; keep it within about twelve characters.

tabs.unreadAi.text: Unread messages from the Homeroom bot
tabs.unreadAi.description: Spoken name of the small count on the AI tab in the main navigation: how many messages from the Homeroom bot the person has not read.

tabs.unreadAiTitle_one.text: {{count}} unread message from the Homeroom bot
tabs.unreadAiTitle_one.description: Tooltip on the count badge of the Homeroom bot tab in the main navigation: how many messages from the Homeroom bot the person has not read.

tabs.unreadAiTitle_other.text: {{count}} unread messages from the Homeroom bot
tabs.unreadAiTitle_other.description: Tooltip on the count badge of the Homeroom bot tab in the main navigation: how many messages from the Homeroom bot the person has not read.

tabs.messages.description: Tab in the main navigation: opens the person's conversations with people and agents.

tabs.communities.description: Tab in the main navigation: opens the Communities page, which lists the communities the person pinned and the others they belong to. A community is a group that owns projects.

tabs.me.description: Last tab in the main navigation: opens the person's own profile, their account and settings. A short word for the person themselves, like "Me"; it must fit under an icon in a fifth of a phone's width.

tabs.meNamed.description: Accessible name of the profile tab when signed in. The tab shows only the word for You; this adds whose account it is. {{username}} is the person's username. Keep the word for You first.

tabs.communitiesVotes_one.description: Accessible name of the Communities tab while votes are waiting: the tab's word, then what its blue number counts. Keep the word for Communities first.

tabs.communitiesVotes_other.description: Accessible name of the Communities tab while votes are waiting: the tab's word, then what its blue number counts. Keep the word for Communities first.

tabs.votesWaiting_one.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the number badge on the Communities tab: how many proposals are waiting for this person's vote.

tabs.votesWaiting_other.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the number badge on the Communities tab: how many proposals are waiting for this person's vote.

tabs.unreadConversations.description: Accessible name of the number badge on the Messages tab. The number counts conversations with something unread, not messages.

tabs.unreadChannels.description: Accessible name of the number badge on the Communities tab. The number counts community channels that have unread messages.

tabs.stripApps.description: Small heading in the column of tabs down the side of an iPhone Duo's screen, over the app the person has open and the one they left: it divides those apps from the places above them (Home, Discover, Messages, Communities).

tabs.stripResume.description: Accessible name of the app the person left, in the Apps section of that side column: pressing it goes back into {{app}} as it was left. {{app}} is the app's name.

tabs.settings.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the cog at the foot of the desktop rail: opens Settings.

rail.communities.description: Heading over the desktop sidebar's list of communities: the ones pinned to its top, then the ones the viewer opened lately, each staying where it first arrived.

rail.search.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the small search button beside the Communities heading in the desktop sidebar: opens the list of all the person's communities with its search box ready to type in.

rail.allPlain.description: Row under the person's communities in the sidebar of a look of the frame: opens the list of every community they are in.

rail.hideSidebar.description: Accessible name of the header button that folds the desktop navigation rail away, while the rail is showing.

rail.showSidebar.description: Accessible name of the header button that brings the desktop navigation rail back, while the rail is folded away.

rail.skipToNavigation.description: Link shown only to keyboard users at the top of the page: moves focus to the main navigation.

rail.pinned.description: Heading over the desktop sidebar's list of communities when some are pinned to its top; the same heading as the list under it.

rail.app.description: First row under a community in the desktop sidebar: opens the community's app, the thing its members build and use. Shown under the community's name, so it says only App.

rail.appOf.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the App row under a community in the desktop sidebar, which opens that community's app. {{name}} is the community's name.

rail.pin.here.description: The dashed slot the desktop sidebar draws under Pinned while an app's tile is dragged over from Pinned apps: dropping the tile there pins the app's community to the sidebar.

rail.pin.already.description: The same slot when the dragged app's community is pinned to the sidebar already: dropping it would change nothing, so the drop is refused.

rail.pin.full.description: The same slot when four communities are already pinned, the most there is room for: the drop is refused until one is taken off.

rail.pin.add.description: Item in the right-click menu of a community's row in the desktop sidebar or in All communities: keeps the community in the sidebar's Pinned section, above the person's other communities.

rail.pin.newTab.description: Item in the same right-click menu: opens the community's page in a new browser tab, as the browser's own menu for a link would.

rail.pin.fullToast.text: Four communities are pinned already. Unpin one first.
rail.pin.fullToast.description: Short message shown when the person tries to pin a fifth community to the desktop sidebar: four is the most there is room for.

rail.pin.unpin.description: The one item in the right-click menu of a community pinned to the desktop sidebar, and the caption on its tile while it is dragged out of the sidebar: it takes the community off the pinned list.

parked.resume.description: Label on the strip for an app the person left running: pressing the strip returns to that app as it was left.

parked.forget.description: Accessible name of the close button on the strip for an app left running: stops keeping {{app}} open. {{app}} is the app's name.

liveApp.stillOpen.description: Added to the accessible name of an app's row or tile, after the app's name, when the app is still loaded and will resume as it was left. One item in a list of facts.

liveApp.dotTitle.description: Tooltip of the small dot on an app that is still loaded and will resume as it was left.

liveApp.close.description: Accessible name of the button that closes an app still open in the background, on its App row in the desktop sidebar. {{app}} is the app's name, such as "Chess app".

liveApp.closeTitle.description: Tooltip of that same button, shown where the green still-open dot was.

header.back.description: Accessible name of the header's back button when it returns to the previous screen.

header.closeApp.description: Accessible name of the header's back button when it closes the app on screen and returns to Home.

header.home.description: Accessible name of the header's back button when it leads to the Home screen.

header.notifications.description: Accessible name of the bell button in the header: opens the list of notifications.

header.unreadNotifications.description: Accessible name of the number badge on the header's bell button.

header.communities.description: Title in the header on the screen that lists all of the person's communities.

header.switchCommunity.description: Accessible name of the header button on a community's page: opens the list for switching to another community. {{community}} is the current community's name; keep it first.

header.homeroomMenu.description: Accessible name of the Homeroom logo button in the header: opens the main menu. Homeroom is the product's name and is not translated.

header.changeBuilding.text: One of your changes is building
header.changeBuilding.description: Tooltip on the Homeroom logo button while a spinner shows on it: a change this person asked for is being built.

header.inApp.suggest.description: Small button in the header while an app is running: opens the form for suggesting an improvement to the app on screen.

header.inApp.suggestLabel.description: Accessible name of the header's Suggest button while an app is running: opens the form for suggesting an improvement to the app on screen.

chromeless.openAppLabel.description: Accessible name of the floating pill shown when an app is displayed without Homeroom's own header and tabs: opens the same app inside Homeroom.

chromeless.open.description: Text of the floating pill shown when an app is displayed without Homeroom's own header and tabs: opens the same app inside Homeroom.

banner.viewAsNonAdmin.text.description: Banner across the top for an administrator who chose to preview Homeroom as an ordinary member.

banner.viewAsNonAdmin.switchBack.description: Button in the banner for an administrator previewing as an ordinary member: returns to the administrator view.

status.connecting.description: The header's connection status, a small pill under the top bar, while the phone or computer cannot reach Homeroom's servers; the screen shows what was saved earlier. Like a messaging app's title saying it is connecting. No full stop at the end.

status.noInternet.description: The header's connection status, a small pill under the top bar, when the device itself says it has no network connection at all. No full stop at the end.

status.updatedAt.description: Beside the header's connection status while offline: when what the screen shows was last updated from the server. {{time}} is a time of day such as 12:41, or a short date such as Nov 17 for an earlier day. No full stop at the end.

banner.restart.text.description: The header's connection status, a small pill under the top bar, for a moment while Homeroom restarts for an update; the screen reconnects by itself. Homeroom is the product's name. No full stop at the end.

list.pair.description: How two independent facts are joined when an accessible name lists several, for example "App: Recipe Box, still open, unread". {{first}} is everything said so far and {{second}} the next fact. Only the punctuation between them is translated.

common.cancel.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: abandons the dialog or the action in progress and changes nothing.

common.close.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: closes the dialog, sheet or panel it is on. Also the accessible name of an X button that does this.

common.back.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: returns to the previous screen or step.

common.retry.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: repeats a request that failed.

common.tryAgain.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: repeats an action that failed.

common.save.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: saves the form it is on.

common.done.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: finishes and closes a dialog or an editing mode when there is nothing left to confirm.

common.ok.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: acknowledges a message and closes it.

common.copy.description: Generic button, used only where the control is exactly this and nothing about the place changes its meaning: copies the text or link beside it to the clipboard.

common.copied.description: Generic confirmation shown briefly in place of a Copy button after the text or link was copied to the clipboard.

common.loading.description: Generic placeholder shown while content is being fetched, where nothing more specific is said about what is loading.

ui.passwordInput.show.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the eye button inside a password field while the password is hidden as dots: pressing it shows the typed characters.

ui.passwordInput.hide.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the eye button inside a password field while the typed characters are visible: pressing it hides them as dots again.

ui.chat.newMessages.description: Accessible name of the line drawn across a chat transcript above the first message the reader has not seen yet. Read by screen readers only.

ui.chat.newLine.description: The one word shown at the end of the line that separates messages already read from unread ones in a chat transcript. An adjective: the messages below the line are new.

join.prompt.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when a person who is not a member tries to take part (vote, post, start a change) in a community's project. {{community}} is the project or community's name. Join is a verb: become a member.

join.prompt.message.text: Members start changes, file requests, vote and chat here. Join to take part.
join.prompt.message.description: Body of the join confirmation dialog, under its title: says what members of the community can do and that joining is needed to do it. Requests are requests for a change to the project; Join is a verb.

join.prompt.join.description: Confirm button of the join confirmation dialog: makes the person a member of the community named in the title, then repeats what they were trying to do. Verb.

join.prompt.notNow.description: Cancel button of the join confirmation dialog: closes it without joining the community.

time.ago.justNow.description: Age of an item (a message, card or notification) that is less than a minute old, shown as a small stamp on its row. Lower case because it sits in the middle of a line.

time.ago.minutes_one.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} minute old. 'm' abbreviates minute; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.ago.minutes_other.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} minutes old (under an hour). 'm' abbreviates minutes; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.ago.hours_one.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} hour old. 'h' abbreviates hour; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.ago.hours_other.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} hours old (under a day). 'h' abbreviates hours; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.ago.days_one.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} day old. 'd' abbreviates day; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.ago.days_other.description: Compact age stamp on a card, list or notification row for something {{count}} days old (under a week). 'd' abbreviates days; keep it as short as the language allows.

time.reset.weekly.description: When a weekly allowance comes back, in the reader's own time zone. Used only to replace the words "Monday 00:00 UTC" inside a sentence the server wrote in English (for example "Weekly limit reached. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC."), so it must read as the end of an English sentence after "Resets". Homeroom's own sentences about a reset are whole entries elsewhere. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day.

time.reset.daily.description: When a daily allowance comes back, in the reader's own time zone. Used only to replace the words "at midnight UTC" inside a sentence the server wrote in English, so it must read as the end of an English sentence after "Resets" or "They reset". Homeroom's own sentences about a reset are whole entries elsewhere. {{time}} is the time of day.

spec.screens.afterLabel.description: Accessible name of the 'after' picture in a proposal's before/after screens: the screen as it is planned to look. {{changes}} is the author's own description of what changes on that screen.

spec.screens.beforeLabel.description: Accessible name of the 'before' picture in a proposal's before/after screens: the screen as it looks today. {{changes}} is the author's own description of what changes on that screen.

spec.screens.afterChip.description: Small chip over the 'after' picture in a proposal's before/after screens: this side shows the planned look, not something built yet. Keep the middle dot.

spec.screens.beforeChip.description: Small chip over the 'before' picture in a proposal's before/after screens: this side shows how the screen looks today. Keep the middle dot.

spec.screens.metaPhone.description: Caption under a proposal's before/after screen drawn at phone size. {{width}} and {{height}} are the screen's size in pixels; {{persona}} is the kind of viewer the screen is shown for, in the author's own word (member, admin). Keep the multiplication sign and the middle dot.

spec.screens.metaDesktop.description: Caption under a proposal's before/after screen drawn at desktop size. {{width}} and {{height}} are the screen's size in pixels; {{persona}} is the kind of viewer the screen is shown for, in the author's own word (member, admin). Keep the multiplication sign and the middle dot.

spec.screens.metaPhoneZoom.text: Phone, {{width}} × {{height}}<0> · close-up</0><1> · whole screen</1> · seen as a {{persona}}
spec.screens.metaPhoneZoom.description: Caption under a proposal's before/after screen drawn at phone size, when the picture can switch between a close-up of the changed part and the whole screen. Only one of the two tagged parts is visible at a time: <0> while the close-up is shown, <1> while the whole screen is shown, so the line must read correctly with either one alone. {{width}} and {{height}} are the size in pixels; {{persona}} is the kind of viewer, in the author's own word (member, admin).

spec.screens.metaDesktopZoom.text: Desktop, {{width}} × {{height}}<0> · close-up</0><1> · whole screen</1> · seen as a {{persona}}
spec.screens.metaDesktopZoom.description: Caption under a proposal's before/after screen drawn at desktop size, when the picture can switch between a close-up of the changed part and the whole screen. Only one of the two tagged parts is visible at a time: <0> while the close-up is shown, <1> while the whole screen is shown, so the line must read correctly with either one alone. {{width}} and {{height}} are the size in pixels; {{persona}} is the kind of viewer, in the author's own word (member, admin).

ui.chat.replies_one.description: Label of the control under a chat message that opens its thread of replies, when the thread has {{count}} reply. Reply is a noun here: a message written in answer.

ui.chat.replies_other.description: Label of the control under a chat message that opens its thread of replies. {{count}} is how many replies the thread has. Replies is a noun here: messages written in answer.

ui.cardRun.more_one.description: Row in a chat transcript that stands for cards folded away after the first of a run of cards in a row (proposals, shared items); pressing it shows them. {{count}} is how many are hidden, here one. Keep the leading ellipsis.

ui.cardRun.more_other.description: Row in a chat transcript that stands for cards folded away after the first of a run of cards in a row (proposals, shared items); pressing it shows them. {{count}} is how many are hidden. Keep the leading ellipsis.

illustration.error.type.text: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP under 20 MB.
illustration.error.type.description: Error under the picture chooser of an illustration editor (an app's featured illustration, a challenge's artwork) when the chosen file is not one of these image formats or is larger than 20 megabytes. PNG, JPEG and WebP are file format names.

illustration.error.unreadable.text: That image could not be read. Choose another image.
illustration.error.unreadable.description: Error under the picture chooser of an illustration editor when the browser could not open the chosen image file, for example because it is damaged.

illustration.error.noSize.text: Choose an image with a valid size.
illustration.error.noSize.description: Error under the picture chooser of an illustration editor when the chosen image reports no width or height, so it cannot be drawn.

illustration.error.noCanvas.text: Image editing is unavailable in this browser.
illustration.error.noCanvas.description: Error under the picture chooser of an illustration editor when the browser cannot resize images, so the chosen picture cannot be prepared for upload.

illustration.error.tooLarge.description: Error under the picture chooser of an illustration editor when the chosen picture is still over the upload limit after it was shrunk. Smaller means fewer pixels or a smaller file.

release.sentence.waiting.description: Says when a change merged into Homeroom itself goes live, on every surface that shows such a change (a change's page, a card's tooltip, a chat card): it was merged but Homeroom's next release is held up, so no time is promised. No full stop: the surrounding message adds it.

release.sentence.now.description: Says when a change merged into Homeroom itself goes live, on every surface that shows such a change (a change's page, a card's tooltip, a chat card): the Homeroom release that carries it is rolling out now. No full stop: the surrounding message adds it.

release.sentence.next.text: Merged; goes live in the next release
release.sentence.next.description: Says when a change merged into Homeroom itself goes live, on every surface that shows such a change (a change's page, a card's tooltip, a chat card): it goes out with Homeroom's next release, and no time is known yet. No full stop: the surrounding message adds it.

release.sentence.minutes_one.text: Merged; goes live in the next release (in about a minute)
release.sentence.minutes_one.description: Says when a change merged into Homeroom itself goes live, on every surface that shows such a change (a change's page, a card's tooltip, a chat card): it goes out with Homeroom's next release, expected in about {{count}} minute. English spells the one minute out; a translation may use {{count}}. No full stop: the surrounding message adds it.

release.sentence.minutes_other.text: Merged; goes live in the next release (about {{count}} minutes)
release.sentence.minutes_other.description: Says when a change merged into Homeroom itself goes live, on every surface that shows such a change (a change's page, a card's tooltip, a chat card): it goes out with Homeroom's next release, expected in about {{count}} minutes. No full stop: the surrounding message adds it.

release.countLine.waiting_one.text: {{count}} merged change waiting for a release
release.countLine.waiting_one.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} change (here 1) was merged and Homeroom's next release, which would carry it, is held up.

release.countLine.waiting_other.text: {{count}} merged changes waiting for a release
release.countLine.waiting_other.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} changes were merged and Homeroom's next release, which would carry them, is held up.

release.countLine.now_one.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged change (here 1) is going live now, as the Homeroom release that carries it rolls out.

release.countLine.now_other.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged changes are going live now, as the Homeroom release that carries them rolls out.

release.countLine.next_one.text: {{count}} merged change goes live in the next release
release.countLine.next_one.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged change (here 1) goes out with Homeroom's next release, and no time is known yet.

release.countLine.next_other.text: {{count}} merged changes go live in the next release
release.countLine.next_other.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged changes go out together with Homeroom's next release, and no time is known yet.

release.countLine.estimate_one.text: {{count}} merged change goes live in the next release ({{eta}})
release.countLine.estimate_one.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged change (here 1) goes out with Homeroom's next release. {{eta}} is when that release is expected, worded on its own, for example "about 8 minutes" or "in about a minute".

release.countLine.estimate_other.text: {{count}} merged changes go live in the next release ({{eta}})
release.countLine.estimate_other.description: Status line at the top of Homeroom's own Workshop board "Done" column: {{count}} merged changes go out together with Homeroom's next release. {{eta}} is when that release is expected, worded on its own, for example "about 8 minutes" or "in about a minute".

release.countLine.eta_one.description: When Homeroom's next release is expected, placed in brackets after "… merged changes go live in the next release" on the Workshop board's "Done" column: in about {{count}} minute. English spells the one minute out; a translation may use {{count}}. Lower case because it sits inside that line.

release.countLine.eta_other.description: When Homeroom's next release is expected, placed in brackets after "… merged changes go live in the next release" on the Workshop board's "Done" column: in about {{count}} minutes. Lower case because it sits inside that line.

sectionColumn.label.description: Accessible name of the column beside a project's page on a wide screen that lists its places (its chat, its topics and its tabs).

dictation.speak.description: Microphone button: records speech to add to the current text field.

dictation.stop.description: Button: finishes the recording and transcribes it into the text field.

dictation.permission.description: Status while the browser microphone permission prompt is open.

dictation.transcribing.description: Status while a finished recording is being transcribed.

dictation.cancel.description: Button: discards the recording or pending transcription and keeps existing text.

dictation.listening.text: Listening… Press Stop when you finish.
dictation.listening.description: Status while recording speech, with instructions for finishing.

dictation.error.permission.text: Allow microphone access in your browser or device settings, then try again.
dictation.error.permission.description: Dictation error when microphone access was denied.

dictation.error.policy.text: Microphone access is blocked on this page. You can still type your message.
dictation.error.policy.description: Dictation error when the page's permissions policy prevents microphone access. Browser microphone settings cannot override this restriction.

dictation.error.unsupported.text: Speaking is unavailable in this browser. You can still type your message.
dictation.error.unsupported.description: Dictation error when recording is unsupported.

dictation.error.unavailable.text: Your microphone could not start. Check that it is connected, then try again.
dictation.error.unavailable.description: Dictation error when a microphone cannot be opened.

dictation.error.interrupted.text: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Your existing text is safe. Try again.
dictation.error.interrupted.description: Dictation error when microphone capture is interrupted.

dictation.error.invalidAudio.text: That recording could not be read. Try a recording under one minute.
dictation.error.invalidAudio.description: Dictation error for invalid or over-limit audio.

dictation.error.noSpeech.text: No speech was heard. Try again and speak closer to the microphone.
dictation.error.noSpeech.description: Dictation error when the recording was silent or had no transcript.

dictation.error.keyRequired.text: Your AI connection is unavailable. Check AI usage & models in Settings, then try again.
dictation.error.keyRequired.description: Dictation error when the account’s managed or personal AI credential is unavailable.

dictation.error.credits.text: Your AI credits have run out. Add credits in Settings, then try again.
dictation.error.credits.description: Dictation error when the transcription provider reports exhausted credits.

dictation.error.tooLong.text: Those words would exceed this field’s limit. Shorten your text and try again.
dictation.error.tooLong.description: Dictation error when appending the transcript would exceed the current field character limit.

dictation.error.timeout.text: Transcription took too long. Your existing text is safe. Try again.
dictation.error.timeout.description: Dictation error after a transcription timeout.

dictation.error.busy.text: Please wait a moment before recording again.
dictation.error.busy.description: Dictation error for concurrent requests or a rate limit.

dictation.error.failed.text: Your recording could not be transcribed. Your existing text is safe. Try again.
dictation.error.failed.description: Dictation error for an unsuccessful transcription request.

header.drawer.toHub.description: On a phone, the header's back arrow on one of a community's places (Needs you, Workshop, a channel): goes up to the community's Hub, the page that leads to all of them. {{community}} is the community's name. Its accessible name and tooltip.

header.drawer.toPlace.description: On a phone, the header's back arrow on a page under one of a community's places (All items, under the Workshop): goes up to that place. {{place}} is the place's name, such as Workshop. Its accessible name and tooltip.

header.drawer.messages.description: On a phone, the header's title over the list of the person's conversations, when the conversations are drawn as the navigation drawer's outer level.

header.drawer.toMessages.description: On a phone, the header's back arrow in a conversation: slides back to the list of the person's conversations.

work.stage.reading.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, is reading the request, or it waits to be read.

work.stage.notStarted.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: nobody has started on the request yet: it waits in Homeroom bot's line, or for anyone to pick it up.

work.stage.readyToBuild.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: Homeroom bot read it and will build it, but it waits its turn among the project's builds.

work.stage.planning.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: Homeroom bot is writing its plan for the request.

work.stage.waitingForYou.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: it is the requester's move (shown to them).

work.stage.building.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: the change for it is being built.

work.stage.checking.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change's tests are running, or some failed.

work.stage.syncing.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change conflicts with main and Homeroom is resolving that now or next, with nobody asked for anything.

work.stage.shots.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change's tests passed, and Homeroom is taking the before and after screenshots people look at before they vote. Nothing else is left before it goes on, and nobody is asked for anything.

work.stage.upForVote.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change is waiting for the group's votes.

work.stage.approved.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change has the votes its project's rule needs, and it is waiting on its own checks or on GitHub's required checks before it goes live.

work.stage.goingLive.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change was approved and is being put live.

work.stage.waitingToMerge.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change was approved and tested, and GitHub has not merged it yet because GitHub's own required checks are still running or it is held back for a moment.

work.stage.stuck.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen. The stage word: its change was approved, but GitHub's own required checks never passed after many tries, so Homeroom stopped trying to merge it until the change or the project's main code moves.

work.stage.live.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change is live.

work.stage.stopped.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: Homeroom bot stopped working on it; a person can start it again.

work.stage.closed.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: the request or the change was closed.

work.stage.fixing.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). The stage word: its change's failing check is not the change's own, and Homeroom bot is getting that check itself fixed first, so nobody is asked for anything.

work.why.question.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to the requester: Homeroom bot asked them a question and waits for the answer.

work.why.plan.text: Waiting for you to OK the plan
work.why.plan.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to the requester: Homeroom bot wrote a plan and waits for them to say build it.

work.why.decide.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to the requester: Homeroom bot handed it back because a person must decide what to do.

work.why.alreadyWorks.text: It may already work: close it?
work.why.alreadyWorks.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to the requester: Homeroom bot found that what was asked for is already there, so it can be closed.

work.why.needsDetail.text: Waiting for more detail from you
work.why.needsDetail.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to the requester: Homeroom bot could not tell what to build and needs more detail.

work.whyOthers.question.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to someone other than the requester: Homeroom bot asked the requester a question.

work.whyOthers.plan.text: Waiting for the plan to be OK'd
work.whyOthers.plan.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to someone other than the requester: Homeroom bot's plan waits for the requester's go-ahead.

work.whyOthers.decide.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to someone other than the requester: a person must decide what to do with it.

work.whyOthers.alreadyWorks.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to someone other than the requester: Homeroom bot found what was asked for already there.

work.whyOthers.needsDetail.description: Where a request or a change stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Shown to someone other than the requester: Homeroom bot needs more detail to build it.

work.handBack.others.description: Where a request stands, the same words on every screen (the Homeroom bot tab, the chat's drawer, a request's page, a project's chat, the bell). Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, left the request for a person to decide, and the person who decides on this project is not the one who asked for it. {{username}} is that person's username, shown after an @.

work.handBack.othersMany.text: Waiting for the project's admins to decide
work.handBack.othersMany.description: Where a request stands, the same words on every screen. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, left the request for a person to decide, and the people who decide on this project (its creator and admins) are not the one who asked for it.

work.handBack.operatorWork.text: Waiting on setup outside the app
work.handBack.operatorWork.description: Where a request stands, the same words on every screen. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, cannot build the request until somebody with access sets something up outside the app first (for example an outside account or a setting on the project).

work.handBack.destructiveDb.text: Needs a person: it changes stored data
work.handBack.destructiveDb.description: Where a request stands, the same words on every screen. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, leaves the request to a person because building it would change data the app already stores in a way that could lose some of it.

work.handBack.platform.text: About Homeroom itself: put it on Homeroom's board?
work.handBack.platform.description: Where a request stands, shown to the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, found the request is about Homeroom, the platform, not about this project, and offers to put a copy on Homeroom's own board of requests.

work.handBack.otherProject.text: About another project: move it there?
work.handBack.otherProject.description: Where a request stands, shown to the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, found the request is about a different project than the one it was filed on, and offers to move it there.

work.handBack.wrongProject.text: Filed on the wrong project: close it?
work.handBack.wrongProject.description: Where a request stands, shown to the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, found the request was filed on the wrong project, and offers a vote on closing it here.

work.handBack.close.description: Where a request stands, shown to the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, found nothing to build (the person asked to drop it, or it only asked for an explanation, which Homeroom bot gave), and offers a vote on closing it.

work.handBack.blocked.text: Can't be built as written: add detail
work.handBack.blocked.description: Where a request stands, shown to the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot, read the code and found the request cannot be built as it is written; more detail from them lets it look again.

work.handBackOthers.others.description: Where a request stands, shown to anyone but the person who asked for it. Homeroom bot left the request for a person to decide, and the person who decides on this project is {{username}}, shown after an @.

work.handBackOthers.othersMany.text: Waiting for the project's admins to decide
