topics.field.aboutPlaceholder.text: One line people see at the top of the channel
topics.field.aboutPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the "What it is for" field in the Topics dialog: the line people see at the top of the topic's channel.

topics.field.into.description: Label of the menu in the Topics dialog for choosing the topic another topic is merged into.

topics.field.intoPlaceholder.description: First, unselectable choice of the menu in the Topics dialog for the topic another topic is merged into: asks the person to pick one.

topics.merge.hint.text: Its requests and their votes move to the topic you choose. Its channel stays, read only, with its history.
topics.merge.hint.description: Hint under the "Merge into" menu in the Topics dialog: what merging a topic does to its requests and to its chat channel.

topics.archive.hint.text: Its channel stays, read only, with its history. Its requests are sorted into the other topics again.
topics.archive.hint.description: Text of the Topics dialog's form for archiving a topic: what archiving does to its chat channel and to the requests filed under it.

topics.submit.idle.description: Submit button of the Topics dialog's form: opens a pull request (a proposal) with the topic change for the group's vote. PR is short for pull request.

topics.submit.busy.description: Submit button of the Topics dialog's form while the pull request (proposal) with the topic change is being opened. PR is short for pull request.

topics.status.opened.text: "{{title}}" is up for a vote. It applies once voted in.
topics.status.opened.description: Confirmation in the Topics dialog after a topic change was proposed. {{title}} is the proposal's title, for example Add the topic Onboarding; keep the quotation marks as the language writes them.

topics.status.openedUntitled.text: "Topic change" is up for a vote. It applies once voted in.
topics.status.openedUntitled.description: Confirmation in the Topics dialog after a topic change was proposed, when the proposal's title is not known: "Topic change" stands in for the title, in quotation marks.

topics.proposals.heading.description: Small heading in the Topics dialog over the list of topic changes that were proposed and are not voted in yet.

topics.proposals.untitled.description: Title of a row in the Topics dialog's "Waiting for a vote" list when the proposed topic change has no title of its own.

topics.proposals.number.description: Second line of a row in the Topics dialog's "Waiting for a vote" list: the proposal's number. {{number}} is the pull request number, for example 4417; keep the #.

topics.archived.heading.description: Small heading in the Topics dialog over the list of topics that were archived or merged into another topic.

topics.error.nameShort.text: A topic needs a name of at least 3 characters.
topics.error.nameShort.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the topic's name is shorter than 3 characters.

topics.error.nameLong.text: A topic's name is 48 characters at most.
topics.error.nameLong.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the topic's name is longer than 48 characters.

topics.error.aboutLong.text: What it is for is one line: 140 characters at most.
topics.error.aboutLong.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the "What it is for" line is longer than 140 characters. "What it is for" is that field's label.

topics.error.notLive.text: That topic is not live any more.
topics.error.notLive.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the topic being renamed was archived or merged in the meantime.

topics.error.unchanged.text: Change the name, the channel or what it is for first.
topics.error.unchanged.description: Error in the Topics dialog when a rename is submitted without changing the name, the channel handle or the "What it is for" line.

topics.error.chooseInto.text: Choose the topic to merge it into.
topics.error.chooseInto.description: Error in the Topics dialog when a merge is submitted before a topic to merge into was chosen.

topics.error.open.text: Could not open the proposal. Try again.
topics.error.open.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the server refused to open the topic change's proposal and gave no reason of its own.

topics.error.network.text: Network error while opening the proposal.
topics.error.network.description: Error in the Topics dialog when the request to open the topic change's proposal did not reach the server.

whoDecides.title.description: Title of the sheet where a project's creator or admin chooses who can see the project and how its changes are approved.

whoDecides.sub.description: Line under the sheet's title. {{name}} is the project's name; {{audience}} says who it is for and how many are in it, for example "Private community · 3 members".

whoDecides.back.description: Accessible name of the round back button at the top of a screen inside the Who can see & change it sheet.

whoDecides.close.description: Accessible name of the round close button at the top of the Who can see & change it sheet.

whoDecides.picked.description: Accessible name of the check mark beside the option chosen in a list on the Who can see & change it sheet.

whoDecides.now.description: Small badge on the approval option the project uses today.

whoDecides.waitingTitle.text: Another change is up for a vote too
whoDecides.waitingTitle.description: Summary heading when something was changed and another change to who can see and change it is already up for a vote; competing changes are allowed, so this one can still be proposed.

whoDecides.waitingSub.text: A change to who can see and change it is already up for a vote. If both pass, the later one may overwrite the earlier.
whoDecides.waitingSub.description: Warning line in the summary when another change to who can see and change it is already up for a vote; followed by a link that opens it.

whoDecides.open.description: Link or button that opens the proposal the sheet is talking about.

whoDecides.see.title.description: Section label over the two choices of who can open the project.

whoDecides.see.private.description: Choice: only the project's members can open it.

whoDecides.see.privateSub.description: Line under the Private community choice on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: only the project's members can open it. "Open" is a verb.

whoDecides.see.public.description: Choice: anyone can open the project and join it.

whoDecides.see.publicSub.text: Anyone can open it and join.
whoDecides.see.publicSub.description: Line under the Public community choice on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: anyone can open the project and become a member. "Open" and "join" are verbs.

whoDecides.see.note.text: Everyone who can see it can suggest changes. The rule below decides what goes live.
whoDecides.see.note.description: Note under the two visibility choices on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set. "Suggest changes" means propose them; "the rule below" is the approval rule picked next, which decides which changes go live.

whoDecides.see.limitedName.description: Name of an older setting some projects still have: anyone can see the project, only collaborators can build it.

whoDecides.see.limitedNote.text: Today anyone can see it, and only its collaborators can build it. Picking Public community lets everyone who joins suggest changes.
whoDecides.see.limitedNote.description: Note under the visibility choices for a project still on the older public, invite-only building setting.

whoDecides.rule.title.description: Small section label on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set, over the four presets for how a project's changes get approved by vote. Keep it short.

whoDecides.publicWarning.text: Anyone can join a public community, so under this rule anyone who joins can approve changes.
whoDecides.publicWarning.description: Warning shown when a public community is paired with Open floor or Two yeses.

whoDecides.legacyName.description: Name for an older approval setting that none of the four presets matches, in the list of changes to propose.

whoDecides.legacyNote.text: This project uses an older approval setting. Pick one below to change it.
whoDecides.legacyNote.description: Note above the presets when the project's current rule is an older setting none of them matches.

whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.name.description: Preset name, as the project's creator reads it: a change goes live on the creator's yes, or when most of the group says yes.

whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.nameO.description: The same preset's name as everyone but its creator reads it. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.line.text: Your yes ships any change. So does a yes from most of the group.
whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.line.description: Line under the You or the group preset, for the creator: a change goes live once the creator says yes (proposing a change is not a yes; the creator taps Yes on their own changes too), or once most of the group says yes.

whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.lineO.text: A yes from {{creator}} ships any change. So does a yes from most of the group.
whoDecides.preset.you_or_the_group.lineO.description: Line under the same preset for anyone but the creator. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.preset.two_yeses.name.description: Preset name: a change goes live once any two people say yes; whoever made it may be one of them.

whoDecides.preset.two_yeses.line.text: Any two people say yes, whoever made it among them. While it’s just you, your yes is enough.
whoDecides.preset.two_yeses.line.description: Line under the Two yeses preset on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: a change goes live once two people tap Yes, and the person who made it may be one of them (making it is not a yes); a project of one needs only that person's yes.

whoDecides.preset.open_floor.name.description: Preset name: any member's yes puts a change live, even on their own change.

whoDecides.preset.open_floor.line.text: Any member’s yes ships a change, even their own.
whoDecides.preset.open_floor.line.description: Line under the Open floor preset on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: one yes from any member puts a change live, even a yes on a change that member made. "Ships" means goes live.

whoDecides.preset.group_vote.name.description: Preset name: the platform's usual vote, most active members say yes, or a wait with no objections.

whoDecides.preset.group_vote.line.text: Most active members say yes, or it goes live after a wait if nobody objects.
whoDecides.preset.group_vote.line.description: Line under the Group vote preset on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: the usual vote, where most recently active members say yes, or a change goes live after a waiting period when nobody votes no.

whoDecides.plays.title.description: Section label over the rows showing what the picked rule means: one row for anyone, or two, for the reader and for anyone else.

whoDecides.plays.anyoneTitle.description: Row title under How it plays out, for a rule that treats every change alike (Two yeses, Open floor, Group vote, or a project's own rules): what happens to a change anyone makes, the reader's included.

whoDecides.plays.youTitle.description: Row title under How it plays out, for You or the group: what happens to a change the reader makes.

whoDecides.plays.anyoneElseTitle.description: Row title under How it plays out, for You or the group, below the row You make a change: what happens to a change anyone other than the reader makes.

whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.you.text: Your yes is enough. Live once its checks pass.
whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.you.description: You or the group, for a change the creator makes.

whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.other.text: Live when you say yes, or when most of the group does.
whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.other.description: You or the group, for a change someone else makes, as the creator reads it.

whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.youOth.text: Live when {{creator}} says yes, or when most of the group does.
whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.youOth.description: You or the group, for a change the reader makes, when the reader is not the creator. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.otherO.text: Live when {{creator}} says yes, or when most of the group does.
whoDecides.plays.you_or_the_group.otherO.description: You or the group, for a change someone else makes, when the reader is not the creator.

whoDecides.plays.two_yeses.anyone.text: Live once two people say yes. Its maker’s yes can be one of them.
whoDecides.plays.two_yeses.anyone.description: Two yeses, under the row Anyone makes a change: two people tapping Yes put it live, and the person who made the change may be one of them (making it is not a yes).

whoDecides.plays.open_floor.anyone.text: Their own yes is enough. Live once its checks pass.
whoDecides.plays.open_floor.anyone.description: Open floor, under the row Anyone makes a change: "their" is whoever made the change, whose own yes puts it live.

whoDecides.plays.group_vote.anyone.text: Live when most active members say yes, or after a wait if nobody objects.
whoDecides.plays.group_vote.anyone.description: Group vote, under the row Anyone makes a change: the group decides, whoever made the change.

whoDecides.plays.own.anyone.text: Live when any one of its rules passes. Their own yes counts toward the rules they’re in.
whoDecides.plays.own.anyone.description: A project's own rules, under the row Anyone makes a change: one passing rule puts a change live. "Their" and "they" are whoever made the change, whose own yes counts in each rule whose group includes them.

whoDecides.alwaysYou.text: Changing who can see it, its admins or this rule always works like You or the group: your yes is enough, or the group’s real yes votes are.
whoDecides.alwaysYou.description: Note under How it plays out, for the creator: changes to who decides follow a fixed rule whatever is picked.

whoDecides.alwaysCreator.text: Changing who can see it, its admins or this rule always works like You or the group: {{creator}}’s yes is enough, or the group’s real yes votes are.
whoDecides.alwaysCreator.description: The same note for anyone but the creator. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.own.name.description: Option and screen title: build the project's own approval rule from groups and rules.

whoDecides.own.sub.text: Groups and rules, starting from the one picked above.
whoDecides.own.sub.description: Line under the Make your own option on the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: opens a screen to build custom groups and approval rules, prefilled from the preset picked above.

whoDecides.own.picked_one.text: Your own rule. Tap to change it.
whoDecides.own.picked_one.description: Line under Make your own when the project's own rules are picked, with one rule.

whoDecides.own.picked_other.text: Your own {{count}} rules. Tap to change them.
whoDecides.own.picked_other.description: Line under Make your own when the project's own rules are picked. {{count}} is how many rules.

whoDecides.own.startedFrom.description: Line under the Make your own title. {{name}} is the project; {{preset}} is the preset the rules started from.

whoDecides.own.same.description: Shown on Make your own when the rules are exactly one of the presets. {{preset}} is its name.

whoDecides.own.rules.text: Rules · any one passing is enough
whoDecides.own.rules.description: Small section label on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules, over the list of approval rules: a change goes live when any one of them passes. "Rules" is a plural noun.

whoDecides.own.or.description: Word between two rules in the list: either rule passing is enough.

whoDecides.own.addRule.description: Tappable row at the end of the rule list on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules: opens a screen to create a new approval rule. "Add" is a verb; "rule" is a noun.

whoDecides.own.ruleCount_one.description: How many rules there are out of the most allowed, with one rule. {{max}} is the limit.

whoDecides.own.ruleCount_other.description: How many rules there are out of the most allowed. {{max}} is the limit.

whoDecides.own.groups.description: Section label over the groups a rule can name.

whoDecides.own.addGroup.description: Tappable row at the end of the group list on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules: opens a screen to create a new named group of members. "Add" is a verb.

whoDecides.own.alwaysOn.description: Section label over the fixed rule for changes to who decides.

whoDecides.own.alwaysTitle.description: Title of the fixed row under Always on, on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules: the rule for changes to who can decide (visibility, admins, groups and rules). Noun phrase, not an instruction.

whoDecides.own.alwaysSub.text: Who can see it, its admins, its groups and these rules: {{creator}} says yes, or the group does with real yes votes.
whoDecides.own.alwaysSub.description: What the fixed rule says. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.own.alwaysSubNobody.text: Who can see it, its admins, its groups and these rules: the group says yes with real yes votes.
whoDecides.own.alwaysSubNobody.description: What the fixed rule says on a project with no creator.

whoDecides.own.use.description: Button: take the rules back to the main sheet, where they are proposed.

whoDecides.own.useNote.text: Nothing changes until you propose it. It follows the Always on rule.
whoDecides.own.useNote.description: Note under the Use these rules button on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules: the rules take effect only once proposed and voted in, and that vote follows the fixed Always on rule.

whoDecides.own.problem.noRules.description: Error on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules when the person tries to use an empty list of rules. "Add" is a verb.

whoDecides.own.problem.tooManyRules.text: A project has at most {{max}} rules.
whoDecides.own.problem.tooManyRules.description: Error on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules when the list has more approval rules than allowed. {{max}} is the limit, a number.

whoDecides.own.problem.tooManyGroups.text: A project has at most {{max}} groups of its own.
whoDecides.own.problem.tooManyGroups.description: Error: too many named groups. {{max}} is the limit.

whoDecides.own.problem.missingGroup.text: A rule names a group that is gone. Change or remove that rule.
whoDecides.own.problem.missingGroup.description: Error: a rule refers to a group that was deleted.

whoDecides.own.problem.duplicate.text: That rule is already on the list.
whoDecides.own.problem.duplicate.description: Error on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project builds its own approval rules when the same approval rule was added twice.

whoDecides.group.creator.description: Built-in group: the person who made the project.

whoDecides.group.creatorNobody.text: Nobody: this project has no creator
whoDecides.group.creatorNobody.description: Line under the Creator group on a project that has no creator by design, such as Homeroom's own project. Keep it distinct from a creator whose account no longer exists.

whoDecides.group.creatorGone.text: The account that made this project no longer exists
whoDecides.group.creatorGone.description: Line under the Creator group on the Who can see & change it sheet when the person who made the project deleted their account.

whoDecides.group.members.description: Built-in group: everyone in the project's community.

whoDecides.group.membersSub_one.text: {{count}} person, updates as people join and leave
whoDecides.group.membersSub_one.description: Line under the built-in All members group on the Who can see & change it sheet, when the project has one member: the group follows people joining and leaving the project. {{count}} is that number.

whoDecides.group.membersSub_other.text: {{count}} people, updates as people join and leave
whoDecides.group.membersSub_other.description: Line under All members. {{count}} is how many people are in it.

whoDecides.group.admins.description: Built-in group: the project's admins, set in Members.

whoDecides.group.builtIn.description: Small badge beside a group Homeroom defines itself (Creator, All members, App admins) on the Who can see & change it sheet: it cannot be renamed or deleted. Adjective, keep it short.

whoDecides.group.nobody.description: Line under a group that has no people in it yet, on the Make your own screen of the Who can see & change it sheet.

whoDecides.group.keptByApp.description: Small badge beside a group the project's app keeps, on the Groups list of the Who can see & change it sheet, where built-in groups say Built in. The app, not a person, decides who is in it.

whoDecides.group.keptByAppSub_one.text: {{count}} person, the app keeps this list
whoDecides.group.keptByAppSub_one.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps, when it has one person. {{count}} is that number.

whoDecides.group.keptByAppSub_other.text: {{count}} people, the app keeps this list
whoDecides.group.keptByAppSub_other.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps. {{count}} is how many people the app last reported.

whoDecides.group.appGroupSub_one.text: {{count}} person · sent {{when}} · Not in the rules yet
whoDecides.group.appGroupSub_one.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps that no rule uses yet, on the Groups list of the Who can see & change it sheet, when it has one person. {{count}} is that number and {{when}} is how long ago the app sent its list, such as 5m ago.

whoDecides.group.appGroupSub_other.text: {{count}} people · sent {{when}} · Not in the rules yet
whoDecides.group.appGroupSub_other.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps that no rule uses yet, on the Groups list of the Who can see & change it sheet. {{count}} is how many people are in it and {{when}} is how long ago the app sent its list, such as 5m ago.

whoDecides.group.appGroupNotSent.text: Not sent yet · Not in the rules yet
whoDecides.group.appGroupNotSent.description: Line under a group the project's app made but has not sent its member list for, on the Groups list of the Who can see & change it sheet.

whoDecides.group.appGroupNoMatch.text: Your app hasn't sent a group called this yet. Check the name matches the one your app uses.
whoDecides.group.appGroupNoMatch.description: Warning on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, when a person turns on The app keeps this group and types a name the app has never sent. Saving and proposing are still allowed: the app might send it later.

whoDecides.group.keptSwitch.description: Switch on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet: when on, the project's app decides who is in the group and nobody picks people by hand.

whoDecides.group.keptSwitchSub.text: Your app tells Homeroom who is in it. Nobody picks people here.
whoDecides.group.keptSwitchSub.description: Line under the The app keeps this group switch, saying what turning it on means.

whoDecides.group.keptReported.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps, saying when the app last sent its member list. {{when}} is a date and time.

whoDecides.group.keptNever.text: The app has not sent its list yet. Until it does, this group has nobody in it.
whoDecides.group.keptNever.description: Line under a group the project's app keeps, before the app has ever reported its members.

whoDecides.group.title.description: Title of the screen that edits a named group.

whoDecides.group.newTitle.description: Title of the screen that makes a named group.

whoDecides.group.sub.description: Line under a group or rule screen's title. {{name}} is the project.

whoDecides.group.name.description: Label of the text field for the group's name on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited. "Name" is a noun.

whoDecides.group.people_one.description: Section label over the group's people, with one person.

whoDecides.group.people_other.description: Section label over the group's people. {{count}} is how many.

whoDecides.group.removePerson.description: Accessible name of the button that takes a person out of the group. {{name}} is their username.

whoDecides.group.add.description: Label before the buttons that add members to the group.

whoDecides.group.note.text: Only members of {{name}} can be in a group.
whoDecides.group.note.description: Note under the group's people. {{name}} is the project.

whoDecides.group.usedBy_one.description: Section label over the rules that name this group, with one.

whoDecides.group.usedBy_other.description: Section label over the rules that name this group. {{count}} is how many.

whoDecides.group.whoDecides.text: Changing who’s in a group changes who decides, so it follows the Always on rule when you propose it.
whoDecides.group.whoDecides.description: Note on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited: changing a group's people changes who approves changes, so saving it is proposed under the fixed Always on rule.

whoDecides.group.save.description: Button on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited: keeps the group's name and people. "Save" is a verb; keep it short.

whoDecides.group.delete.description: Button on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited: removes the group. "Delete" is a verb; keep it short.

whoDecides.group.cannotDelete.text: A rule uses this group. Remove the rule first to delete it.
whoDecides.group.cannotDelete.description: Note in place of Delete group when a rule names the group.

whoDecides.group.problem.blank.description: Error on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited when the group's name field is empty.

whoDecides.group.problem.long.text: A group’s name is at most {{max}} characters.
whoDecides.group.problem.long.description: Error: the group's name is too long. {{max}} is the limit.

whoDecides.group.problem.builtIn.text: {{name}} is a built-in group. Name yours something else.
whoDecides.group.problem.builtIn.description: Error: the name is taken by a built-in group. {{name}} is what was typed.

whoDecides.group.problem.taken.text: Another group already has that name.
whoDecides.group.problem.taken.description: Error on the group screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a named group of members is edited when another group of the project already has the typed name.

whoDecides.rule.newTitle.description: Title of the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, when creating a new rule. "Rule" is a noun: one approval rule, not the verb "to rule".

whoDecides.rule.editTitle.description: Title of the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, when editing an existing rule. "Rule" is a noun: one approval rule, not the verb "to rule". One word, keep it short.

whoDecides.rule.sentence.description: The rule being edited, said as one sentence. {{rule}} is the rule, for example "At least 2 people in Lifeguards say yes".

whoDecides.rule.whose.description: Section label over the groups a rule can count.

whoDecides.rule.howMany.description: Section label over the ways a rule can count yeses.

whoDecides.rule.kind.atLeast.description: Way to count: at least this many yeses from the group.

whoDecides.rule.kind.atLeastSub.text: Never more than the group has, so it keeps working if someone leaves.
whoDecides.rule.kind.atLeastSub.description: Line under the A number of people option on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: the required number is capped at the group's size, so the rule still works when someone leaves.

whoDecides.rule.kind.percentOfActive.description: Way to count: a share of the group's people who have been around lately.

whoDecides.rule.kind.percentOfActiveSub.text: Only people active lately count, the way Group vote does.
whoDecides.rule.kind.percentOfActiveSub.description: Line under the % of the active people option on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: only people who used the project recently are counted, as the Group vote preset does.

whoDecides.rule.kind.percentOfEveryone.description: Way to count: a share of everyone in the group.

whoDecides.rule.kind.percentOfEveryoneSu.description: Line under the % of everyone in the group option on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: everyone in the group is counted, whether recently active or not. A short fragment.

whoDecides.rule.kind.majority.description: Way to count: the platform's usual vote over the group.

whoDecides.rule.kind.majoritySub.text: Group vote’s math: the bar eases as more people are active, and one yes with no objections goes live after a wait.
whoDecides.rule.kind.majoritySub.description: Line under the Majority over time option on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: it uses the Group vote preset's counting, where fewer yeses are needed as more people are active and a single unopposed yes goes live after a wait. "Math" means calculation.

whoDecides.rule.people.description: Label of the stepper that sets how many yeses a rule needs.

whoDecides.rule.percent.description: Label of the stepper that sets a rule's share.

whoDecides.rule.percentValue.description: A share, as the stepper shows it. {{percent}} is a whole number from 1 to 100.

whoDecides.rule.fewer.description: Accessible name of the stepper's minus button.

whoDecides.rule.more.description: Accessible name of the stepper's plus button.

whoDecides.rule.min.title.description: Switch on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, under How many, for a Majority over time or % rule: turns on a fewest number of yeses the rule needs.

whoDecides.rule.min.sub.text: It can’t go live on fewer yeses than this. Never more than the group has, so it keeps working if someone leaves.
whoDecides.rule.min.sub.description: Line under the Also need a minimum switch on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: the rule never passes on fewer yeses than the number set, and the number is capped at the group's size.

whoDecides.rule.min.label.description: Label of the stepper that sets a rule's minimum number of yeses, on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited. The number follows it, so it reads "At least 10".

whoDecides.rule.today.title.description: Section label over what the rule asks for with the project as it is now.

whoDecides.rule.yesesOnly.text: Only yeses count toward a rule. No votes don’t stop it, though enough of them can still close a change nobody wants.
whoDecides.rule.yesesOnly.description: Note under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: only yes votes count toward a rule passing; no votes do not block it, but enough no votes can still close a change. "Close" means reject and set aside.

whoDecides.rule.save.description: Button on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited: keeps the rule and returns to the list. "Save" is a verb; keep it short.

whoDecides.rule.remove.description: Button or accessible name: take a rule off the list.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.creator.description: A rule, said as a clause. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.creatorNobody.description: The creator rule on a project with no creator.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.atLeast_one.text: At least {{count}} person in {{group}} says yes
whoDecides.rule.phrase.atLeast_one.description: A rule, said as a clause, asking for one yes. {{group}} is a group's name.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.atLeast_other.text: At least {{count}} people in {{group}} say yes
whoDecides.rule.phrase.atLeast_other.description: A rule, said as a clause. {{count}} is how many yeses; {{group}} is a group's name.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActive.text: {{percent}}% of the active people in {{group}} say yes
whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActive.description: A rule, said as a clause. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActiveMi.text: {{percent}}% of the active people in {{group}} say yes, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActiveMi.description: A rule, said as a clause, with a minimum number of yeses. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActiveMi.text: {{percent}}% of the active people in {{group}} say yes, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfActiveMi.description: A rule, said as a clause, with a minimum number of yeses. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfEveryone.description: A rule, said as a clause. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfEveryone.text: {{percent}}% of everyone in {{group}} says yes, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfEveryone.description: A rule, said as a clause, with a minimum number of yeses. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfEveryone.text: {{percent}}% of everyone in {{group}} says yes, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.percentOfEveryone.description: A rule, said as a clause, with a minimum number of yeses. {{percent}} is a whole number; {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.majority.text: Most active people in {{group}} say yes, over time
whoDecides.rule.phrase.majority.description: A rule, said as a clause: the platform's usual vote over a group. {{group}} is a group's name.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.majorityMin_one.text: Most active people in {{group}} say yes, over time, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.majorityMin_one.description: A rule, said as a clause: the platform's usual vote over a group, with a minimum number of yeses. {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.phrase.majorityMin_other.text: Most active people in {{group}} say yes, over time, and at least {{count}} of them
whoDecides.rule.phrase.majorityMin_other.description: A rule, said as a clause: the platform's usual vote over a group, with a minimum number of yeses. {{group}} is a group's name; {{count}} is the minimum.

whoDecides.rule.today.empty.text: Can’t pass until {{group}} has someone in it.
whoDecides.rule.today.empty.description: What a rule on an empty group asks for. {{group}} is the group's name.

whoDecides.rule.today.creator.description: What the creator rule asks for. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.rule.today.atLeast_one.text: Needs {{count}} yes today. Never more than the group has.
whoDecides.rule.today.atLeast_one.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a rule needing a number of people, when it needs one yes: {{count}} is 1; the number never exceeds the group's size.

whoDecides.rule.today.atLeast_other.text: Needs {{count}} yeses today. Never more than the group has.
whoDecides.rule.today.atLeast_other.description: What a count rule asks for today. {{count}} is how many yeses.

whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfEveryone.text: Needs {{need}} of {{total}} today, active or not.
whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfEveryone.description: What a share-of-everyone rule asks for today. {{need}} yeses out of {{total}} people.

whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActive.text: Counts only people who have been active lately.
whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActive.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a rule counting a share of the active people: says only recently active people are counted.

whoDecides.rule.today.majority.text: Group vote’s math, or a quiet wait if nobody objects.
whoDecides.rule.today.majority.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a Majority over time rule: it counts like the Group vote preset, or a change goes live after a quiet wait when nobody votes no.

whoDecides.rule.today.majorityMin_one.text: Group vote’s math, or a quiet wait if nobody objects, and never fewer than {{count}} yes.
whoDecides.rule.today.majorityMin_one.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a Majority over time rule with a minimum: it counts like the Group vote preset, or a change goes live after a quiet wait when nobody votes no, but never on fewer yeses than {{count}}, which is never more than the group has.

whoDecides.rule.today.majorityMin_other.text: Group vote’s math, or a quiet wait if nobody objects, and never fewer than {{count}} yeses.
whoDecides.rule.today.majorityMin_other.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a Majority over time rule with a minimum: it counts like the Group vote preset, or a change goes live after a quiet wait when nobody votes no, but never on fewer yeses than {{count}}, which is never more than the group has.

whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActiveMin.text: Counts only people who have been active lately, and never fewer than {{count}} yes.
whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActiveMin.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a rule counting a share of the active people with a minimum: only recently active people are counted, and it never goes live on fewer yeses than {{count}}, which is never more than the group has.

whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActiveMin.text: Counts only people who have been active lately, and never fewer than {{count}} yeses.
whoDecides.rule.today.percentOfActiveMin.description: Line under Today on the rule screen of the Who can see & change it sheet, where one approval rule is edited, for a rule counting a share of the active people with a minimum: only recently active people are counted, and it never goes live on fewer yeses than {{count}}, which is never more than the group has.

whoDecides.rule.today.unknown.text: Depends on how many people the group has.
whoDecides.rule.today.unknown.description: What a rule asks for when the screen does not know the group's size.

whoDecides.people.title.description: Section label over who is in the project and its admins.

whoDecides.people.members.description: Row that opens Members, where people are invited and managed.

whoDecides.people.membersSub_one.text: {{count}} person in it. Invite and manage people.
whoDecides.people.membersSub_one.description: Line under the Members row in the People section of the Who can see & change it sheet, when the project has one member: tapping the row opens Members to invite and manage people. {{count}} is 1.

whoDecides.people.membersSub_other.text: {{count}} people in it. Invite and manage people.
whoDecides.people.membersSub_other.description: Line under the Members row. {{count}} is how many people.

whoDecides.people.admins.description: Row that opens Members on the project's admins.

whoDecides.people.adminsNone.text: None yet. They manage settings and can force-merge.
whoDecides.people.adminsNone.description: Line under the App admins row of the Who can see & change it sheet when the project has no admins: says what admins do. "Force-merge" means put a change live without waiting for the vote.

whoDecides.change.see.description: Name of the first kind of change in the list of changes to propose.

whoDecides.change.rule.description: Name of the second kind of change in the list of changes to propose.

whoDecides.changeLine.description: One change in the list to propose. {{what}} is what changes; {{from}} and {{to}} are the old and new settings.

whoDecides.count_one.description: Heading of the summary when one thing was changed.

whoDecides.count_other.description: Heading of the summary when several things were changed. {{count}} is how many.

whoDecides.propose_one.description: Button: open the proposal for the one change.

whoDecides.propose_other.description: Button: open one proposal for several changes. {{count}} is how many.

whoDecides.proposing.description: The propose button while the proposal is being opened.

whoDecides.proposeNoteYou.text: Your yes is enough to put it through, or the group’s real yes votes are. Changes to who decides never go live on a quiet wait.
whoDecides.proposeNoteYou.description: Note under the propose button, for the creator.

whoDecides.proposeNoteCreator.text: {{creator}}’s yes is enough to put it through, or the group’s real yes votes are. Changes to who decides never go live on a quiet wait.
whoDecides.proposeNoteCreator.description: Note under the propose button, for anyone but the creator. {{creator}} is the creator's username.

whoDecides.nothing.description: Summary heading at the bottom of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set, before any setting was changed.

whoDecides.nothingSub.text: Pick something different above, and it becomes one proposal for the group.
whoDecides.nothingSub.description: Line under Nothing changed yet at the bottom of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: any setting changed above is bundled into one proposal the group votes on.

whoDecides.opened.description: Summary heading at the bottom of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set once the change was sent as a proposal for a vote. Past participle: "has been proposed".

whoDecides.openedSub.text: It’s up for a vote now, and goes live once it passes.
whoDecides.openedSub.description: Line under Proposed at the bottom of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set: the change is being voted on now and takes effect once the vote passes.

whoDecides.notVerified.text: Nothing changed. Making it public needs a verified phone first.
whoDecides.notVerified.description: Status after the person declined to verify before making the project public.

whoDecides.error.text: Could not propose the change. Try again.
whoDecides.error.description: Error at the bottom of the Who can see & change it sheet, where a project's visibility and approval rule are set when sending the change as a proposal failed. "Propose" is a verb.

members.whoDecides.title.description: Row in the Members dialog that opens the sheet where the project's visibility and approval rule are set.

members.whoDecides.sub.text: Private or public, and how changes are approved
members.whoDecides.sub.description: Second line of the Who can see & change it row in the Members dialog: says the row sets whether the project is private or public and how its changes are approved. "Approved" means accepted by a vote.

appSettings.access.now.text: Now: {{access}}. Who can see it and how its changes are approved are set together, in one proposal.
appSettings.access.now.description: Line in App settings' Access section. {{access}} is who can see the project today, for example "Private community".

appSettings.access.open.description: Button in App settings' Access section: opens the sheet that sets who can see the project and how its changes are approved.

feedback.edit.button.description: Button or small link on a sent-feedback confirmation: correct this request during its five-minute edit window.

feedback.edit.heading.description: Heading of the editor for recently submitted feedback.

feedback.edit.titleLabel.description: Label above the title field in the recently submitted feedback editor.

feedback.edit.window_one.text: You can edit it for {{count}} more minute.
feedback.edit.window_one.description: Time remaining in the feedback edit window; {{count}} is the number of minutes, rounded up.

feedback.edit.window_other.text: You can edit it for {{count}} more minutes.
feedback.edit.window_other.description: Time remaining in the feedback edit window; {{count}} is the number of minutes, rounded up.

feedback.edit.save.description: Button: save corrections to a recently submitted request.

feedback.edit.saving.description: Save button while a request correction is being sent.

feedback.edit.saved.description: Notice on the feedback confirmation after correcting the same request.

feedback.edit.savedToast.description: Toast after correcting a request opened from Your feedback.

feedback.edit.required.text: Fill in both the title and what should change.
feedback.edit.required.description: Validation message when a feedback correction has an empty title or description.

feedback.edit.closed.text: The 5 minutes to edit this have passed. Send more feedback to add to it.
feedback.edit.closed.description: Notice when the feedback edit window expires; the typed corrections remain available to copy.

feedback.edit.failed.text: Your changes could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
feedback.edit.failed.description: Notice after a failed feedback correction; the person can retry and their words remain in the editor.

feedback.edit.conflict.text: This request changed elsewhere. Close and reopen it from Your feedback before trying again. You can copy your corrections here.
feedback.edit.conflict.description: Notice when another save or automatic title update changed the request since this editor opened.

feedback.edit.tooLong.text: The title or words are too long. Shorten them and try again.
feedback.edit.tooLong.description: Notice when a feedback correction exceeds the field or full request length limit.

card.openApp.description: Accessible name and tooltip of an app's icon wherever the icon is a link: activating it opens that app. "Open" is a verb. {{app}} is the app's name.

pill.missingSecrets.description: Small red chip on an app's card or row: the app cannot run yet because required secret values (API keys and the like) have not been set.

pill.missingSecretsTip_one.text: {{count}} required secret unset. Set values in the app's Secrets panel
pill.missingSecretsTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "Missing secrets" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many required secret values are not set yet. "Secrets" is the name of a panel in the app's settings.

pill.missingSecretsTip_other.text: {{count}} required secrets unset. Set values in the app's Secrets panel
pill.missingSecretsTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "Missing secrets" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many required secret values are not set yet. "Secrets" is the name of a panel in the app's settings.

pill.toVote_one.description: Small amber chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} proposed changes to this app are waiting for the viewer's community to vote on them.

pill.toVote_other.description: Small amber chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} proposed changes to this app are waiting for the viewer's community to vote on them.

pill.toVoteTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "to vote" chip on an app. {{count}} is the number of proposed changes (noun) to the app that are waiting for votes.

pill.toVoteTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "to vote" chip on an app. {{count}} is the number of proposed changes (noun) to the app that are waiting for votes.

pill.inDev_one.description: Small blue chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} build sessions, in which someone is developing a change to the app, are in progress. "dev" is short for development.

pill.inDev_other.description: Small blue chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} build sessions, in which someone is developing a change to the app, are in progress. "dev" is short for development.

pill.inDevTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "in dev" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many sessions of building (developing) a change to the app are under way. "Build" describes the session; it is not a command.

pill.inDevTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "in dev" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many sessions of building (developing) a change to the app are under way. "Build" describes the session; it is not a command.

pill.issues_one.description: Small grey chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} open issues (reported problems or requests) for the app.

pill.issues_other.description: Small grey chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} open issues (reported problems or requests) for the app.

pill.issuesTip_one.description: Tooltip of the issues chip on an app. {{count}} is how many issues are open, meaning not yet resolved. "Open" is an adjective.

pill.issuesTip_other.description: Tooltip of the issues chip on an app. {{count}} is how many issues are open, meaning not yet resolved. "Open" is an adjective.

pill.new.description: Status chip on a Discover row for an app created in the last two weeks. One word; shown only when nothing on the row asks for attention.

pill.newTip_one.description: Tooltip on the "New" chip in Discover; {{count}} is the window in days (the singular form is unused in practice).

pill.newTip_other.description: Tooltip on the "New" chip in Discover; {{count}} is the window in days (14).

pill.private.description: Chip with a lock icon on an app's card or row: only the app's members can open and use it.

pill.privateTip.text: Only members can open and use this app
pill.privateTip.description: Tooltip of the "Private" chip on an app. "Open" is a verb.

pill.inviteOnly.description: Chip with an envelope icon on an app's card or row: anyone can use the app, but only invited collaborators can build (develop changes to) it. "Build" is a noun here.

pill.inviteOnlyTip.text: Anyone can use this app; only invited collaborators can build it
pill.inviteOnlyTip.description: Tooltip of the "Invite-only build" chip on an app. "Build" is a verb: develop changes to the app.

loadError.directoryTitle.description: Title of the error card shown in place of Discover's list when the list of apps could not be fetched.

loadError.detail.text: Something went wrong reaching the app directory. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.detail.description: Second line of the error card shown when the list of apps could not be fetched, on Discover and on Home. A "Try again" button follows it.

illustration.title.description: Title, and accessible name, of the dialog where an app's owner sets the picture shown on the app's card in Home's Discover rail.

illustration.previewCaption.description: Caption over the sample card in the featured illustration editor: this is how the card will look on Discover. "Preview" is a noun.

illustration.theme.group.description: Accessible name of the Light / Dark pair of buttons in the featured illustration editor, which switch the sample card between the two colour themes.

illustration.theme.light.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: show the sample card in the light colour theme.

illustration.theme.dark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: show the sample card in the dark colour theme.

illustration.framingLabel.text: Illustration framing: drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom, arrow keys to nudge
illustration.framingLabel.description: Accessible name of the sample card in the featured illustration editor, where the picture is positioned and zoomed.

illustration.framingHelp.text: Drag the card to move the image. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Zoom <0>{{percent}}%</0>.
illustration.framingHelp.description: Help line under the upload buttons in the featured illustration editor, ending with the current zoom level. {{percent}} is a whole number such as 120; the numbered tag wraps the live readout.

illustration.upload.fileLabel.description: Accessible name of the hidden file chooser in the featured illustration editor.

illustration.upload.light.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose the picture used in the light colour theme, when none is set yet.

illustration.upload.replaceLight.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a different picture for the light colour theme.

illustration.upload.dark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a separate picture for the dark colour theme.

illustration.upload.replaceDark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a different picture for the dark colour theme.

illustration.upload.useLightInBoth.text: Use light image in both themes
illustration.upload.useLightInBoth.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: drop the separate dark-theme picture so the light one is used everywhere.

illustration.upload.formats.text: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB.
illustration.upload.formats.description: Small note under the upload button in the featured illustration editor: the accepted file types and size. Keep the format names.

illustration.upload.sameDimensions.text: Use images with the same dimensions. Framing and colour are shared across both themes.
illustration.upload.sameDimensions.description: Small note in the featured illustration editor about the light and dark pictures.

illustration.preview.add.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a short, silent video clip of the app that plays over the card's picture.

illustration.preview.replace.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a different short video clip to play over the card's picture.

illustration.preview.remove.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: drop the card's short video clip, so the card shows its picture only.

illustration.preview.formats.text: MP4 or WebM, 5 to 8 seconds, up to 1.5 MB, showing made-up content only. It plays over the picture when someone points at the card.
illustration.preview.formats.description: Small note under the preview loop buttons in the featured illustration editor. Keep the format names.

illustration.preview.fileLabel.description: Accessible name of the hidden video file chooser in the featured illustration editor.

illustration.preview.player.description: Accessible name of the video player that shows the card's preview loop in the featured illustration editor.

illustration.preview.invalid.text: Choose an MP4 or WebM of at most 1.5 MB.
illustration.preview.invalid.description: Error in the featured illustration editor when the chosen preview loop is the wrong kind of file or too large.

illustration.cardColour.description: Label, and accessible name, of the row of colour swatches in the featured illustration editor: the background colour of the app's card.

illustration.resetPosition.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: puts the picture back to its default position and zoom.

illustration.useAppIcon.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: removes the illustration so the card shows the app's icon instead.

illustration.loadingPreview.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor while the current illustration is being fetched.

illustration.loadFailed.text: Could not load the illustration. Reopen the editor to try again.
illustration.loadFailed.description: Error in the featured illustration editor when the current illustration could not be fetched and the server gave no message of its own.

illustration.saveFailed.description: Error in the featured illustration editor when proposing the change failed and the server gave no message of its own.

illustration.sent.text: Sent to the group for approval. The illustration changes when the vote passes. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.sent.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor after the change was submitted for the community's vote. The numbered tag is a link to the proposal (noun: the change put to a vote); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.pending.text: A change to this illustration is already waiting for the group's vote. Another can be proposed once it settles. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.pending.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor when an earlier change to the illustration is still being voted on. The numbered tag is a link to that proposal (noun); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.pendingMine.text: Your change to this picture is waiting for the group's vote. Saving replaces it and clears the votes cast on it. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.pendingMine.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor when the viewer's own change to the picture is waiting for the community's vote: what they save now replaces that change in place. The numbered tag is a link to the proposal (noun); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.openProposal.description: Link beside a refused replace in the featured illustration editor, when the change it was for can still be opened (it was already decided). The proposal is the change that was put to the group's vote.

illustration.replace.description: Main button of the featured illustration editor, when the viewer's own change to the picture is already waiting for the group's vote: replaces that waiting change with what is on screen, instead of proposing another.

illustration.replaced.text: Replaced. The group votes again on the new picture. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.replaced.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor after the viewer replaced their own waiting change. The numbered tag is a link to the proposal (noun); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.proposeNote.text: Proposing opens a governance card on the board. The change applies when the group votes it in.
illustration.proposeNote.description: Small note above the buttons of the featured illustration editor: what pressing "Propose change" does. The board is the project's list of proposals.

illustration.propose.description: Main button of the featured illustration editor: submits the new illustration for the community's vote. "Change" is a noun.

illustration.pleaseWait.description: Label of the main button of the featured illustration editor while an upload or save is in progress.

buildReady.unnamedProject.description: Email saying a build is ready: stands where the project's name goes when it is not known, as a small label over the headline and before a colon in the subject.

buildReady.subject.ready.description: Email subject: a build somebody asked for is ready. {{app}} is the project's name.

buildReady.subject.notWorking.text: {{app}}: Built, but something isn't working yet
buildReady.subject.notWorking.description: Email subject: a build somebody asked for was made, but part of it failed. {{app}} is the project's name.

buildReady.lead.ready.text: Ready to try. Try it, and approve it if you're happy.
buildReady.lead.ready.description: Email saying a build is ready: the headline.

buildReady.lead.notWorking.text: Built, but something isn't working yet. Try it to see.
buildReady.lead.notWorking.description: Email saying a build was made but part of it failed: the headline.

inviteActivity.firstMessage.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person: that person wrote their first message. {{actor}} is a username, after its @. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joined.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person. {{actor}} is a username, after its @. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joinedSomeone.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person whose name is not known. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joinedUnnamed.text: Someone joined your project through your invite.
inviteActivity.joinedUnnamed.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person, when neither the person nor the project is known.

general.internal.description: Error shown when something went wrong on Homeroom's side and the person's action did not happen. Say plainly that it is Homeroom's fault, not theirs.

general.internalStop.description: Error shown when something went wrong on Homeroom's side and the person's action did not happen. Keeps its closing full stop.

general.invalidData.description: Error shown when what the person entered or sent was refused because some of it was not acceptable.

general.notFound.description: Error shown when the thing the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

general.tooLarge.description: Error shown when what the person tried to send or upload is bigger than Homeroom accepts.

general.uploadFailed.description: Error shown when a file the person chose could not be uploaded.

project.notFound.description: Error shown when the app or project the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.proposalNotFound.description: Error shown when the proposed change the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.issueNotFound.description: Error shown when the request (an issue on a project) the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.sessionNotFound.description: Error shown when the working session the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.eventNotFound.description: Error shown when the season event the person opened does not exist or is no longer there. Keeps its closing full stop.

chat.messageNotFound.description: Error shown when the chat message the person acted on does not exist or was deleted.

chat.threadNotFound.description: Error shown when the chat thread the person opened does not exist or is no longer there.

chat.notificationNotFound.description: Error shown when the notification the person acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

account.userNotFound.description: Error shown when the person's account or the account they looked for does not exist.

account.userNotFoundStop.description: Error shown when the person's account or the account they looked for does not exist. Keeps its closing full stop.

account.notFound.description: Error shown during sign-in when no account matches what the person gave.

signIn.notAuthenticated.description: Error shown when an action needs the person to be signed in and they are not.

signIn.notSignedIn.description: Error shown when an action needs the person to be signed in and they are not. Keeps its closing full stop.

signIn.signInFirst.description: Error shown when a person who is not signed in tries something that needs an account: asks them to sign in.

signIn.signOutFirst.text: Sign out before signing in again.
signIn.signOutFirst.description: Error shown when a person already signed in starts another sign-in: asks them to sign out first.

signIn.invalidCredentials.description: Error shown on the sign-in screen when the username or email and password do not match.

signIn.usernamePasswordRequired.description: Error shown on the sign-in screen when the username or the password was left empty.

signIn.emailRequired.description: Error shown on the sign-in or password reset screen when the email address was left empty.

signIn.tooLong.text: That sign-in took too long, or started somewhere else. Try again.
signIn.tooLong.description: Error shown when a sign-in with an outside provider expired or was begun on another device or browser.

signIn.notSetUp.text: That sign-in is not set up.
signIn.notSetUp.description: Error shown when the person chose an outside sign-in provider that this Homeroom has not been configured for.

signIn.signatureFailed.description: Error shown when signing in with a crypto wallet: the wallet's signature could not be confirmed.

signUp.usernameTaken.description: Error shown when creating an account or changing a username: somebody else already has that username.

signUp.usernameTakenStop.description: Error shown when creating an account or changing a username: somebody else already has that username.

signUp.sessionExpired.text: Your signup session expired. Request a new code.
signUp.sessionExpired.description: Error shown while creating an account when too much time has passed since the emailed or texted code: asks the person to request another code.

signUp.activationCode.text: Invalid or already used activation code
signUp.activationCode.description: Error shown when the activation code the person entered is wrong or has been used.

signUp.tooManyFromAddress.text: Too many signups from this address. Try again in a few minutes.
signUp.tooManyFromAddress.description: Error shown when too many accounts were started from one internet connection: asks the person to wait a few minutes.

signUp.tooManyUsernames.text: Too many username attempts. Try again in a little while.
signUp.tooManyUsernames.description: Error shown when the person tried too many usernames in a row: asks them to wait a little.

access.notLetInYet.text: Your account does not have platform access yet.
access.notLetInYet.description: Error shown to a person still on the waitlist when they try something only let-in people can do.

password.resetLinkInvalid.description: Error shown when the emailed password reset link is wrong or too old: the person needs a new link.

password.currentRequired.description: Error shown on the change password form when the current password was left empty.

password.currentIncorrect.description: Error shown on the change password form when the current password entered is wrong.

password.noMatch.description: Error shown when the two new password fields differ.

password.mustDiffer.text: New password must be different from your current password
password.mustDiffer.description: Error shown on the change password form when the new password is the same as the old one.

search.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of the Home screen, which filters the viewer's pinned apps and communities and the communities they can join. This is the wording on a phone or a tablet, and before the device is known: it names no keyboard shortcut.

search.placeholderCtrl.description: Placeholder inside Home's search field on a computer that is not a Mac. Ctrl+K is the keyboard shortcut that puts the cursor in this field; keep the key name as written.

search.placeholderCmd.description: Placeholder inside Home's search field on a Mac. Cmd+K (the Command key and K) is the keyboard shortcut that puts the cursor in this field; keep the key name as written.

search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Home screen.

search.clear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the × button inside Home's search field: empties the field.

search.results_one.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

search.results_other.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

grid.headingProjects.description: Heading over the grid of project tiles on the Home screen under the Standard (WIP) look: the projects this person keeps a tile for. It replaces "Pinned apps" there.

grid.seeLess.description: Link beside Edit in the heading over the grid of project tiles on the Home screen (the Standard (WIP) look), shown once See all has unfolded the grid: it folds the grid back to its first rows.

grid.heading.description: Heading over the grid of app tiles on the Home screen: the apps this person keeps a tile for. The same name is used in "Pin to Home".

grid.loading.description: Read by screen readers while the grid of app tiles on Home is still loading.

grid.noMatches.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the search finds none of the viewer's apps. {{query}} is what the person typed. The same search also filters the communities listed further down the Home screen.

search.none.description: Shown on Home under the line saying none of the viewer's apps match the search, when no community matches it either: none they are in and none they could join. {{query}} is what the person typed. A button offering to make it follows.

search.make.description: Button on Home shown when the search matches no app and no community. {{idea}} is what the person typed. Pressing it opens the screen for making a new project, with those words filled in as the idea.

grid.showAll_one.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.showAll_other.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.notice.offline.text: You're offline. Apps you've opened before will appear here once this device has loaded them.
grid.notice.offline.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the device has no connection and no apps are stored yet.

grid.notice.loadFailed.description: Title of the error card shown in place of Home's app tiles when the list of apps could not be fetched.

grid.tile.tip.text: {{app}}. Hold or right-click for app actions
grid.tile.tip.description: Tooltip of an app's tile on the Home screen. {{app}} is the app's name; keep it first. Holding the tile or right-clicking it opens a menu of actions for that app.

grid.tile.actions.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small menu button on an app's card: opens the menu of things to do with that app.

grid.tile.remixedFrom.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small badge on an app's tile: this app is a version made from another app, the original. {{app}} is the original's name.

grid.tile.remixedFromDeleted.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small badge on an app's tile: this app is a version made from another app. Used when the original has been deleted; the app is shown as the word "deleted" in angle brackets, as it always has been. {{open}} and {{close}} are the angle brackets < and > that the code puts around the word; keep them around the translated word.

grid.tile.audience.invited.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small people badge on an app's tile: the app belongs to a community people join by invitation.

grid.tile.audience.solo.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small lock badge on an app's tile: only the viewer can see and use this app.

grid.tile.retryNamed.description: Accessible name of the Retry button on a tile whose app failed to build: tries building it again. {{app}} is the app's name.

grid.tile.opened.description: Small grey line under an app's name on a Pinned apps tile on Home, for an app the viewer used on this device in the last 30 days. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "2h ago" or "just now", counted from when they left the app. Shown from tablet width up; a phone shows the time alone.

grid.tile.openedShort.description: The same small grey line under an app's name on a Pinned apps tile on Home, on a phone, where the tile is too narrow for "Opened 2h ago": the time alone. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "2h ago", "30d ago" or "just now". Add a word only if it stays as short as the time.

grid.tile.status.creating.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is being set up and is not running yet.

grid.tile.status.awaitingSecrets.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is waiting for its required secret values (API keys and the like) to be set.

grid.tile.status.error.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app failed to build or start.

layout.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save your home screen layout.
layout.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when the new arrangement of tiles on Home, after a drag, could not be saved.

create.label.description: Label under the dashed + tile at the end of Home's grid, and on the small dashed-plus New project button beside "Show all N apps" when the grid is folded and has no room for the tile: starts a new project (an app and the community that builds it).

create.tip.text: Start a project: an app for you or for a community
create.tip.description: Tooltip of the + tile at the end of Home's grid, and of the small New project button beside "Show all N apps" that stands in for it there.

create.disabledHint.text: View your app allowance or request more slots.
create.disabledHint.description: Last sentence of the + tile's tooltip when the viewer has used up the number of apps they may create: what pressing it does instead. A slot is room for one app.

needsCard.seeAll.description: Link at the end of the heading line of Home's Recent threads card: opens the notifications sheet's Recent threads list, every discussion the viewer took part in.

needsCard.eyebrow.description: Title of Home's Recent threads card, in the side column: the discussions the viewer took part in, newest activity first. The card opens the same list in the notifications sheet.

needsCard.kind.change.description: The title of a row on Home's Recent threads card, for a thread that has no title of its own: what the thread is. It is a change to a project. {{number}} is its number, like 6800.

needsCard.kind.changeBare.description: The title of a row on Home's Recent threads card, for a thread that has no title of its own: what the thread is. It is a change to a project that has no number yet.

needsCard.kind.request.description: The title of a row on Home's Recent threads card, for a thread that has no title of its own: what the thread is. It is a request. {{number}} is its number, like 6790.

needsCard.kind.requestBare.description: The title of a row on Home's Recent threads card, for a thread that has no title of its own: what the thread is. It is a request filed on a project that has no number yet.

needsCard.kind.decision.description: The title of a row on Home's Recent threads card, for a thread that has no title of its own: what the thread is. It is a group decision on how a project is run (a vote on a new name, a card picture, and so on).

needsCard.meta.description: Second, small line of a row on Home's Recent threads card, under the thread's title: the thread's project, then how long ago something last happened in it. Keep the <0></0> tags around the time. {{project}} is a project's name, like Plant Pal; {{when}} is a time, like 2h ago.

create.lockedTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the + tile at the end of Home's grid when the viewer cannot create another app right now — and of the small New project button beside "Show all N apps" that stands in for it there, in the same state. {{hint}} is one whole sentence saying what pressing it does ("View your app allowance or request more slots.").

myApps.added.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was added to the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.removed.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was taken off the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.updateFailed.description: Brief notice when adding an app to Pinned apps, or removing it, did not go through. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

leave.confirm.title.description: Title of the question asked when someone presses "Joined" on an app to stop being a member of its community. {{community}} is the app's name.

leave.confirm.private.text: You will lose access to it until someone invites you back.
leave.confirm.private.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is private.

leave.confirm.public.text: You won’t be able to propose or vote on its changes until you join again.
leave.confirm.public.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is public. "Changes" is a noun.

leave.confirm.button.description: Confirming button of the "Leave …?" question: stop being a member of the app's community. A verb.

membership.joined.description: Brief notice after the viewer joined an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name.

membership.left.description: Brief notice after the viewer stopped being a member of an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name. "Left" is the past of leave, not a direction.

membership.joinFailed.description: Brief notice when joining an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

membership.leaveFailed.description: Brief notice when leaving an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

menu.updated.description: Line in the header of an app tile's menu: when the app's latest version went live. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

menu.details.label.description: Item in an app tile's menu on Home: opens the hub of the app's community, its project page.

menu.details.tip.text: Who it is for, what is changing, and how to join
menu.details.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Go to community" item in an app tile's menu: what the community's hub shows.

menu.editMyApps.label.description: Last item in the menu of an app tile in the Pinned apps grid on Home: puts the grid into edit mode, where tiles can be moved and removed. "Edit" is a verb; "Pinned apps" is the name of the section.

menu.editMyApps.tip.text: Move and remove the apps in Pinned apps
menu.editMyApps.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Edit Pinned apps" item in an app tile's menu on Home. "Move" and "remove" are verbs.

menu.github.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for an app whose code is on GitHub: opens the app's source code repository on GitHub in a new tab.

menu.github.tip.description: Tooltip of the "View on GitHub" item in an app's menu. "Open" is a verb.

menu.code.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for an app whose code is on Homeroom's own git host rather than GitHub: opens the app's source code in a new tab. "View" is a verb.

menu.code.tip.description: Tooltip of the "View code" item in an app's menu. "Open" is a verb.

menu.myApps.add.description: Item in an app's menu: puts a tile for the app on the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.remove.description: Item in an app's menu: takes the app's tile off the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.showAgainTip.text: Show this app in Pinned apps again. You keep your builder access either way.
