replies.app.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the message box in a thread under a message of a project's channel.

replies.app.membersOnly.text: Only members of this app can reply here.
replies.app.membersOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box in a thread of a project's channel, shown to someone who is not a member of that project.

bot.ready.line.release.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when the change goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)"; this entry adds only the full stop that ends it.

bot.ready.change.request.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one: which request the change is for, then what it is. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the change's own title, else the request's.

bot.ready.change.requestUntitled.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one, when there is no title to say beside the number: which request the change is for. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.outcome.goingLiveRelease.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history, for a change to Homeroom itself: the change is built and merged, and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when it goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.plan.complicatedNote.text: Its before and after screens are on the request below. To change it, write what to change: you post it there, where the group can see it, and a new plan follows.
bot.plan.complicatedNote.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits: its before and after screens are on the request card below, and what the reader asks to change is posted there for the community to see.

bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.text: To change it, write what to change: you post it on the request below, where the group can see it, and a new plan follows.
bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits and the card itself shows the plan and its before and after screens: what the reader asks to change is posted on the request card below, for the community to see.

bot.plan.spec.see.description: Row on Homeroom bot's plan card for a complicated change: opens the whole plan (what will change and its before and after screens) inside the card. "See" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.hide.description: The same row on Homeroom bot's plan card once the whole plan is open: folds the plan away again. "Hide" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.sections.description: Accessible name of the two tabs over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card.

bot.plan.spec.tab.user.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says what people will see and do differently. Shown first.

bot.plan.spec.tab.tech.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says how it will be built, for developers.

bot.plan.spec.tabEmpty.description: Shown in a tab of the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card when that half of the plan is empty.

bot.track.state.waitingNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot needs something from the person who asked for it (an answer, a go-ahead, more detail), shown to somebody else, on a page anyone can open. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.step.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Plan" step.

bot.track.step.build.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Build" step.

bot.track.step.checks.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Checks" step.

bot.track.step.vote.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Vote" step.

bot.track.step.live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Live" step.

bot.track.step.buildTry.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under the Build segment of a request's progress bar when the bot is building it again: its checks failed or voters asked for changes, so this is a later try. {{number}} is which try, 2 or more.

bot.track.try.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note after the status word of a request the bot is working on again, for example "Building · Try 2". {{number}} is which try, 2 or more.

bot.track.soFar.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. How long this try has been running. {{duration}} is a short duration such as "15m" or "2h 5m". Only this try is counted, never an earlier one.

bot.track.line.waiting.questionNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "question", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.line.waiting.planNamed.text: Its plan is ready for @{{username}} to say Build it
bot.track.line.waiting.planNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "plan", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @. "Build it" is the name of the button that person taps: keep it as the button reads.

bot.track.line.waiting.detailNamed.text: It can't build this as written: it needs more detail from @{{username}}
bot.track.line.waiting.detailNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "detail", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.line.stopped.time.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "time".

bot.track.line.stopped.restart.text: The platform restarted during its build
bot.track.line.stopped.restart.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "restart".

bot.track.line.stopped.restarts.text: The platform restarted during each of its last tries
bot.track.line.stopped.restarts.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "restarts".

bot.track.line.stopped.unproposed.text: It built this but couldn't put it up for a vote
bot.track.line.stopped.unproposed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "unproposed".

bot.track.line.stopped.not_pushed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "not_pushed".

bot.track.line.stopped.no_change.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "no_change".

bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_already.text: It made no change: it says this is already there
bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_already.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "no_change_already".

bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_unclear.text: It made no change: it wasn't sure what to change
bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_unclear.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "no_change_unclear".

bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_could_n.text: It made no change: it says it couldn't do this
bot.track.line.stopped.no_change_could_n.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "no_change_could_not".

bot.track.line.stopped.no_start.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "no_start".

bot.track.line.stopped.build_failed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "stopped" when the reason is "build_failed".

bot.track.line.stopped.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title for the state "stopped": the bot could not write its plan for the request, so nothing was built, and it is not trying again by itself.

bot.track.line.stopped.stopped.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on. Line under a request's title for the state "stopped": somebody stopped the bot's build of the request (who is not known).

bot.track.line.stopped.stoppedBy.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on. Line under a request's title for the state "stopped": a person stopped the bot's build of the request. {{username}} is that person's username, shown after an @.

bot.track.line.done_elsewhere.by.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under the title of a request somebody else's merged change shipped. {{username}} is that person's username and {{number}} the pull request's number.

bot.track.line.done_elsewhere.byNoPr.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under the title of a request somebody else's merged change shipped, when the change has no pull request number. {{username}} is that person's username.

bot.track.line.held.until.text: On hold until {{date}}: this week's building time is used up
bot.track.line.held.until.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under the title of a request held because the building time of whoever pays for it is used up this week. {{date}} is when it resets, a short weekday and time.

bot.track.line.cooldown.until.text: Paused after repeated errors: trying again {{date}}
bot.track.line.cooldown.until.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under the title of a request Homeroom bot paused because its tries failed several times in a row (nothing to do with building time). {{date}} is when it tries again, a short weekday and time.

bot.track.held.next.text: Next in line for a slot
bot.track.held.next.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note on a held request: it is the next one the bot will take up when a slot frees.

bot.track.held.aheadSlot_one.text: Waiting for a slot, {{count}} request ahead of it
bot.track.held.aheadSlot_one.description: A request Homeroom bot is ready to build but holds because all of its project's slots are in use, in one short line under the On hold heading of the activity drawer, and on the bot's slots page under Waiting for a slot. {{count}} is how many requests the bot will take up before it.

bot.track.held.aheadSlot_other.text: Waiting for a slot, {{count}} requests ahead of it
bot.track.held.aheadSlot_other.description: A request Homeroom bot is ready to build but holds because all of its project's slots are in use, in one short line under the On hold heading of the activity drawer, and on the bot's slots page under Waiting for a slot. {{count}} is how many requests the bot will take up before it.

bot.track.held.nextBuild.text: Next in line to be built
bot.track.held.nextBuild.description: A request Homeroom bot is ready to build but holds because it is already building as many changes on the project at once as it may, in one short line under the On hold heading of the activity drawer, and on the bot's slots page under Waiting for a slot: it is the next one the bot will build.

bot.track.held.aheadBuild_one.text: Waiting its turn to be built, {{count}} request ahead of it
bot.track.held.aheadBuild_one.description: A request Homeroom bot is ready to build but holds because it is already building as many changes on the project at once as it may, in one short line under the On hold heading of the activity drawer, and on the bot's slots page under Waiting for a slot. {{count}} is how many requests the bot will build before it.

bot.track.held.aheadBuild_other.text: Waiting its turn to be built, {{count}} requests ahead of it
bot.track.held.aheadBuild_other.description: A request Homeroom bot is ready to build but holds because it is already building as many changes on the project at once as it may, in one short line under the On hold heading of the activity drawer, and on the bot's slots page under Waiting for a slot. {{count}} is how many requests the bot will build before it.

bot.track.held.ahead_one.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note on a held request: how many requests the bot will take up before it. {{count}} is that number.

bot.track.held.ahead_other.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note on a held request: how many requests the bot will take up before it. {{count}} is that number.

bot.track.queue.ahead_one.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note on a queued request: how many requests are ahead of it in the bot's queue. {{count}} is that number.

bot.track.queue.ahead_other.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note on a queued request: how many requests are ahead of it in the bot's queue. {{count}} is that number.

bot.track.link.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Link on a request's track card: opens the plan the bot is building from.

bot.track.link.change.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Link on a request's track card: opens the change the bot built, on its page.

bot.track.link.request.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Link on a request's track card: opens the request's own page. {{number}} is the request's number.

bot.track.link.slots.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Link on a held request's track card: opens the page listing what holds each of the project's bot slots and what waits for one.

bot.track.name.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Accessible name of a request's track card. {{title}} is the request's title.

bot.track.bar.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Accessible name of a request's five-step progress bar. {{state}} is its status word, {{step}} which step it is on and {{name}} that step's label.

bot.track.barNone.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Accessible name of a request's five-step progress bar while it is before the first step (queued or held). {{state}} is its status word.

bot.track.tryDivider.description: Divider in a request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot, before the messages of one of its tries, when the bot built it more than once. {{number}} is which try and {{date}} when it began.

bot.track.pictures.plan.text: The plan's screens, before and after
bot.track.pictures.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Caption over the before and after pictures the bot drew in its plan for the change.

bot.track.pictures.change.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Caption over the before and after screenshots of the change the bot built.

bot.track.pictures.before.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label on the "before" picture of a change.

bot.track.pictures.after.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label on the "after" picture of a change.

bot.track.filed.builds.text: Homeroom bot reads it next and builds it from version {{version}}. Its progress shows here and on the request.
bot.track.filed.builds.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when the bot has the new request in its queue. {{version}} is the number of the design's version the request's plan holds, which the bot builds from. "Here" is the person's chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.track.filed.held.builds.text: Homeroom bot builds it when one of its builds is done: it is building as much on this project as it may at once. Its progress shows here and on the request.
bot.track.filed.held.builds.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when the new request waits for its turn because the bot is already building as many changes on the project at once as it may. "Here" is the person's chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.track.filed.held.slots.text: Homeroom bot builds it when one of its changes is voted in or closed: it is at its limit of changes up for a vote here. Its progress shows here and on the request.
bot.track.filed.held.slots.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when the new request waits because as many of the bot's changes on the project as may wait for a vote at once are waiting. "Here" is the person's chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.track.filed.held.bot_wide.text: Homeroom bot builds it when a slot frees: it is at its limit across projects. Its progress shows here and on the request.
bot.track.filed.held.bot_wide.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when the new request waits because Homeroom bot has as much work waiting as it may have across all projects. "Here" is the person's chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.track.filed.held.allowance.text: Homeroom bot builds it once the week resets: this week's building time is used up. Its progress shows here and on the request.
bot.track.filed.held.allowance.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when the new request waits because the building time for this week is used up. "Here" is the person's chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.track.filed.person.text: This needs a person, not Homeroom bot: the people on the project decide who builds it.
bot.track.filed.person.description: In a private design thread, after Homeroom bot's line saying it filed the person's design as a request: what happens next, when Homeroom bot does not build requests on that project, or a person has to decide about it first.

privateThread.done.description: The line under a private thread's head with Homeroom bot once it is finished: its request went live or was closed, or the person marked it done. Reopen follows it.

privateThread.reopen.description: A button: brings a finished private thread with Homeroom bot back, as it was before it was done. On the line under the thread's head, and in its ⋯ menu.

privateThread.markDone.description: A menu item in a private thread's ⋯ menu (in its head, and on its row on the Homeroom bot page): finishes the thread, which then leaves the page's lists. Nothing in it is deleted.

privateThread.rename.description: A menu item in a private thread's ⋯ menu (in its head, and on its row on the Homeroom bot page), above Mark done: opens a small prompt to give the thread a name of the person's own, which the automatic title never replaces.

privateThread.renameTitle.description: The title of the small prompt a private thread's Rename opens, with one text field and Save.

privateThread.renamePlaceholder.description: The placeholder in the text field of the prompt a private thread's Rename opens: what the thread should be called.

privateThread.renameFailed.description: The message shown when renaming a private thread failed and the server gave no sentence of its own. The thread keeps its name.

privateThread.menu.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the ⋯ button on a private thread with Homeroom bot, which opens a menu with Mark done (or Reopen).

privateThread.label.text: Only you can see this thread.
privateThread.label.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): nothing in it is public until they file it or post it.

privateThread.newProject.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Button: asks who a project made from the thread's idea would be for.

privateThread.whoFor.text: It isn't in a community yet. Who is it for?
privateThread.whoFor.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Shown after New project, over three choices that each open Create with the thread's words.

privateThread.forMe.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a project only the person is in.

privateThread.forGroup.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a private project for people the person invites.

privateThread.forCommunity.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a public project anyone can join.

privateThread.filed.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) once it was filed. {{number}} is the new request's number, {{project}} the project's name.

privateThread.made.description: Line at the top of a private thread with Homeroom bot once a project was made from its plan. {{project}} is the new project's name; an Open link follows it.

privateThread.posted.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) once it was posted in an existing thread. {{number}} is the request's or change's number, {{project}} the project's name.

privateThread.open.description: Link after the filed or posted line at the top of a private thread with Homeroom bot: opens the request or change.

privateThread.openRequest.description: Link at the end of the one-line strip at the top of a private thread with Homeroom bot that was filed as a request (or posted on one as its plan); the strip says where that request stands (its status, then a five-step bar). Opens the request's page. "Open" is a verb; {{number}} is the request's number, keep the #.

ai.hero.name.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Its heading, the bot's name, beside its picture.

ai.hero.both.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Line under the heading: {{needs}} is how many things in its Needs you list ask something of the person (a vote, an answer, a Build it), {{next}} how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.hero.next.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Line under the heading when nothing waits on the person: {{next}} is how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.hero.needs.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Line under the heading when nothing of theirs is being worked on: {{needs}} is how many things in its Needs you list ask something of the person (a vote, an answer, a Build it).

ai.hero.bothFresh_one.description: The AI tab's main view: line under the heading when something needs the person and something is in progress. {{needs}} is how many things ask something of them, {{fresh}} how many of those threads have a message they have not read yet (the number in colour), {{next}} how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.hero.bothFresh_other.description: The AI tab's main view: line under the heading when something needs the person and something is in progress. {{needs}} is how many things ask something of them, {{fresh}} how many of those threads have a message they have not read yet (the number in colour), {{next}} how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.hero.needsFresh_one.description: The AI tab's main view: line under the heading when something needs the person and nothing of theirs is in progress. {{needs}} is how many things ask something of them, {{fresh}} how many of those threads have a message they have not read yet (the number in colour).

ai.hero.needsFresh_other.description: The AI tab's main view: line under the heading when something needs the person and nothing of theirs is in progress. {{needs}} is how many things ask something of them, {{fresh}} how many of those threads have a message they have not read yet (the number in colour).

ai.work.fresh_one.description: The AI tab's Needs you list: a small pill beside its heading or a project's name, saying how many threads there have a message the person has not read. Shown only above zero.

ai.work.fresh_other.description: The AI tab's Needs you list: a small pill beside its heading or a project's name, saying how many threads there have a message the person has not read. Shown only above zero.

ai.work.earlier.description: The AI tab's Needs you list: a small line inside a project, between the threads with something new and the ones the person has already seen.

ai.work.title.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Label over the first list: what waits on the person (a vote, an answer, a plan to say Build it to) in the threads they are in, then their private threads.

ai.work.titleCount_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Label over the first list when something in it asks for the person: {{count}} is how many of its rows do (a vote, an answer, a Build it). It is a count, not a link.

ai.work.titleCount_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Label over the first list when something in it asks for the person: {{count}} is how many of its rows do (a vote, an answer, a Build it). It is a count, not a link.

ai.work.empty.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Shown in the Needs you list when it is empty.

ai.work.unreachable.text: Not saved on this phone yet. Your lists will load when you’re back online.
ai.work.unreachable.description: The AI tab's main view: shown at the top of the Needs you list, above a Try again button, when the person's lists (what needs them, what is in progress, what is waiting) could not be fetched because there was no connection and this device has no saved copy of them.

ai.work.failed.description: The AI tab's main view: shown at the top of the Needs you list, above a Try again button, when Homeroom answered with an error while fetching the person's lists (what needs them, what is in progress, what is waiting).

ai.work.loading.description: The Homeroom bot tab: announced to screen readers in the Needs you list while it is still loading; on screen its rows show as grey placeholders.

ai.work.showMore_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Row at the end of a list showing only its first rows: shows the rest. {{count}} is how many more.

ai.work.showMore_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Row at the end of a list showing only its first rows: shows the rest. {{count}} is how many more.

ai.work.showMoreFresh_one.description: The AI tab's Live this week list: the button under a project's first rows when some of the folded rows have something new. {{count}} is how many more rows it shows, {{fresh}} how many of them are new.

ai.work.showMoreFresh_other.description: The AI tab's Live this week list: the button under a project's first rows when some of the folded rows have something new. {{count}} is how many more rows it shows, {{fresh}} how many of them are new.

ai.work.showLess.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Row at the end of a list showing all its rows: shows only the first ones again.

ai.row.where.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) that needs the person: the project and the request or change number.

ai.row.fixYours.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of a change the person made themselves that waits on them: its checks failed, its preview did not build, or merging it hit a conflict a person has to resolve.

ai.row.waitsOnFixTests.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · It has its votes; its tests fail, so you fix it
ai.row.waitsOnFixTests.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but whose tests fail. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request or change number.

ai.row.waitsOnFixConflict.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · It has its votes; it conflicts with main, so you fix it
ai.row.waitsOnFixConflict.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but which conflicts with main. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request or change number.

ai.row.waitsOnFixBoth.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · It has its votes; its tests fail and it conflicts with main, so you fix it
ai.row.waitsOnFixBoth.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but whose tests fail and which conflicts with main. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request or change number.

ai.row.fixYoursPr.text: {{project}} · PR {{number}} · Your change needs a fix
ai.row.fixYoursPr.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the same tooltip on a project whose code is on GitHub, where a change's number is its pull request's ("PR 12"). Its checks failed, its preview did not build, or merging it hit a conflict a person has to resolve.

ai.row.botCouldntFix.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of the person's own change after Homeroom bot took over its fix and its last attempt failed, or of the change Homeroom bot made for a request they asked for, after it handed the fix back.

ai.row.botCouldntFixPr.text: {{project}} · PR {{number}} · Homeroom bot couldn't fix it
ai.row.botCouldntFixPr.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the same tooltip on a project whose code is on GitHub, where a change's number is its pull request's ("PR 12"). Also covers the change Homeroom bot made for a request they asked for, after it handed the fix back.

ai.row.voteFreesSlot.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Your vote helps free a build slot
ai.row.voteFreesSlot.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of a vote on one of Homeroom bot's changes while a request of the person's waits for one of its slots on that project; deciding the change frees one.

ai.row.voteConflict.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Conflicts with main: Homeroom resolves it once you approve
ai.row.voteConflict.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the Vote row of a change that conflicts with main and that only a yes can move. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request or change number.

ai.row.project.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) that needs the person and has no number: the project's name.

ai.row.privateDraft.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with a draft for a project: only the person can see it, which project it is for, and that it is not posted.

ai.row.privateFiled.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) that was filed as a request on the project: only the person can see it, which project it is for, and the request's number.

ai.row.privatePosted.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) whose words were posted on a request or change on the project: only the person can see it, which project it is for, and the number it was posted on.

ai.row.privatePutAway.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) for a draft the person chose not to send: only the person can see it and which project it is for.

ai.row.privateIdea.text: Only you · Not in a community yet
ai.row.privateIdea.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with an idea that is for no project yet: only the person can see it.

ai.row.requests_one.description: After the title of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's lists, when its thread holds one request and several were merged: how many requests the thread holds.

ai.row.requests_other.description: After the title of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's lists, when its thread holds several requests: how many requests the thread holds.

ai.row.privateAbout.description: Tooltip (and phone second line) of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's Needs you list for a private thread opened from a request's page: only the person sees it, the project, and the request it is about.

ai.row.privateAboutChange.description: Tooltip (and phone second line) of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's Needs you list for a private thread opened from a change's page: only the person sees it, the project, and the change it is about.

ai.pill.vote.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row: the person owes a vote on it.

ai.pill.testsFailing.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: pill at the end of the row of the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but whose tests fail. It says what the change waits on instead of Vote.

ai.pill.conflicts.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: pill at the end of the row of the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but which conflicts with main. It says what the change waits on instead of Vote.

ai.pill.approve.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row: a change on a project that is just this person's waits for their approval (their yes alone decides it). A verb.

ai.pill.pick.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row: the person owes a pick between competing changes. A verb.

ai.pill.answer.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row: Homeroom bot asked the person a question about it and needs their reply. A short label, not a verb.

ai.pill.buildIt.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row: a plan is ready to build; it opens the plan, where Build it is the button. A verb.

ai.pill.decide.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot handed back because a person has to decide something first, and the bot needs their reply about what happens next. Opens the request. A short label, not a verb.

ai.pill.othersDecide.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot handed back for a decision that is not the person's own: the project's creator or admins decide it. Opens the request, whose note names them. A short label.

ai.pill.moveIt.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot found is about another project, or about Homeroom itself. Opens the request, where its note offers to move it (or copy it to Homeroom's own board). A verb.

ai.pill.closeIt.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot found has nothing to build (it was filed on the wrong project, the person asked to drop it, or it only asked a question the bot answered). Opens the request, where its note offers a vote on closing it. A verb.

ai.pill.proposeClose.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot found already works. Opens the request, where Propose to close starts its close vote. A verb.

ai.pill.tryAgain.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request whose build by Homeroom bot stopped. Opens the request, where Homeroom bot can be asked to build it again. A verb.

ai.pill.letTryAgain.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a change whose checks failed after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit. Opens the change's Testing card, where its requester or an admin may let it try once more. A verb.

ai.pill.fixIt.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a change the person made themselves whose checks failed, whose preview did not build, or that conflicts. Opens the change, where its Testing card says what failed. A verb.

ai.pill.askAgain.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on the person's own change after Homeroom bot took over its fix and its last attempt failed, or on the change Homeroom bot made for a request they asked for, after it handed the fix back. Opens the change, where the bot can be asked again in its thread. A verb.

ai.pill.needsYou.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Pill at the end of a row that waits on the person, when it says no more than that. A verb.

ai.busy.title_one.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps label over the card of the person's work that is under way or waits on someone else, beside Needs you and Live this week. {{count}} is how many rows it holds.

ai.busy.title_other.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps label over the card of the person's work that is under way or waits on someone else, beside Needs you and Live this week. {{count}} is how many rows it holds.

ai.up.stillCount_one.description: The AI tab's main view, Waiting: the folded head at the bottom of Waiting over the rows nobody is moving (nobody is on it, not read yet, an operator task, a person's to decide, nothing to build). Press it to open them. {{count}} is how many rows.

ai.up.stillCount_other.description: The AI tab's main view, Waiting: the folded head at the bottom of Waiting over the rows nobody is moving (nobody is on it, not read yet, an operator task, a person's to decide, nothing to build). Press it to open them. {{count}} is how many rows.

ai.live.title_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Folding label over the person's work that went live in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

ai.live.title_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Folding label over the person's work that went live in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

ai.live.row.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, and their private threads with it. Tooltip of a one-line row in Live this week: its project and number.

ai.live.closed.description: Tooltip of a private thread marked done this week, in Live this week: only the person can see it, which project it is for, and that it is closed. The row's lock says the same.

ai.live.closedSolo.description: Tooltip of a private thread marked done this week, in Live this week, that is for no project yet: only the person can see it, and it is closed. The row's lock says the same.

ai.drawer.back.description: The Homeroom bot tab on a phone: the back arrow over a private thread with Homeroom bot that is open in place of the list, which slides the list back in. Its accessible name and tooltip.

ai.filter.label.description: The AI tab's main view: accessible name of the row of project chips over the lists, which narrows them to the projects picked; also the title of the More projects panel those chips end with (a sheet on a phone).

ai.filter.all.description: The AI tab's main view: the first chip over the lists, showing every project's work. Pressed when no project chip is.

ai.filter.more_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the last chip over the lists, after the three projects that need the person most; opens the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many projects have no chip of their own.

ai.filter.more_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the last chip over the lists, after the three projects that need the person most; opens the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many projects have no chip of their own.

ai.filter.fresh_one.description: The AI tab's filter chips: the number on a project's chip (and on All), how many of that project's threads in Needs you have a message the person has not read. A screen reader hears this instead of the number; shown only above zero.

ai.filter.fresh_other.description: The AI tab's filter chips: the number on a project's chip (and on All), how many of that project's threads in Needs you have a message the person has not read. A screen reader hears this instead of the number; shown only above zero.

ai.filter.search.description: The AI tab's main view: placeholder and accessible name of the search box at the top of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; filters the projects by name.

ai.filter.group.needs.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects with something waiting on the person.

ai.filter.group.busy.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects with work under way or waiting on someone else, and nothing waiting on the person.

ai.filter.group.quiet.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects that only had work go live this week.

ai.filter.note.needs_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, in the accent. {{count}} is how many things in it wait on the person.

ai.filter.note.needs_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, in the accent. {{count}} is how many things in it wait on the person.

ai.filter.note.progress_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it are being worked on.

ai.filter.note.progress_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it are being worked on.

ai.filter.note.waiting_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it wait on someone else (votes, a free builder, the clock).

ai.filter.note.waiting_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it wait on someone else (votes, a free builder, the clock).

ai.filter.note.live_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it went live in the last week.

ai.filter.note.live_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it went live in the last week.

ai.filter.none.description: The AI tab's main view: in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show when its search matches no project. {{query}} is what the person typed.

ai.filter.showAll.description: The AI tab's main view: link at the foot of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; unpicks every project so the lists show all of them again.

ai.filter.done.description: The AI tab's main view: button at the foot of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; closes it. Picks apply as they are made.

ai.search.open.description: The Homeroom bot tab, beside the round plus at the top: the name and tooltip of the round search button, which opens a box that narrows every list on the page to the threads whose title, number or project matches what is typed, and lists the messages in the person's chat with Homeroom bot that contain it.

ai.search.label.description: The Homeroom bot tab: placeholder and accessible name of the search box under the heading, which narrows every list on the page to the threads whose title, number or project matches what is typed, and lists the messages in the person's chat with Homeroom bot that contain it.

ai.search.none.text: Nothing in your threads or messages matches “{{query}}”
ai.search.none.description: The Homeroom bot tab: shown in place of the lists when the search box's text matches no thread on the page and no message in the person's chat with Homeroom bot. {{query}} is what the person typed.

ai.search.noneThreads.description: The Homeroom bot tab: shown in place of the lists when the search box's text matches no thread on the page and the person's messages were not searched: what they typed is a single character, too short to search messages for, or the search of their messages could not be read. {{query}} is what the person typed.

ai.search.messages_one.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: small caps label over the card that lists the messages in the person's chat with Homeroom bot that contain what they typed, under the threads that match. {{count}} is how many messages are listed; a translation may use it in this singular form too.

ai.search.messages_other.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: small caps label over the card that lists the messages in the person's chat with Homeroom bot that contain what they typed, under the threads that match. {{count}} is how many messages are listed.

ai.search.inChat.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: on the row of a message the search found, where that message is when it was written in the person's chat with Homeroom bot itself and not in one of its threads (a message in a thread shows the thread's name there instead).

ai.search.rowYou.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: accessible name and tooltip of the row of a message the person wrote that the search found; the row is a link that opens the message. {{snippet}} is a short piece of the message round the words searched for, {{place}} is the name of the thread it is in or the words for the chat itself, {{date}} is the day it was written, for example 3 Nov.

ai.search.rowBot.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: accessible name and tooltip of the row of a message Homeroom bot wrote that the search found; the row is a link that opens the message. {{snippet}} is a short piece of the message round the words searched for, {{place}} is the name of the thread it is in or the words for the chat itself, {{date}} is the day it was written, for example 3 Nov.

ai.search.more.text: These are the newest matches. Type more to narrow them down.
ai.search.more.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: line under the list of messages the search found, shown when more messages matched than the list holds.

ai.search.failed.text: Your messages could not be searched.
ai.search.failed.description: The Homeroom bot tab, while searching: note shown when the search of the person's messages with Homeroom bot could not be read (offline, or a server error); the threads on the page are still searched. A Try again button follows it.

ai.live.number.description: The AI tab's main view, Live this week: the number at the end of a one-line row for a change that went live this week.

ai.live.olderTab.text: This tab is on an older Homeroom.
ai.live.olderTab.description: The AI tab's main view: one line under Live this week when some of its changes are live but this tab runs the version of Homeroom from before them. A Reload button sits at its end.

ai.short.reload.description: The AI tab's main view: the word at the right end of a Live this week row that the page open in this tab is too old to show, and the button under that list which reloads the page onto the running version.

ai.short.private.description: Homeroom bot tab: the word on the right of a private thread's row (only the person can see it), and the heading, beside a lock, over private ideas that are in no project yet.

ai.short.today.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Live this week: it went live today.

ai.short.yesterday.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Live this week: it went live yesterday.

ai.why.fixYours.text: Checks failed, its preview did not build, or it conflicts
ai.why.fixYours.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row for a change the person made themselves that waits on their fix.

ai.why.botCouldntFix.text: Homeroom bot couldn't fix it. Ask it again, or fix it yourself
ai.why.botCouldntFix.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row for the person's own change after Homeroom bot took over its fix and its last attempt failed, or for the change Homeroom bot made for a request they asked for, after it handed the fix back.

ai.why.fixTests.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row for the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but whose tests fail.

ai.why.fixConflict.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row for the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but which conflicts with main.

ai.why.fixBoth.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row for the person's own change, made through a coding agent, whose votes are in but whose tests fail and which conflicts with main.

ai.history.title.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Its heading, small caps over the card.

ai.history.kind.label.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Accessible name, read by a screen reader, of its row of filter chips (All, Changes, Requests, Votes, Only you).

ai.history.kind.all.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Filter chip, the first: every kind of work.

ai.history.kind.change.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Filter chip: only changes (code changes to an app) the person built, or Homeroom bot built from their request. A noun, plural.

ai.history.kind.request.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Filter chip: only requests the person filed (things they asked to have built or fixed) that somebody else built or that were closed. A noun, plural.

ai.history.kind.vote.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Filter chip: only changes and group decisions the person voted on or opened, once decided. A noun, plural.

ai.history.kind.solo.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Filter chip: only the person's private threads with Homeroom bot, which nobody else can see.

ai.history.live.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a change that went live (people using the app have it), or for a private thread with Homeroom bot about such a change. {{date}} is the day, short, as "Oct 24".

ai.history.closed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a change closed without being merged, a request closed with nothing built, or a private thread with Homeroom bot about a change that was closed.

ai.history.shipped.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a request of the person's that somebody else built, and that is live now.

ai.history.passed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a group decision the person opened (a rename, a new picture, …) that the group voted through.

ai.history.withdrawn.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a group decision the person opened and then withdrew.

ai.history.done.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a private thread with Homeroom bot that the person marked done.

ai.history.putAway.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a private thread with Homeroom bot that the person put away without filing it.

ai.history.filedShipped.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a private thread with Homeroom bot that the person filed as a request, which then went live. {{number}} is the request's number.

ai.history.filedClosed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The word at the end of a row for a private thread with Homeroom bot that the person filed as a request, which was then closed with nothing built. {{number}} is the request's number.

ai.history.yesMerged.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a change the person voted Yes on, which was merged.

ai.history.noMerged.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a change the person voted No on, which was merged anyway.

ai.history.yesClosed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a change or decision the person voted Yes on, which was closed without going through.

ai.history.noClosed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a change or decision the person voted No on, which was closed without going through.

ai.history.yesPassed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a group decision the person voted Yes on, which the group voted through.

ai.history.noPassed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a group decision the person voted No on, which the group voted through anyway.

ai.history.yesWithdrawn.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a group decision the person voted Yes on, which its author withdrew.

ai.history.noWithdrawn.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). The end of a row for a group decision the person voted No on, which its author withdrew.

ai.history.wherePr.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). A row's tooltip, for a change on a project whose code is on GitHub, where its number is its pull request's. {{project}} is the project's name.

ai.history.left.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Beside a project's name over its rows, for a private community the person is no longer in: only what they made there stays listed.

ai.history.earlier.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Button under the card: shows the months before the ones listed.

ai.history.empty.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Shown in the card when none of the person's work has finished (or none of the kind and projects picked).

ai.history.loading.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Accessible name, read by a screen reader, of the placeholder bars shown while the card's rows load.

ai.history.failed.text: Your history could not be read.
ai.history.failed.description: The Homeroom bot tab's History card, below Live this week: the person's own work once it has finished (changes they built or Homeroom bot built from their request, requests they filed, votes they cast, their private threads with the bot). Shown in the card when its rows could not be loaded, above a Try again button. Plain, not an alarm.

ai.filter.emptyProject.text: Nothing of yours in {{project}} right now.
ai.filter.emptyProject.description: The Homeroom bot tab, Needs you, when the project chips are narrowed to one project and nothing of the person's is under way or waiting there. {{project}} is the project's name.

ai.why.voteFreesSlot.text: Your vote helps free a build slot
ai.why.voteFreesSlot.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a vote on one of Homeroom bot's changes, where a request of yours waits for its build slot.

ai.why.voteConflict.text: Conflicts with main: Homeroom resolves it once you approve
ai.why.voteConflict.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Vote row on a change that conflicts with main; a yes lets Homeroom resolve the conflict and merge it without asking again.

ai.why.heldYours_one.text: A vote you owe can free its slot
ai.why.heldYours_one.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Waiting row held for a build slot that one vote you owe can free.

ai.why.heldYours_other.text: {{count}} votes you owe can free its slot
ai.why.heldYours_other.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Waiting row held for a build slot that votes you owe can free.

ai.ask.label.description: The Homeroom bot tab's main view on a phone: the bar at the foot of the screen, which opens a new chat with Homeroom bot (the same screen the New chat button opens), where the person says what they want and their first message starts a private thread.

ai.thread.sub.text: Only you can see this thread
ai.thread.sub.description: The Homeroom bot tab: the line under the name of one of the person's private threads with Homeroom bot, shown alone in the column beside the lists (or a phone's drawer), after a lock glyph. Nothing in it is public until they file it or post it.

ai.thread.aboutRequest.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a request's page, and of its row in the list: the request's number and title, for example "#18 Dark mode".

ai.thread.aboutRequestUntitled.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a request's page, when the request's title is not known.

ai.thread.aboutChange.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a change's page: the change's number and title.

ai.thread.aboutChangeUntitled.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a change's page, when the change's title is not known.

botCards.batch.title.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply when it works through several of a person's requests at once. {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.titleRunning.description: Title of that card once the person tapped Build: Homeroom bot is building the ready requests. {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.titleDone.description: Title of that card once nothing of the batch is being built any more (each is live, waiting for a yes, or stopped). {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.count.total_one.description: First part of the summary under the batch card's title, joined to the next parts with a dot: how many requests the card lists.

botCards.batch.count.total_other.description: First part of the summary under the batch card's title, joined to the next parts with a dot: how many requests the card lists.

botCards.batch.count.ready_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot found ready to build.

botCards.batch.count.ready_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot found ready to build.

botCards.batch.count.question_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests have a question from Homeroom bot waiting for an answer.

botCards.batch.count.question_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests have a question from Homeroom bot waiting for an answer.

botCards.batch.count.person_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot left for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.count.person_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot left for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.count.done_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already live, or need nothing built.

botCards.batch.count.done_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already live, or need nothing built.

botCards.batch.count.reading_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot is reading again now.

botCards.batch.count.reading_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot is reading again now.

botCards.batch.count.underway_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.count.underway_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.count.unread_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot could not read from here.

botCards.batch.count.unread_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot could not read from here.

botCards.batch.read.ready.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot found it ready to build.

botCards.batch.read.question.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot asked a question about it that waits for an answer.

botCards.batch.read.person.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot left it for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.read.done.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: what it asks is live, or there was nothing to build.

botCards.batch.read.reading.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot is reading it again now.

botCards.batch.read.underway.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: it is already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.read.unread.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot could not read it from here.

botCards.batch.why.plan.text: Its plan is ready: Build goes ahead with it.
botCards.batch.why.plan.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: Homeroom bot wrote its plan, and Build goes ahead with that plan.
