frame.topics.purpose.description: A project's Topics page when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). The one sentence under the page's title.

frame.workshop.bot.description: A project's Workshop when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Label of the group in the context column that says how many of the bot's build slots are in use. Homeroom bot is a name.

frame.workshop.building.description: A project's Workshop when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Title of the row about Homeroom bot's build slots: how many it is building now, of how many it may build at once.

frame.workshop.rule.description: A project's Workshop when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Label of the group in the context column that says who must approve a change.

frame.topic.theRequest.description: A request's or a change's page when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Small label over the card that holds the request in the asker's own words.

frame.topic.theChange.description: A request's or a change's page when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Small label over the card that holds the change's summary and who put it up.

frame.topic.status.description: A request's or a change's page when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). Small label over the card in the context column that says where the request or the change stands.

frame.place.general.description: A project's #general channel when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). The one sentence under the page's title: what the channel is for, as the standard page's line says it.

frame.channel.this.description: A project's #general channel when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). The small label over the card beside the conversation that says how many members the channel reaches and holds its Mute button.

frame.allItems.purpose.text: Every request and change in {{project}}, by stage.
frame.allItems.purpose.description: A project's All items page when the interface is drawn in one of the frame's looks (an admin's preview in Settings > Experimental). The one sentence under the page's title; {{project}} is the project's name.

topic.change.gate.closesClosed.description: End of a line naming a request a change will close, on its Votes card, when that request is already closed, so nothing is waiting on anybody.

topic.change.gate.closesDisputed.text: its filer says this doesn't close it
topic.change.gate.closesDisputed.description: End of a line naming a request a change will close, on its Votes card, when the person who filed that request pressed "This doesn't close it".

topic.change.gate.closesConfirm.description: Small button at the end of a line naming a request a change will close, on its Votes card. Only the person who filed that request sees it; pressing it records that they agree the change closes their request.

topic.thread.page.claimConfirm.description: Button on the card for a change that says it closes the viewer's request. Only the request's filer sees it. Pressing it records their agreement and posts a line in the change's discussion; it unlinks nothing.

topic.thread.page.claimConfirmed.description: Line in place of the Confirm and "This doesn't close it" buttons on the card for a change that says it closes the viewer's request, after the filer pressed Confirm. Shown only to the filer.

topic.rail.title.description: Heading over the timeline of a thread's big events on a request's or a change's page: who asked, the plan, each change built, its tests, and where it stands now. Also the section's accessible name.

topic.rail.resize.description: Accessible name of the draggable line between a request's or a change's card and its "How it got here" timeline on a wide page: dragging it makes the timeline wider or narrower. "How it got here" is the timeline's heading; translate it the same way.

topic.rail.asked.description: Name of the first step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): the request was filed.

topic.rail.planned.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): a plan was posted for the request.

topic.rail.plannedVersion.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): the newest plan is a later version than the first. {{version}} is its number, 2 or more.

topic.rail.built.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): a change was built.

topic.rail.builtNumbered.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) when the request has more than one change: which change was built. {{number}} is the change's number.

topic.rail.tested.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): the change's tests ran and passed.

topic.rail.testedAll.description: Line under the Tested step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card).

topic.rail.testsFailed_one.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), drawn in red: how many of the change's tests failed. One test.

topic.rail.testsFailed_other.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), drawn in red: how many of the change's tests failed. Several tests.

topic.rail.testsFailedPlain.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), drawn in red, when the number of failed tests is not known.

topic.card.foot.stoppedTests.description: Headline at the foot of a change's card, in red, when its tests failed and Homeroom bot has stopped trying to fix them.

topic.card.foot.tally.description: Short fact at the foot of a change's card while it is up for a vote: the yes votes so far out of the number needed, for example "0 of 2". It is followed by a dot and the viewer's own line ("You haven't voted").

topic.card.foot.since.description: Short fact at the foot of a change's card once it is live: the day it went live, for example "Since Nov 14".

topic.rail.fixing.description: Name of the current step in the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page while Homeroom bot is fixing the change's failed tests.

topic.rail.waitingFix.description: Name of the current step in the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page when its tests failed and its author has to fix them.

topic.rail.testing.description: Name of the current step in the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page while its tests are running.

topic.rail.note.fixing.text: Homeroom bot is fixing what its tests found. It is tested again after that.
topic.rail.note.fixing.description: Note under the Fixing step of the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page.

topic.rail.note.waitingFix.text: Its tests have to pass before it can go live. A new version is tested again when it arrives.
topic.rail.note.waitingFix.description: Note under the Waiting for a fix step of the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page.

topic.rail.note.approved.text: It has the yes it needs. Homeroom syncs it with main, then it goes live.
topic.rail.note.approved.description: Note under the Approved step of the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page: the change has enough yes votes and its tests passed, and its merge is next.

topic.rail.note.stoppedTests.text: Its tests still fail and nobody is fixing them. It moves on when a new version arrives.
topic.rail.note.stoppedTests.description: Note under the Stopped step of the "How it got here" timeline on a change's page, when its tests failed and Homeroom bot stopped trying to fix them.

topic.rail.voted.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): the change got the yes votes it needed.

topic.rail.yesVotes_one.description: Line under the Approved step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): how many members voted yes. One vote.

topic.rail.yesVotes_other.description: Line under the Approved step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): how many members voted yes. Several votes.

topic.rail.by.description: Line under a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): who did it. {{name}} is a username or Homeroom bot.

topic.rail.since.description: Stamp beside the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), the one that says where the thread stands now: how long it has stood there. {{when}} is a short date such as Nov 13 or Today.

topic.rail.readRequest.description: Link on the Asked step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): opens the request's own words, whole, in the reader beside the thread.

topic.rail.readPlan.description: Link on the Planned step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): opens the plan in the reader beside the thread.

topic.rail.seeFailed.description: Link on the tests-failed step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): opens the change's details, which list the failed tests.

topic.rail.openChange.description: Link on a change's step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) when the request has more than one change: brings that change's section of the page into view.

topic.rail.showEarlier_one.description: Link beside the folded pile of step markers in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) on a narrow screen: opens the earlier steps. One step.

topic.rail.showEarlier_other.description: Link beside the folded pile of step markers in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) on a narrow screen: opens the earlier steps. Several steps.

topic.rail.showLess.description: Link beside the heading in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) on a narrow screen, once the earlier steps are open: folds them back into the pile.

topic.rail.seeChecks.description: Link on the Tested step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card): opens the change's votes and tests over the card.

topic.rail.note.reading.text: Homeroom bot is reading the request and the project. It comes back with a plan or a question.
topic.rail.note.reading.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while Homeroom bot is reading a request that was just filed.

topic.rail.note.planning.text: Homeroom bot is writing a plan for it.
topic.rail.note.planning.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while Homeroom bot writes its plan for the request.

topic.rail.note.question.text: Homeroom bot asked a question in the replies. Anyone can answer it.
topic.rail.note.question.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, when Homeroom bot is waiting for an answer to a question it asked before planning.

topic.rail.note.plan.text: The plan is ready. It is built once a member presses Build it.
topic.rail.note.plan.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, when a plan is posted and nobody has started the build. "Build it" is the button's label.

topic.rail.note.waiting.text: It is waiting for an answer in the replies.
topic.rail.note.waiting.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, when the request is waiting for a person and no more specific reason is known.

topic.rail.note.building.text: It is being built. Then it is tested and goes up for a vote.
topic.rail.note.building.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while a change is being built for the request.

topic.rail.note.checking.text: Its tests are running. Then the before and after screenshots are taken, and it goes up for a vote.
topic.rail.note.checking.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while the change's automated tests run.

topic.rail.note.shots.text: Its tests passed. Only the before and after screenshots are left, then it goes up for a vote.
topic.rail.note.shots.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while the before and after screenshots are being taken, after the tests passed.

topic.rail.note.vote.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, while the change is up for the group's vote and no tally line is known.

topic.rail.note.goingLive.text: It has the yes it needs and is on its way to everyone.
topic.rail.note.goingLive.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, after the vote passed, while the change is being merged and released.

topic.rail.note.live.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, once the change is live.

topic.rail.note.stopped.text: It stopped before it was finished.
topic.rail.note.stopped.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, when the work stopped (a build that did not finish, or tests that still fail) and no more specific reason is known.

topic.rail.note.closed.text: Nothing more happens here unless it is reopened.
topic.rail.note.closed.description: Sentence under the last step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's or a change's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card), and under the status at the foot of the card, once the request or the change is closed.

topic.card.ownWords.description: Small line under the request's text on a request's page: the text above is exactly what the person who asked wrote, not a summary. {{name}} is their username.

topic.card.summaryBy.description: Small line under the summary on a change's page: who wrote the summary above. {{name}} is a username or Homeroom bot.

topic.card.summaryByBot.description: Small line under the summary on a change's page when Homeroom bot wrote the summary above from the change itself.

topic.card.summaryByBotPlan.text: Summary by Homeroom bot, from the request and the plan.
topic.card.summaryByBotPlan.description: Small line under the summary on a request's page when Homeroom bot wrote it: who wrote it and what it was written from. Here the request has a plan and no change built yet.

topic.card.summaryByBotChange.text: Summary by Homeroom bot, from the request and its change.
topic.card.summaryByBotChange.description: Small line under the summary on a request's page when Homeroom bot wrote it: who wrote it and what it was written from. Here one change has been built for the request.

topic.card.summaryByBotChanges.text: Summary by Homeroom bot, from the request and its changes.
topic.card.summaryByBotChanges.description: Small line under the summary on a request's page when Homeroom bot wrote it: who wrote it and what it was written from. Here two or more changes have been built for the request.

topic.card.layer.close.description: Accessible name of the × button, and of the dimmed area behind, on the panel that opens over a thread's card when a step of the "How it got here" timeline is pressed: closes the panel.

topic.card.shots.chipIfPasses.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the After side is showing and the change is not live yet: this is what the app will look like if the change is approved.

topic.card.shots.chipTodayBefore.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the Before side is showing and the change is not live yet: this is what the app looks like today.

topic.card.shots.chipLive.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the After side is showing and the change has gone live: this is what the app looks like now.

topic.card.shots.chipWas.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the Before side is showing and the change has gone live: this is what the app looked like before it.

topic.card.shots.chipProposed.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the After side is showing and the change was closed without going live: this is what it would have looked like.

topic.card.shots.chipToday.description: Small label on the picture in a change's card, at its top corner, while the Before side is showing and the change was closed without going live: this is what the app looks like.

topic.card.opt.name.description: Name of one of the competing changes in its row on a request's card: its letter on the ballot (A, B, C), then the change's own title.

topic.card.opt.by.description: Start of the line under a competing change's name in its row on a request's card: who built it. {{name}} is a username.

topic.card.opt.yes_one.description: End of the line under a competing change's name in its row on a request's card: how many members have voted yes for it. This form is for exactly one vote.

topic.card.opt.yes_other.description: End of the line under a competing change's name in its row on a request's card: how many members have voted yes for it. This form is for no votes or several.

topic.card.opt.look.description: Link at the end of a competing change's row on a request's card: opens that change over the card, with its summary, its before and after pictures and how its tests went.

topic.card.opt.lookSub.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a request's card when one of its competing changes is looked at. {{who}} says who built the change and its number, for example 'sam · #6712'; {{count}} is how many changes compete.

topic.rail.builtLettered.description: Name of a step in the "How it got here" timeline on a request's page (the list of the thread's big events, beside its card) when the request has competing changes: which one was built, by its letter on the ballot (A, B, C).

topic.card.layer.checksSub.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a change's card when its Tested or tests-failed step is pressed in the "How it got here" timeline: the panel holds how the change's automatic tests went.

topic.card.layer.votesSub.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a change's card when its up-for-a-vote or voted step is pressed in the "How it got here" timeline: the panel holds who has voted on the change and how many more votes it needs.

topic.card.layer.planBy.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a thread's card when the Planned step is pressed in the "How it got here" timeline. {{name}} is who posted the plan: a username or Homeroom bot.

topic.card.layer.planLoading.description: Shown in the panel that opens over a thread's card while the plan's text is being fetched.

topic.card.layer.planFailed.text: The plan could not be loaded. Close this and try again.
topic.card.layer.planFailed.description: Shown in the panel that opens over a thread's card when the plan's text could not be fetched.

topic.card.layer.requestSub.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a request's card when the Asked step is pressed in the "How it got here" timeline: the panel shows the request's own text. {{name}} is the username of who asked.

topic.card.layer.trackSub.description: Second line in the header of the panel that opens over a request's card when its current step is pressed in the "How it got here" timeline while Homeroom bot is working on it: the panel shows the bot's progress card.

topic.card.foot.seeProgress.description: Button at the foot of a change's card while its tests are running: opens the change's Testing card over the card.

topic.card.foot.readPlan.description: Button at the foot of a request's card when it has a plan: opens the plan over the card.

topic.card.ballot.choosing_one.description: Headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote, before anyone has voted. One change (it competes with closing the request).

topic.card.ballot.choosing_other.description: Headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote, before anyone has voted. Several changes.

topic.card.ballot.leads.description: Headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote: which change has the most yes votes. {{choice}} is its letter (A, B, …), {{yes}} its yes votes and {{other}} the next change's.

topic.card.ballot.levelTwo.description: Headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote when the two leading changes have the same number of yes votes. {{a}} and {{b}} are their letters.

topic.card.ballot.level.description: Headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote when three or more changes share the most yes votes.

topic.card.ballot.count.description: One choice's yes votes in the line under the headline at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote, for example "A 2". {{choice}} is a change's letter, or the word for neither or for closing the request; {{yes}} its yes votes.

topic.card.ballot.vote.description: Button at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote. Pressing it asks which change should go live.

topic.card.ballot.change.description: Link at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote, once the viewer has voted. Pressing it asks again which change should go live.

topic.card.ballot.which.description: Question shown at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote after Vote is pressed, over a button for each change and one for none of them.

topic.card.ballot.notVoted.description: Second part of the line at the foot of a request's card while its competing changes are up for one vote, after the counts and a dot, when the viewer has not voted yet. Lowercase: it follows a dot, as in "A 2 · B 1 · Neither 0 · you haven’t voted".

topic.card.ballot.cancel.description: Link beside the choices at the foot of a request's card when two or more changes built for it compete for the group's vote: puts the question away without voting.

topic.card.shots.noneTitle.description: Heading in the box where a change's before and after screenshots would be, on a change that alters nothing visible.

topic.card.shots.noneText.text: This change is to how it works underneath, so there are no before and after screenshots. The summary above says what it does.
topic.card.shots.noneText.description: Sentence under "Nothing you can see changes" in the box where a change's before and after screenshots would be.

topic.card.shots.notYetTitle.description: Title of the quiet box on a change's card where its before and after picture will be, while the change's tests have not passed yet.

topic.card.shots.notYetText.text: The before and after screenshots are taken once its tests pass.
topic.card.shots.notYetText.description: Line under "No screenshots yet" on a change's card.

topic.card.shots.neverTitle.description: Title of the quiet box on a change's card where its before and after picture would be, when its tests failed and nothing is fixing them.

topic.card.shots.neverText.text: This version never passed its tests, so none were taken.
topic.card.shots.neverText.description: Line under "No screenshots" on a change's card whose tests failed and whose fix stopped.

topic.card.checks.failed_one.description: Chip in the layer that opens over a change's card to show its tests: how many tests failed, for example "1 failed".

topic.card.checks.failed_other.description: Chip in the layer that opens over a change's card to show its tests: how many tests failed, for example "2 failed".

topic.card.checks.passed_one.description: Chip in the layer that opens over a change's card to show its tests: how many tests passed, for example "1 passed".

topic.card.checks.passed_other.description: Chip in the layer that opens over a change's card to show its tests: how many tests passed, for example "736 passed".

topic.card.look.yes_one.description: Chip under a competing change's summary, in the layer Look opens over a request's card: how many members voted yes for it, for example "1 yes".

topic.card.look.yes_other.description: Chip under a competing change's summary, in the layer Look opens over a request's card: how many members voted yes for it, for example "2 yes" or "0 yes".

topic.card.shots.tile.description: Accessible name of a small picture under a change's before and after picture on its page: pressing it shows that screen in the picture above. {{index}} is the screen's position and {{total}} how many screens the change has.

topic.card.shots.screenOf.description: Small line beside the row of screen pictures under a change's before and after picture: which screen the picture above is showing. {{total}} is 2 or more.

diagram.kind.seen.description: Small-caps label over a picture for a change that changes nothing on screen, when the picture shows one element (a status line, a message, a notice or a count) before the change and after it.

diagram.kind.moment.description: Small-caps label over a picture for a change that changes nothing on screen, when the picture tells a short timeline of a real incident from the request: its date, the change it happened to, and how long it lasted.

diagram.kind.steps.description: Small-caps label over a picture for a change that changes nothing on screen, when the picture shows a before row and an after row of small drawings, each with a short caption.

diagram.seen.before.description: Label over the left side of a “What you’d see” picture: the element as it is now, before the change.

diagram.seen.after.description: Label over the right side of a “What you’d see” picture: the element as it is once the change is in. Also labels the second row of a “How it works” picture.

diagram.moment.now.description: Label over the second part of a “What happened” picture: what happens now, after the change.

diagram.moment.head.description: The head line of a “What happened” picture: when the incident happened, the change it happened to, and how long it lasted. {{date}} is a date such as “18 Nov 2026”; {{ref}} names a change or request such as “PR #6699”; {{lasted}} is a duration such as “about 25 minutes”. Keep the middle dots and the spaces around them.

diagram.moment.headNoLasted.description: The head line of a “What happened” picture when the author did not say how long it lasted: when it happened and the change it happened to. {{date}} is a date such as “18 Nov 2026”, {{ref}} names a change or request such as “PR #6699”. Keep the middle dot.

diagram.steps.retry.description: Words a screen reader hears beside a step of a “How it works” picture that was tried again, drawn with a small retry mark.

diagram.text.seen.description: A “What you’d see” picture said in words, for a screen reader. {{where}} names the element the picture shows; {{before}} and {{after}} are its words on each side.

diagram.text.moment.description: A “What happened” picture said in words, for a screen reader (the picture's label is read before it, so it is not repeated here). {{date}} is when it happened, {{ref}} the change it happened to, {{events}} what happened then, and {{now}} what happens now, each already joined into a list.

diagram.text.steps.description: A “How it works” picture said in words, for a screen reader (the picture's label is read before it, so it is not repeated here). {{before}} and {{after}} are each that row's captions in order.

topic.card.shots.noPictureTitle.description: Heading in the box where a change's picture would be, on a change that changes nothing on screen and has no picture of what it does yet.

topic.card.shots.noPictureText.text: Nothing on screen changes, and this change has no picture of what it does yet. Homeroom bot is adding one.
topic.card.shots.noPictureText.description: Sentence under “No picture yet” in the box where a change's picture would be.

topic.details.touches.description: Sub-heading in the Details sheet of a change, over the picture of which parts of the project the change edits: screens, server, database and tests, with a count of files.

generic.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: used when a notification has nothing more specific to say.

join.app.description: Phone notification title: what happened, then the project it happened in. {{title}} is the rest of the title, already in the language; {{app}} is the project's name. Keep the middle dot unless the language separates them differently.

join.conversation.description: Phone notification title: what happened, then the conversation it happened in. {{title}} is the rest of the title, already in the language; {{conversation}} is the conversation's name. Keep the middle dot unless the language separates them differently.

testAlert.title.description: Phone notification title: the test a person sends themselves from Settings to check notifications work. Homeroom is the product's name.

testAlert.body.text: Your phone can receive push notifications from Homeroom.
testAlert.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the test a person sends themselves from Settings. Homeroom is the product's name.

conversationInvite.title.person.description: Phone notification title: somebody invited the reader to a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationInvite.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to a private conversation from somebody whose name is not known.

conversationInvite.body.text: Open Messages to accept or decline
conversationInvite.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: an invitation to a conversation. Messages is the name of the screen.

conversationMessage.title.person.description: Phone notification title: a new message in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationMessage.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: a new message in a private conversation from somebody whose name is not known.

conversationMention.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationReply.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody answered the reader in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationThreadReply.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody answered in a reply thread of a private conversation the reader is in. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationReaction.title.emoji.description: Phone notification title: somebody reacted to the reader's message in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{reaction}} is the emoji they used.

conversationReaction.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody reacted to the reader's message in a private conversation. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

conversationReaction.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's own message that somebody reacted to, in a private conversation. {{message}} is that message, as written.

friendRequest.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody asked to be the reader's friend. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

friendRequest.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a friend request. Notifications is the name of the screen where the buttons are.

friendAccept.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody accepted the reader's friend request. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

friendAccept.body.text: You're friends now. They show up first when you start a message
friendAccept.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a friend request was accepted. "They" is the new friend.

mention.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a project's chat about a change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

mention.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a project's chat. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

issueMention.title.numbered.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a request filed on a project's board. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{number}} is the request's number.

issueMention.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody named the reader in a request filed on a project's board, when its number is not known. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

issueMention.body.text: Open the request to see what they wrote
issueMention.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody named the reader in a request on a project's board.

reply.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody answered in a project's chat about a change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

reply.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody answered the reader in a project's chat. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

threadReply.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody answered in a reply thread of a project's chat the reader is in. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

issueThreadReply.title.numbered.description: Phone notification title: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the reader filed or posted in. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{number}} is the request's number.

issueThreadReply.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the reader filed or posted in, when its number is not known. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

changeThreadReply.title.numbered.description: Phone notification title: somebody posted in the discussion of a proposed change the reader is in. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{number}} is the change's number.

changeThreadReply.title.decision.description: Phone notification title: somebody posted in the discussion of a community decision the reader is in. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

channelMessage.many.title.where_one.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen. {{place}} is the group's name.

channelMessage.many.title.where_other.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen. {{place}} is the group's name.

channelMessage.many.title_one.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen.

channelMessage.many.title_other.description: Phone notification title: A person's messages in a small private group's discussion, several since the notification was first due: {{count}} is how many, always more than one in English, so the singular is rarely seen.

channelMessage.many.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the latest of several messages in a small group's discussion. {{actor}} is its writer's username: keep the @. {{message}} is what they wrote, as written.

channelMessage.one.title.where.description: Phone notification title: one message in a small private group's discussion. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{place}} is the group's name.

channelMessage.one.title.description: Phone notification title: one message in a small private group's discussion. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

reaction.title.emoji.description: Phone notification title: somebody reacted to the reader's message in a project's chat. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{reaction}} is the emoji they used.

reaction.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody reacted to the reader's message in a project's chat. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

reaction.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's own message that somebody reacted to, in a project's chat. {{message}} is that message, as written.

kudos.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody thanked the reader for a change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

kudos.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody thanked the reader. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

kudos.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody thanked the reader for their work.

inviteOpened.title.app.description: Phone notification title: somebody opened an invite link the reader made. {{app}} is a project's name.

inviteOpened.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody opened an invite link the reader made.

inviteOpened.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody opened an invite link the reader made: the reader gets another notification if they join.

memberJoined.title.app.description: Phone notification title: somebody joined through the reader's invite link. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{app}} is a project's name.

memberJoined.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody joined through the reader's invite link. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

memberJoined.body.text: They came in through your invite. Say hello
memberJoined.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody joined through the reader's invite link.

inviteLinkBusy.title.app_one.text: Your {{app}} invite link brought in {{count}} person today
inviteLinkBusy.title.app_one.description: Phone notification title: a lot of people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day, which can mean it was shared further than they meant. {{app}} is a project's name; {{count}} is how many joined through it in the last day.

inviteLinkBusy.title.app_other.text: Your {{app}} invite link brought in {{count}} people today
inviteLinkBusy.title.app_other.description: Phone notification title: a lot of people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day, which can mean it was shared further than they meant. {{app}} is a project's name; {{count}} is how many joined through it in the last day.

inviteLinkBusy.title.plain_one.text: Your invite link brought in {{count}} person today
inviteLinkBusy.title.plain_one.description: Phone notification title: a lot of people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day. {{count}} is how many joined through it in the last day.

inviteLinkBusy.title.plain_other.text: Your invite link brought in {{count}} people today
inviteLinkBusy.title.plain_other.description: Phone notification title: a lot of people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day. {{count}} is how many joined through it in the last day.

inviteLinkBusy.body.text: If you didn't expect that, you can turn it off
inviteLinkBusy.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a lot of people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day. "it" is the invite link; the notification in the app has the button that turns it off.

inviteLinkPaused.title.app.description: Phone notification title: so many people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day that it stopped letting more in. {{app}} is a project's name.

inviteLinkPaused.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: so many people joined through one of the reader's invite links within a day that it stopped letting more in.

inviteLinkPaused.body_one.text: {{count}} person joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
inviteLinkPaused.body_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: one of the reader's invite links paused itself. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. "it" is the invite link.

inviteLinkPaused.body_other.text: {{count}} people joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
inviteLinkPaused.body_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: one of the reader's invite links paused itself. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. "it" is the invite link.

firstMessage.title.app.description: Phone notification title: somebody the reader invited wrote their first message in a project. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{app}} is a project's name.

firstMessage.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody the reader invited wrote their first message. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

collabInvite.join.title.app.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to join a private project. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{app}} is a project's name.

collabInvite.join.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to join somebody's private project, when its name is not known. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

collabInvite.join.title.unnamed.text: You have an invite to join
collabInvite.join.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to join a private project, from somebody whose name is not known.

collabInvite.join.body.text: Accept or decline in the app
collabInvite.join.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: an invitation to join a private project.

collabInvite.build.title.app.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to build a project together. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{app}} is a project's name.

collabInvite.build.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to build something together. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

collabInvite.build.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to build something together, from somebody whose name is not known.

collabInvite.build.body.text: Join them to build it. Accept or decline in the app
collabInvite.build.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: an invitation to build a project together.

collabInviteAccepted.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody accepted the reader's invitation to build together. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

collabInviteAccepted.body.text: Your invite was accepted. You can start building together
collabInviteAccepted.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody accepted the reader's invitation to build together.

approverInvite.title.person.text: @{{actor}} asked you to help approve changes
approverInvite.title.person.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to become one of the people who vote on a project's changes. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

approverInvite.title.unnamed.text: You were asked to help approve changes
approverInvite.title.unnamed.description: Phone notification title: an invitation to become one of the people who vote on a project's changes, from somebody whose name is not known.

approverInvite.body.text: You'd try changes and vote on them. Accept in the app
approverInvite.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: an invitation to help approve a project's changes.

approverInviteAccepted.title.description: Phone notification title: somebody accepted the reader's invitation to help approve changes. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

approverInviteAccepted.body.text: They can try changes and vote on them from now on
approverInviteAccepted.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody accepted the reader's invitation to help approve changes.

changeReady.title.text: A change is ready to try
changeReady.title.description: Phone notification title: a change the reader can vote on is ready, when its name is not known.

changeReady.body.person.text: @{{actor}}'s change is ready to try. Try it and vote.
changeReady.body.person.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change is ready for the reader's vote. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

changeReady.body.unnamed.text: This change is ready to try. Try it and vote.
changeReady.body.unnamed.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change is ready for the reader's vote, when who asked for it is not known.

prProposed.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody proposed a change to a project. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

prProposed.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody proposed a change to a project. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

prProposed.body.text: @{{actor}} would love your eyes on this
prProposed.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody proposed a change and asks the reader to look at it. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

proposalVote.yes.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody voted for the reader's change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

proposalVote.yes.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody voted for the reader's change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

proposalVote.no.title.named.description: Phone notification title: somebody voted against the reader's change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

proposalVote.no.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody voted against the reader's change. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

proposalVote.body.reason.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reason a voter gave, in quotation marks of the language. {{reason}} is their own words, as written.

proposalVote.body.plain.text: Open the change to see their vote
proposalVote.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: somebody voted on the reader's change and left no reason.

prMerged.title.approved.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change to Homeroom itself was approved and will be live in minutes. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

prMerged.title.approved.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change to Homeroom itself was approved and will be live in minutes.

prMerged.title.live.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change is live: everybody using the project has it now. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

prMerged.title.live.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change is live: everybody using the project has it now.

prMerged.body.forced.soon.text: An admin approved it. Your change will be live in a few minutes
prMerged.body.forced.soon.description: Phone notification text under the title: an admin approved the reader's change to Homeroom itself without a vote.

prMerged.body.forced.live.text: An admin made it live. Your change is live
prMerged.body.forced.live.description: Phone notification text under the title: an admin put the reader's change live without a vote.

prMerged.body.credits.description: Phone notification text under the title: the vote on the reader's change passed. {{credits}} is a sentence naming the people who backed it, in English for now.

prMerged.body.carried.soon.text: The vote carried. Your change will be live in a few minutes
prMerged.body.carried.soon.description: Phone notification text under the title: the vote on the reader's change to Homeroom itself passed.

prMerged.body.carried.live.text: The vote carried. Your change is live
prMerged.body.carried.live.description: Phone notification text under the title: the vote on the reader's change passed.

revisionRecheck.title.named.description: Phone notification title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. {{change}} is the change's name, perhaps followed by its project, kept as written.

revisionRecheck.title.plain.text: Still good? A change you backed was updated
revisionRecheck.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again.

revisionRecheck.body.person.you.text: @{{actor}} updated it after you asked for a change. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.person.you.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. The reader asked for the update. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

revisionRecheck.body.person.asker.text: @{{actor}} updated it after @{{asker}} asked for a change. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.person.asker.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. {{asker}} is the username of who asked for the update: keep the @. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

revisionRecheck.body.person.bot.text: @{{actor}} updated it after a request for changes. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.person.bot.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. The Homeroom bot updated it on request. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

revisionRecheck.body.person.plain.text: @{{actor}} updated it. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.person.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.you.text: Someone updated it after you asked for a change. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.you.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. The reader asked for the update. Who updated it is not known.

revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.asker.text: Someone updated it after @{{asker}} asked for a change. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.asker.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. {{asker}} is the username of who asked for the update: keep the @. Who updated it is not known.

revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.bot.text: Someone updated it after a request for changes. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.bot.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. The Homeroom bot updated it on request. Who updated it is not known.

revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.plain.text: Someone updated it. One tap keeps your yes.
revisionRecheck.body.unnamed.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: A change the reader voted yes on was updated, so their yes needs a look again. Who updated it is not known.

projectOpened.title.app.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader joined while it was being made has its first version live. {{app}} is a project's name.

projectOpened.title.plain.text: A project you joined is open
projectOpened.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader joined while it was being made has its first version live.

projectOpened.body.text: It’s ready to use. Take a look
projectOpened.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader joined has its first version live.

votedChangeMerged.title.soon.text: A change you voted on was approved
votedChangeMerged.title.soon.description: Phone notification title: a change to Homeroom itself that the reader voted on was approved.

votedChangeMerged.title.live.text: A change you voted on is live
votedChangeMerged.title.live.description: Phone notification title: a change the reader voted on is live.

votedChangeMerged.body.soon.yes.text: Approved. It will be live in a few minutes. You voted yes.
votedChangeMerged.body.soon.yes.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change to Homeroom itself that the reader voted yes on was approved.

votedChangeMerged.body.soon.voted.text: Approved. It will be live in a few minutes. You voted on it.
votedChangeMerged.body.soon.voted.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change to Homeroom itself that the reader voted on was approved.

votedChangeMerged.body.live.yes.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change the reader voted yes on is live.

votedChangeMerged.body.live.voted.text: It's live. You voted on it.
votedChangeMerged.body.live.voted.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change the reader voted on is live.

weeklyDigest.title.app.description: Phone notification title: the Friday summary of a project. {{app}} is a project's name.

weeklyDigest.title.ready.description: Phone notification title: the one Friday summary that covers all of the viewer's projects. What happened is under it.

weeklyDigest.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the Friday summary.

weeklyDigest.body.nothing.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary, when no change went live this week.

weeklyDigest.body.shipped_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary: how many changes went live this week. {{count}} is that number.

weeklyDigest.body.shipped_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary: how many changes went live this week. {{count}} is that number.

weeklyDigest.body.waiting_one.text: One change is waiting for approval
weeklyDigest.body.waiting_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary: how many proposed changes are waiting for a vote. {{count}} is that number; English spells out the singular, and a translation of any form may use {{count}}.

weeklyDigest.body.waiting_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary: how many proposed changes are waiting for a vote. {{count}} is that number; English spells out the singular, and a translation of any form may use {{count}}.

weeklyDigest.body.both.description: Phone notification text under the title: the Friday summary: two sentences, in reading order. {{shipped}} says what went live this week and {{waiting}} what is waiting for approval; each is already a whole sentence in the language.

issueOpened.title.person.numbered.description: Phone notification title: somebody filed a request on a project's board. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it. {{number}} is the request's number.

issueOpened.title.person.plain.description: Phone notification title: somebody filed a request on a project's board, when its number is not known. {{actor}} is a username: keep the @ in front of it.

issueOpened.title.unnamed.numbered.description: Phone notification title: a new request on a project's board. {{number}} is the request's number.

issueOpened.title.unnamed.plain.description: Phone notification title: a new request on a project's board.

issueOpened.body.text: Open the request to see what needs attention
issueOpened.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a new request on a project's board.

voteDigest.title_one.text: {{count}} change is waiting for your approval
voteDigest.title_one.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. {{count}} is how many.

voteDigest.title_other.text: {{count}} changes are waiting for your approval
voteDigest.title_other.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. {{count}} is how many.

voteDigest.title.plain.text: Changes are waiting for your approval
voteDigest.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: a daily reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote, when how many is not known.

voteDigest.body.one.text: Open it to try it and approve it
voteDigest.body.one.description: Phone notification text under the title: a reminder of the one change waiting for the reader's vote.

voteDigest.body.many.text: See them under Needs you in Communities
voteDigest.body.many.description: Phone notification text under the title: a reminder of the changes waiting for the reader's vote. Needs you is a section of the Communities screen, and both are names on screen.

votedDigest.title_one.text: {{count}} change you voted on was decided
votedDigest.title_one.description: Phone notification title: a weekly count of the changes the reader voted on that went live or were closed in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

votedDigest.title_other.text: {{count}} changes you voted on were decided
votedDigest.title_other.description: Phone notification title: a weekly count of the changes the reader voted on that went live or were closed in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

votedDigest.title.plain.text: Changes you voted on were decided
votedDigest.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: a weekly summary of the changes the reader voted on, when how many is not known.

votedDigest.body.text: See how they ended in Your votes
votedDigest.body.description: Phone notification text under the title of the weekly summary of changes the reader voted on. Your votes is the name of a page on screen.

checkFailed.title.named.description: Phone notification title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

checkFailed.title.plain.text: Testing found a problem with your change
checkFailed.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change.

checkFailed.body.text: It needs a fix before it can go live
checkFailed.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: automatic testing failed on the reader's change.

stalePr.blocked.title.named.text: "{{title}}" is approved but can't go live
stalePr.blocked.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

stalePr.blocked.title.plain.text: Your approved change can't go live
stalePr.blocked.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged.

stalePr.blocked.body.text: It needs a fix before it can go live, or it will be set aside
stalePr.blocked.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has its votes but cannot be merged.

stalePr.waiting.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has been waiting a while for votes. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

stalePr.waiting.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's change has been waiting a while for votes.

stalePr.waiting.body.days_one.text: Nobody has weighed in for {{count}} day. Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.days_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes. {{count}} is how many days.

stalePr.waiting.body.days_other.text: Nobody has weighed in for {{count}} days. Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.days_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes. {{count}} is how many days.

stalePr.waiting.body.plain.text: Share the preview or ask a friend to try it
stalePr.waiting.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's change has been waiting for votes.

connectorSubmitted.title.named.description: Phone notification title: the reader's coding agent, working from outside Homeroom, submitted a change. {{title}} is the name of a change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

connectorSubmitted.title.plain.description: Phone notification title: the reader's coding agent, working from outside Homeroom, submitted a change.

connectorSubmitted.body.shared.text: It is visible in the in-progress area (no vote yet)
connectorSubmitted.body.shared.description: Phone notification text under the title: where the reader's agent put its work: shared in progress, not yet up for a vote.

connectorSubmitted.body.waiting.text: It is waiting for approval, and it is being tested
connectorSubmitted.body.waiting.description: Phone notification text under the title: where the reader's agent put its work: up for a vote, and being tested.

agentAwaiting.title.description: Phone notification title: the reader's Claude agent stopped to ask them a question. Claude is a name. Say that it asked, not that it is waiting: the reader may have answered already.

agentAwaiting.body.minutes_one.text: Asked {{count}} minute ago. It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.minutes_one.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question. {{count}} is how many minutes ago.

agentAwaiting.body.minutes_other.text: Asked {{count}} minutes ago. It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.minutes_other.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question. {{count}} is how many minutes ago.

agentAwaiting.body.plain.text: It is holding for your answer
agentAwaiting.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: the reader's Claude agent asked them a question just now.

appHealth.storageWarn.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage.

appHealth.storageWarn.body.app.text: {{app}} has used most of its storage. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.body.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage. {{app}} is a project's name.

appHealth.storageWarn.body.plain.text: Your app has used most of its storage. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used most of its storage.

appHealth.storageEarly.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used over half of its storage.

appHealth.storageEarly.body.app.text: {{app}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit before it fills
appHealth.storageEarly.body.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is over half full. {{app}} is a project's name; {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "1.6 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageEarly.body.plain.text: Your app has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit before it fills
appHealth.storageEarly.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is over half full. {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "1.6 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.app.text: {{app}} has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.app.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is close to its storage limit, with the space used and the limit. {{app}} is a project's name; {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "2.5 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.plain.text: Your app has used {{used}} of {{limit}}. Clean up old data or ask an admin to raise the limit
appHealth.storageWarn.bodySized.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs is close to its storage limit, with the space used and the limit. {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as "2.5 GB" and "3 GB".

appHealth.storageFull.title.description: Phone notification title: a project the reader runs has used all its storage.

appHealth.storageFull.body.text: New data cannot be saved until an admin raises the limit or allows time to clean up
appHealth.storageFull.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a project the reader runs has used all its storage.

appHealth.deployFailed.title.description: Phone notification title: the latest version of a project the reader runs could not be put live.

appHealth.deployFailed.body.text: The latest change did not go live. Open the app to see what failed
appHealth.deployFailed.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: the latest version of a project the reader runs could not be put live.

appHealth.releaseStalled.title.description: Phone notification title: a change to Homeroom itself was approved and has not reached people yet.

appHealth.releaseStalled.body.text: An approved change is not live yet. Open the board to see where it stopped
appHealth.releaseStalled.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: a change to Homeroom itself was approved and has not reached people yet. The board is the project's list of work.

appHealth.other.title.description: Phone notification title: something is wrong with a project the reader runs.

appHealth.other.body.text: Open the app to see what needs attention
appHealth.other.body.description: Phone notification text under the title: something is wrong with a project the reader runs.

releaseHold.title.description: Phone notification title, sent to platform administrators: a proposed change is held until one of them approves it.

releaseHold.body.named.text: “{{title}}” is held until an admin votes yes
releaseHold.body.named.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators. {{title}} is the name of the held change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

releaseHold.body.plain.text: It is held until an admin votes yes
releaseHold.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators, when the held change has no name.

releaseHold.notice.title.text: A change was not read in full
releaseHold.notice.title.description: Phone notification title, sent to platform administrators: Homeroom's risk rules could read only part of a proposed change. The change is not held.

releaseHold.notice.body.named.text: “{{title}}” is not held, and you can look at it
releaseHold.notice.body.named.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators. {{title}} is the name of the change, kept as written, in quotation marks of the language.

releaseHold.notice.body.plain.text: It is not held, and you can look at it
releaseHold.notice.body.plain.description: Phone notification text under the title, sent to platform administrators, when the change has no name.

merge.measured.justNow.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: says the figure in that sentence was measured within the last minute. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.minuteAgo.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: the figure in that sentence was measured about one minute ago. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.minutesAgo_one.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: how long ago the figure in that sentence was measured. {{count}} is a number of minutes. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.minutesAgo_other.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: how long ago the figure in that sentence was measured. {{count}} is a number of minutes. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.hourAgo.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: the figure in that sentence was measured about one hour ago. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.hoursAgo_one.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: how long ago the figure in that sentence was measured. {{count}} is a number of hours. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.hoursAgo_other.description: End of a tooltip on a proposal's status badge, after a sentence and a middle dot: how long ago the figure in that sentence was measured. {{count}} is a number of hours. Lower case, no full stop.

merge.measured.joined.description: Tooltip on a proposal's status badge: joins a whole explanation with how old its measurement is. {{statement}} is one or two complete sentences ending in a full stop; {{measured}} is a phrase such as "measured a minute ago". Only the separator between them is translated here.

explicitApproval.sentence.admins.text: Changes to who runs this app need a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.admins.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, why this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone: it changes the list of the app's admins. "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.sentence.governance.text: Changes to how changes are approved need a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.governance.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, why this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone: it changes the app's approval rule (how many votes a change needs). "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.sentence.visibility.text: Changes to who can see this app need a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.visibility.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, why this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone: it changes whether the app is public or private. "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.sentence.platformEnv.text: Changes to this app’s platform settings need a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.platformEnv.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, why this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone: it changes settings the platform applies to the app. "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.sentence.secrets.text: Changes to this app’s keys need a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.secrets.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, why this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone: it changes the app's secret keys (API keys and passwords the app uses). "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.sentence.other.text: This change needs a Yes from another member.
explicitApproval.sentence.other.description: Explains, on a proposal's vote panel and status tooltip, that this proposal cannot pass on its author's vote alone, when the reason is not one Homeroom can name. "change" is a noun: the proposed change. "Yes" is the name of the approving vote and keeps its capital.

explicitApproval.line.admins.text: It changes who runs this app
explicitApproval.line.admins.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal: what the proposal changes, here the list of the app's admins. "It" is the proposal; "changes" is a verb. No full stop.

explicitApproval.line.governance.text: It changes how changes are approved
explicitApproval.line.governance.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal: what the proposal changes, here the app's approval rule. "It" is the proposal; the first "changes" is a verb, the second a noun (proposed changes). No full stop.

explicitApproval.line.visibility.text: It changes who can see this app
explicitApproval.line.visibility.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal: what the proposal changes, here whether the app is public or private. "It" is the proposal; "changes" is a verb. No full stop.

explicitApproval.line.platformEnv.text: It changes this app’s platform settings
explicitApproval.line.platformEnv.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal: what the proposal changes, here settings the platform applies to the app. "It" is the proposal; "changes" is a verb. No full stop.

explicitApproval.line.secrets.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal: what the proposal changes, here the app's secret keys (API keys and passwords). "It" is the proposal; "changes" is a verb. No full stop.

explicitApproval.line.other.description: Short line beside the "needs another member's Yes" marker on a proposal, when Homeroom cannot name which setting the proposal changes. "It" is the proposal; "changes" is a verb. No full stop.

merge.status.integrating.description: Status badge on a proposal (a proposed change to an app): the platform is merging the app's latest code into the proposal right now. Shown with a spinner.

merge.title.integrating.text: The platform is merging main into this proposal to resolve a conflict. The result is previewed and checked, and it merges on its own once the vote passes.
merge.title.integrating.description: Tooltip on the "Bringing up to date…" status badge of a proposal. "main" is the name of the app's main code branch and stays as it is.

merge.status.waitingOnBudget.description: Status badge on a proposal: it must be merged with the app's latest code, but the platform's shared daily AI budget is used up, so that work waits.

merge.title.waitingOnBudget.text: This proposal needs merging with main, but the platform’s shared token budget is spent for today. It resumes after the midnight UTC reset.
merge.title.waitingOnBudget.description: Tooltip on the "Waiting on shared budget" status badge of a proposal. "main" is the name of the app's main code branch and stays as it is; tokens are units of AI usage.

merge.status.waitingOnGithub.description: Status badge on a proposal that passed its vote and its checks, but GitHub held its merge back: it was still finishing an earlier merge, or refused it for a reason nobody has to act on. The platform tries again by itself.

merge.title.githubBusy.text: GitHub said a merge of this change was already in progress. Homeroom tries again at {{time}}.
merge.title.githubBusy.description: Tooltip on the "Waiting on GitHub" status badge of a proposal. {{time}} is a clock time such as 10:45, shown in the viewer's own time zone. "Homeroom" is the name of the platform and stays as it is.

merge.title.githubBusySoon.text: GitHub said a merge of this change was already in progress. Homeroom tries again in a few minutes.
merge.title.githubBusySoon.description: Tooltip on the "Waiting on GitHub" status badge of a proposal, when the next try's time has passed or was not recorded. "Homeroom" is the name of the platform and stays as it is.
